计算机系统 · 虚拟化与隔离 · 从双系统到 condaComputer systems · Virtualisation and isolation · From dual boot to conda

一台机器，几个世界One Machine, Many Worlds

厨房机器人的团队只有一台好电脑：一台装着 Ubuntu 24.04 的工作站，16 核的 x86 CPU，64 GB 内存，2 TB 固态硬盘，一块 RTX 4090。这一周，七个要求同时落到它头上：新项目要 PyTorch 2.5 和 CUDA 12.4；要复现的老论文要 Python 3.8、PyTorch 1.13 和 CUDA 11.7；机器人的主程序用 ROS 2 Humble，它是给 Ubuntu 22.04 做的；力传感器厂家的标定工具只有 Windows 版；1 kHz 的关节控制回路要一个实时内核；比赛收上来的代码要跑，可不能让它碰到你的密钥；同一套软件还要搬到机器人身上 ARM 架构的 Jetson Thor、云上的 GPU 服务器和学校的集群上。办法有一大堆：双系统、虚拟机、Docker、conda、venv、WSL、gVisor、Nix……它们都能"隔出一个独立的系统"，可隔的地方不一样，靠的东西不一样，花的代价也不一样。这一篇先把一台电脑从硬件到你的程序拆成几层，看一条命令怎样一层层往下走；然后把二十几种方法放在同一张图上，一种一种拆开：各在哪一层动手、靠什么守住那堵墙、为什么被发明出来、要付出什么；最后回到这七个要求，一个一个给出答案。The kitchen-robot team has only one good computer: a workstation running Ubuntu 24.04, with a 16-core x86 CPU, 64 GB of memory, a 2 TB SSD and an RTX 4090. This week, seven requests land on it all at once: the new project needs PyTorch 2.5 and CUDA 12.4; an old paper that has to be reproduced needs Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.13 and CUDA 11.7; the robot’s main program uses ROS 2 Humble, which was made for Ubuntu 22.04; the calibration tool from the force-sensor maker exists only for Windows; the 1 kHz joint control loop needs a real-time kernel; the code handed in for a competition has to be run, but it must not be able to touch your keys; and the same software also has to move to the ARM-based Jetson Thor on the robot, to a GPU server in the cloud and to the university’s cluster. There are lots of ways to do it: dual boot, virtual machines, Docker, conda, venv, WSL, gVisor, Nix … They can all "carve out a system of its own", but where they carve, what they rely on and what they cost all differ. This page first takes a computer apart into layers, from the hardware up to your program, and follows one command down through them, layer by layer; then it puts twenty-odd methods on a single diagram and takes them apart one at a time: the layer where each one steps in, what it relies on to guard its wall, why it was invented and what it costs; and finally it comes back to the seven requests and answers them one by one.

Where the text says "we measured", the measurement was taken on a small virtual machine in the cloud: 2 virtual CPUs, 8 GB of memory, Ubuntu 24.04, Linux 6.18, Docker 29.8; the small programs we measured with are in the isolation/meas/ directory of this page’s repository. Anything marked "est." is an order-of-magnitude estimate with no source.

速查表：本篇用到的说法、记号和缩写Quick reference: the terms, notation and abbreviations used on this page

一台电脑的几层The layers of a computer

硬件Hardware
CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU 和各种设备（第 ① 步）the CPU, memory, disks, GPU and all sorts of other devices (step ①)
固件、UEFIFirmware, UEFI
存在主板上、开机后最先跑的程序，负责找到并启动引导程序（第 ④ 步）the program stored on the motherboard that runs first at power-on; it finds and starts the boot loader (step ④)
引导程序、GRUBBoot loader, GRUB
把内核从磁盘读进内存的程序（第 ④ 步）the program that reads the kernel from disk into memory (step ④)
内核Kernel
管硬件、进程、内存、文件和网络的那个程序，比如 Linux、Windows 的 NT 内核（第 ① 步）the program that manages the hardware, processes, memory, files and network, such as Linux or the NT kernel of Windows (step ①)
系统调用System call
程序请内核办事的入口，比如 openat（打开文件）、read（读）（第 ① 步）the door through which a program asks the kernel to do something, such as openat (open a file) and read (read from it) (step ①)
系统库、glibcSystem libraries, glibc
几乎所有程序都要用的 C 库；每个发行版带一个版本，Ubuntu 22.04 是 2.35，24.04 是 2.39（第 ① 步）the C library that almost every program uses; each distribution ships one version: 2.35 in Ubuntu 22.04, 2.39 in 24.04 (step ①)
运行时、包Runtime, package
跑程序要的解释器和库（Python 解释器、CUDA 运行时）；装进来的第三方代码（site-packages 里的 torch）（第 ①、⑪ 步）the interpreter and libraries a program needs to run (the Python interpreter, the CUDA runtime); third-party code you install (torch in site-packages) (steps ① and ⑪)

进程和内存Processes and memory

进程、PIDProcess, PID
一个正在跑的程序，有自己的内存；它的编号（第 ②、⑦ 步）a running program, with its own memory; its number (steps ② and ⑦)
用户态、内核态User mode, kernel mode
CPU 的两种权限：普通程序在用户态，内核在内核态（第 ② 步）the CPU’s two privilege levels: ordinary programs run in user mode, the kernel in kernel mode (step ②)
虚拟地址、物理地址Virtual address, physical address
程序看到的地址；内存条上真实的地址（第 ② 步）the address a program sees; the real address on the memory modules (step ②)
页、页表、缺页Page, page table, page fault
内存按 4 KiB 一页来管；页表记着每个虚拟页在哪个物理页；要找的页不在，CPU 交给内核处理（第 ② 步）memory is managed in pages of 4 KiB; the page table records which physical page each virtual page is in; if the page being looked for isn’t there, the CPU hands over to the kernel (step ②)
快表（TLB）TLB (translation lookaside buffer)
CPU 里记着最近用过的地址翻译结果的小表（第 ②、⑤ 步）a small table in the CPU that remembers the results of recent address translations (steps ② and ⑤)

虚拟机Virtual machines

虚拟机、客户机、主机Virtual machine, guest, host
假装出来的一整台电脑；在里面跑的系统；真正的那台电脑和它的系统（第 ⑤ 步）a whole make-believe computer; the system that runs inside it; the real computer and its system (step ⑤)
虚拟机监控器Hypervisor
英文 hypervisor：管着几台虚拟机、替它们和硬件打交道的程序（第 ⑤ 步）also called a virtual machine monitor: the program that runs several virtual machines and deals with the hardware on their behalf (step ⑤)
陷入、VM 退出Trap, VM exit
CPU 碰到敏感的操作，停下客户机，交给监控器处理（第 ⑤ 步）when the CPU meets a sensitive operation, it stops the guest and hands over to the hypervisor (step ⑤)
嵌套页表Nested paging
Intel 叫 EPT，AMD 叫 NPT：CPU 自己做客户机和主机两层地址翻译（第 ⑤ 步）Intel calls it EPT, AMD calls it NPT: the CPU itself does both levels of address translation, the guest’s and the host’s (step ⑤)
virtio、直通virtio, passthrough
虚拟机知道自己是虚拟的，用共享队列和监控器交换数据；把一个真实设备整个交给一台虚拟机（第 ⑤ 步）the VM knows it is virtual and exchanges data with the hypervisor through shared queues; handing a whole real device over to one VM (step ⑤)

容器和沙箱Containers and sandboxes

容器Containers
一组共用主机内核的进程，却看到自己的文件、进程、网络和主机名（第 ⑦ 步）each one a group of processes that share the host’s kernel yet see their own files, processes, network and hostname (step ⑦)
命名空间Namespace
英文 namespace：内核给一组进程的一份单独的"名字表"，比如进程号表、挂载表（第 ⑦ 步）a separate "name table" that the kernel gives a group of processes, such as the process-ID table or the mount table (step ⑦)
控制组Control group
英文 cgroup：内核给一组进程设的资源上限，比如最多 2 个 CPU、4 GiB 内存（第 ⑦ 步）cgroup for short: the resource limits the kernel sets for a group of processes, such as at most 2 CPUs and 4 GiB of memory (step ⑦)
能力、seccompCapabilities, seccomp
root 的权力拆成的小块（Linux 有 41 种）；按系统调用过滤的规则（第 ⑦、⑩ 步）root’s powers split into small pieces (Linux has 41 of them); rules that filter system calls (steps ⑦ and ⑩)
镜像、层、摘要Image, layer, digest
容器的文件系统模板；镜像由几层叠成；每层按内容算出来的 SHA-256 名字（第 ⑧ 步）the template for a container’s file system; an image is a stack of several layers; each layer’s SHA-256 name, computed from its content (step ⑧)
沙箱Sandboxes
重点不在给程序一个新世界，而在收走权限：要什么得申请（第 ⑩ 步）the point is not to give a program a new world but to take permissions away: whatever it wants, it has to ask for (step ⑩)

环境Environments

PATH
shell 找命令时依次去看的目录列表（第 ①、⑪ 步）the list of directories the shell looks through, in order, to find a command (steps ① and ⑪)
sys.path
Python 找包时依次去看的目录列表（第 ⑪ 步）the list of directories Python looks through, in order, to find a package (step ⑪)
动态链接器Dynamic linker
程序启动时替它找到 .so 共享库的程序（第 ①、⑪ 步）the program that finds a program’s .so shared libraries for it when it starts (steps ① and ⑪)
环境Environments
一个目录，里面放一个项目自己的包，有时连解释器和库也放进去（venv、conda）（第 ⑪ 步）each one a directory holding one project’s own packages, sometimes the interpreter and libraries too (venv, conda) (step ⑪)
Nix 仓库路径Nix store path
/nix/store/哈希-名字，哈希由全部构建输入算出来（第 ⑫ 步）/nix/store/hash-name, where the hash is computed from all the build inputs (step ⑫)

GPU 和硬件GPU and hardware

驱动Driver
GPU 的驱动分两半：内核里的 nvidia.ko 和用户态的 libcuda.so，版本一般必须一致；数据中心的卡和 Jetson 例外，能用 NVIDIA 的 cuda-compat 包换上更新的 libcuda.so（第 ⑬ 步）the GPU driver comes in two halves, nvidia.ko in the kernel and the user-mode libcuda.so, whose versions usually have to match; data-centre cards and Jetson are the exceptions, where NVIDIA’s cuda-compat package can swap in a newer libcuda.so (step ⑬)
CUDA 运行时CUDA runtime
程序编译时选定的那一版 CUDA 库（libcudart），跟着程序走（第 ⑬ 步）the version of the CUDA library (libcudart) chosen when the program was compiled; it travels with the program (step ⑬)
MIG
把一块 GPU 在硬件上切成最多 7 份（第 ⑬ 步）cuts one GPU into as many as 7 slices in hardware (step ⑬)
可信执行环境Trusted execution environment
CPU 在硬件上把一块内存隔开（SGX、SEV、TDX 还给它加密），连操作系统、监控器和机器的主人都看不到（第 ⑭ 步）the CPU walls off a piece of memory in hardware (SGX, SEV and TDX also encrypt it), so that not even the operating system, the hypervisor or the machine’s owner can see it (step ⑭)

记号Notation

S, P
敏感指令的集合；特权指令的集合（第 ⑤ 步）the set of sensitive instructions; the set of privileged instructions (step ⑤)
n, m, R
客户机和主机的页表各有几级；快表没命中时一次要读几次内存（第 ⑤ 步）how many levels the guest’s and the host’s page tables each have; how many memory reads one TLB miss takes (step ⑤)
Nexit, texit, f
每秒 VM 退出几次；一次退出加回去的时间；监控器占掉的时间比例（第 ⑤ 步）the number of VM exits per second; the time one exit takes, including the way back; the fraction of time the hypervisor takes up (step ⑤)
Q, T, c
控制组的 CPU 配额和周期（微秒）；它们折合几个 CPU（第 ⑦ 步）a control group’s CPU quota and period (in microseconds); how many CPUs they amount to (step ⑦)
h(·)
哈希函数：把任意长的内容变成一串固定长度的"指纹"（第 ⑧、⑫ 步）a hash function: it turns content of any length into a fixed-length "fingerprint" (steps ⑧ and ⑫)
v
驱动的版本号（第 ⑬ 步）the driver’s version number (step ⑬)

单位和缩写Units and abbreviations

周期Cycle
CPU 时钟走一下；3.8 GHz 的 CPU 一秒走 38 亿个周期one tick of the CPU’s clock; a 3.8 GHz CPU goes through 3.8 billion cycles a second
VM, VMM
虚拟机；虚拟机监控器virtual machine; virtual machine monitor
GPT, ESP
磁盘的分区表格式；EFI 系统分区，放各个系统的引导程序（第 ④ 步）a disk’s partition-table format; the EFI system partition, which holds each system’s boot loader (step ④)
WSL
Windows 上跑 Linux 的子系统，有 1 和 2 两代（第 ⑥ 步）the subsystem for running Linux on Windows, which comes in two generations, 1 and 2 (step ⑥)
OOM
内存用完（out of memory）；内核的 OOM 杀手会杀掉进程（第 ⑦ 步）out of memory; the kernel’s OOM killer will kill processes (step ⑦)
TEE
可信执行环境（第 ⑭ 步）trusted execution environment (step ⑭)

第 0 步 · 七个要求Step 0 · Seven requests

一台工作站，七个要求One workstation, seven requests

先把这台工作站说清楚。它装的是 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS：内核 6.8，C 库 glibc 2.39，系统自带的 Python 是 3.12（Ubuntu 2024）。显卡是一块 24 GB 的 RTX 4090，驱动版本 550。整个团队共用它，有人用 ssh 登进来训练，有人坐在它前面调机器人。这一周，七个要求落到了它头上，后面一直用 A 到 G 称呼它们：First, let’s describe the workstation properly. It runs Ubuntu 24.04 LTS: kernel 6.8, the C library glibc 2.39, and the system’s own Python, 3.12 (Ubuntu 2024). The graphics card is a 24 GB RTX 4090, on driver version 550. The whole team shares it: some log in over ssh to train models, others sit in front of it debugging the robot. This week, seven requests landed on it. From here on we call them A to G:

  • A 新项目：训练新的抓取策略，要 Python 3.12、PyTorch 2.5.1、CUDA 12.4。单独装没问题，只是 Ubuntu 24.04 不让你直接往系统的 Python 里 pip install（会报 externally-managed-environment，PEP 668），得先建一个环境。A New project: train a new grasping policy, which needs Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.5.1 and CUDA 12.4. On its own that installs without trouble; it’s just that Ubuntu 24.04 won’t let you pip install straight into the system Python (it fails with externally-managed-environment, PEP 668), so you have to create an environment first.
  • B 老项目：复现一篇 2022 年的基线，要 Python 3.8、PyTorch 1.13.1、CUDA 11.7（PyTorch 2022）。PyTorch 1.13 没有给 Python 3.12 的安装包；Ubuntu 24.04 不带 Python 3.8，而 3.8 在 2024 年 10 月已经停止维护（Anaconda 2024）；就算装得上，装进 A 的同一个目录，也会把 A 的 PyTorch 换掉。B Old project: reproduce a 2022 baseline, which needs Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.13.1 and CUDA 11.7 (PyTorch 2022). PyTorch 1.13 has no install packages for Python 3.12. Ubuntu 24.04 doesn’t ship Python 3.8, and 3.8 reached end of life in October 2024 (Anaconda 2024). And even if you got it installed, putting it in the same directory as A would replace A’s PyTorch.
  • C 机器人主程序：ROS 2 Humble。它的一级支持平台是 Ubuntu 22.04（Open Robotics 2022），24.04 对应的长期支持版是 Jazzy（Open Robotics 2024）。在 24.04 上，apt 根本找不到 Humble 的包。C The robot’s main program: ROS 2 Humble. Its Tier 1 platform is Ubuntu 22.04 (Open Robotics 2022); the long-term support release that goes with 24.04 is Jazzy (Open Robotics 2024). On 24.04, apt can’t find any Humble packages at all.
  • D 标定工具：力传感器厂家的标定软件只有 Windows 版，还要通过 USB 和传感器说话。在 Linux 上，这个 .exe 连执行都执行不了。D Calibration tool: the force-sensor maker’s calibration software is Windows-only, and it also has to talk to the sensor over USB. On Linux, this .exe won’t even execute.
  • E 控制回路：每秒 1000 次算一遍关节力矩，要实时内核（PREEMPT_RT）：1 毫秒一圈，每一圈都得准时开始，普通的内核偶尔会让它多等一阵（第 5 篇讲过这一圈）。可一台机器同一时间只能有一个内核直接管着硬件。E Control loop: work out the joint torques 1000 times a second. This needs a real-time kernel (PREEMPT_RT): one turn of the loop every 1 ms, every turn has to start on time, while an ordinary kernel now and then makes it wait a little longer (page 5 covered this loop). But a machine can have only one kernel directly in charge of the hardware at any one time.
  • F 别人的代码：比赛收上来的代码，或者 AI 编程助手写的代码，要跑一跑看结果，但不能让它读到 ~/.ssh 里的私钥，也不能删掉数据。就这么运行，它的权限和你一模一样。F Someone else’s code: code handed in for a competition, or written by an AI coding assistant, has to be run to see the results, but it mustn’t be able to read the private keys in ~/.ssh or delete data. Run it as it is, and it has exactly the same permissions as you.
  • G 部署：同一套软件要搬到三个地方：机器人身上的 Jetson Thor（ARM64 的 CPU；系统 JetPack 7，现在的 7.2.1 基于 Ubuntu 24.04，带 CUDA 13.2，NVIDIA 2026）、云上的 GPU 服务器（它本身就是一台虚拟机），还有学校的集群（没有 root，用 Slurm 排队，GPU 大家轮着用）。在 x86 上编出来的程序，到了 ARM 上执行不了；在集群上也不能 sudo。G Deployment: the same software has to move to three places: the Jetson Thor on the robot (an ARM64 CPU; the system is JetPack 7, and the current 7.2.1 is based on Ubuntu 24.04 and comes with CUDA 13.2, NVIDIA 2026), a GPU server in the cloud (itself a virtual machine), and the university cluster (no root, jobs queue in Slurm, and everyone takes turns on the GPUs). A program compiled on x86 won’t execute on ARM, and on the cluster you can’t sudo either.

七个要求卡在六个地方：A 和 B 都卡在 Python 的包和解释器上，C 卡在发行版带的系统库上，D 卡在操作系统本身，E 卡在内核，G 卡在 CPU 的种类和权限上；F 不缺哪一层，缺的是一堵墙。后面会看到，这正是二十几种方法的分界线：每种方法都是在某一层把电脑"复制"一份，那一层以上各用各的，以下大家共用；再由某个东西守住这条线。这一篇要回答六个问题：The seven requests are stuck in six places: A and B both on Python’s packages and interpreter, C on the system libraries that come with the distribution, D on the operating system itself, E on the kernel, and G on the kind of CPU and on permissions. F isn’t missing a layer; what it lacks is a wall. As we’ll see, this is exactly the dividing line between the twenty-odd methods: each one "copies" the computer at some layer, so that from that layer up there is one copy per world and below it everything is shared; and something guards that line. This page sets out to answer six questions:

  1. 双系统、虚拟机、Docker、conda……它们有什么共同点？What do dual boot, virtual machines, Docker, conda and the rest have in common?
  2. 它们到底哪里不一样？Where exactly do they differ?
  3. 每一种是为了解决什么问题被发明出来的？What problem was each one invented to solve?
  4. 每一种换来什么、付出什么（启动时间、内存、磁盘、速度、安全）？What does each one buy you, and what does it cost (start-up time, memory, disk, speed, security)?
  5. 它们在计算机里是怎么工作的？How do they work inside the computer?
  6. 这七个要求各该用哪一种，能不能套起来用？Which one should each of the seven requests use, and can they be nested?
  • 左边（手机上是上面）是这台工作站，从下到上一层一层画出来，每层写着真实的版本：硬件、固件和引导、内核、系统调用的那条线、系统库和发行版、运行时、包、你的程序。右边是一个终端，显示每个要求敲下的命令和它打出来的结果。On the left (at the top on a phone) is the workstation, drawn layer by layer from the bottom up, each layer labelled with its real versions: hardware, firmware and boot, kernel, the system-call line, system libraries and distro, runtimes, packages, your program. On the right is a terminal that shows the commands typed for each request and what they print.

    这一步的要点：一台机器上要同时装下的东西会在不同的层打架：包和解释器、发行版的系统库、操作系统、内核、CPU 的种类；还有一种要求不是"换一层"，而是"加一堵墙"。看清楚卡在哪一层，就知道要从哪一层开始复制。The point of this step: The things one machine has to hold at the same time clash at different layers: packages and interpreters, the distribution’s system libraries, the operating system, the kernel, the kind of CPU. And one kind of request is not about "swapping a layer" but about "adding a wall". See clearly which layer a request gets stuck at, and you know which layer to start copying from.
    

    

    

    第 ① 步 · 一台电脑的几层Step ① · The layers of a computer
    

    一条命令，从你的程序一路走到硬盘One command, all the way from your program down to the disk
    

    要看懂这些方法在哪里动手，先得知道一台电脑分几层。拿 A 的训练脚本做例子：它只有一行命令，python train.py。脚本里先 import torch，再读一张照片 cup.png，最后放到 GPU 上算。敲下回车之后，这一行要穿过好几层：To see where these methods step in, you first need to know what layers a computer has. Take A’s training script as the example: it is a single command, python train.py. The script first runs import torch, then reads a photo, cup.png, and finally computes on the GPU. Once you press Enter, this one line has to pass through quite a few layers:
    

      

    • shell 找程序：你敲的是 python 这个名字。shell 按 PATH 变量里的目录一个一个去找，比如 /home/team/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin，第一个找到的就算数。这里先在 .venv/bin 里找到了，它其实是指向 /usr/bin/python3.12 的一个链接。The shell finds the program: what you typed is the name python. The shell searches the directories in the PATH variable one by one, for example /home/team/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin, and the first match wins. Here it turns up first in .venv/bin, where it is really a link pointing to /usr/bin/python3.12.
      • 

    • 内核装载程序：shell 先请内核复制出一个新进程（系统调用 fork，Linux 上实际用的是 clone），新进程再请内核执行这个文件（系统调用 execve）：内核扔掉它原来的内存，配一张新的页表，把程序映射进去（第 ② 步细讲）。The kernel loads the program: the shell first asks the kernel to copy it into a new process (the fork system call; on Linux it is actually clone), and the new process then asks the kernel to execute the file (the execve system call): the kernel throws away the process’s old memory, sets up a new page table and maps the program into it (step ② covers this in detail).
      • 

    • 动态链接器找库：python 不是一个孤零零的文件，它要用 libc.so.6（glibc 2.39）等共享库。动态链接器依次去看：程序里写的路径、LD_LIBRARY_PATH 变量、系统的缓存表，最后是 /lib 和 /usr/lib（程序里写的路径如果是 RUNPATH 这一种，就排到 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 后面，第 ⑪ 步细讲）。The dynamic linker finds the libraries: python is not a file that stands on its own; it needs shared libraries such as libc.so.6 (glibc 2.39). The dynamic linker looks, in order, at the paths written into the program, the LD_LIBRARY_PATH variable, the system’s cache table and finally /lib and /usr/lib (if the path written into the program is of the RUNPATH kind, it moves behind LD_LIBRARY_PATH; step ⑪ covers this in detail).
      • 

    • Python 找包：import torch 时，Python 按 sys.path 里的目录依次找，在 .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/torch 找到。Python finds the package: at import torch, Python searches the directories in sys.path in order and finds it at .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/torch.
      • 

    • torch 找 CUDA：PyTorch 的库再去找 CUDA 运行时 libcudart.so.12（12.4 版，跟着 pip 装进来），它又去找驱动的用户态部分 libcuda.so.1（550 版，装驱动时装在系统里）。torch finds CUDA: PyTorch’s libraries then look for the CUDA runtime, libcudart.so.12 (version 12.4, pulled in by pip), which in turn looks for the user-mode part of the driver, libcuda.so.1 (version 550, put on the system when the driver was installed).
      • 

    • 打开文件：open("cup.png") 经过 glibc，变成一次系统调用 openat。CPU 从用户态切到内核态，进入内核。Opening the file: open("cup.png") goes through glibc and becomes an openat system call. The CPU switches from user mode to kernel mode and enters the kernel.
      • 

    • 内核找文件：cup.png 是相对路径，内核的虚拟文件系统（VFS）从进程的当前目录 /home/team 找起（这个目录当初也是从 / 一级级找到的：/ → home → team），按目录和挂载表找到 ext4 文件系统上的 cup.png。The kernel finds the file: cup.png is a relative path, so the kernel’s virtual file system (VFS) starts from the process’s current directory, /home/team (that directory was itself found one level at a time from /: / → home → team). Going by the directories and the mount table, it finds cup.png on the ext4 file system.
      • 

    • 读数据：ext4 把文件对应到磁盘上的块，经过块设备层、NVMe 驱动，从固态硬盘读出来，复制到 Python 的内存里。Reading the data: ext4 maps the file to blocks on the disk; they are read off the SSD through the block-device layer and the NVMe driver, then copied into Python’s memory.
      • 

    • 用 GPU：libcuda.so 通过设备文件 /dev/nvidia0 请内核里的 nvidia.ko 驱动办事，驱动再去指挥 RTX 4090。Using the GPU: through the device file /dev/nvidia0, libcuda.so asks the nvidia.ko driver in the kernel to do the work, and the driver in turn directs the RTX 4090.
      • 

    

    把这九步按层排一排，从下往上是：硬件（CPU、内存、硬盘、GPU）、固件和引导（开机时把内核读进来，之后就退到一边）、内核（管进程、内存、文件、网络和驱动）、系统调用这道门、系统库和发行版（glibc 和 apt 装的那一大堆）、运行时（Python 解释器、CUDA 运行时）、包（site-packages 里的 torch）、最上面是你的程序。用户态和内核态之间只有一道门，就是系统调用：程序要读文件、开网络、要内存、启动别的程序，都得敲这道门，请内核去办。Sort these nine steps by layer and, from the bottom up, you get: hardware (CPU, memory, disk, GPU), firmware and boot (reads the kernel in at power-on, then steps aside), the kernel (manages processes, memory, files, the network and drivers), the system-call door, system libraries and distro (glibc and the whole heap of things apt installs), runtimes (the Python interpreter, the CUDA runtime), packages (torch in site-packages), and at the very top your program. Between user mode and kernel mode there is only one door, the system call: whenever a program wants to read a file, open a network connection, get memory or start another program, it has to knock on this door and ask the kernel to do it.
    

    再细看一遍，会发现每一层干的其实是同一件事：按名字找东西。shell 按 PATH 把 "python" 找成一个文件；动态链接器按搜索路径把 "libc.so.6" 找成一个文件；Python 按 sys.path 把 "torch" 找成一个目录；内核按挂载表把 "/home/team/cup.png" 找成磁盘上的块，按页表把一个地址找成内存条上的一个位置，按设备文件把 "/dev/nvidia0" 找成一个驱动。这一篇的二十几种方法，说穿了都是在某一层换掉这张"名字 → 东西"的表：venv 换的是 sys.path，conda 换的是 PATH 和库的搜索路径，容器换的是内核里的挂载表、进程号表、网络表，虚拟机连"内存地址 → 内存条"和"设备 → 硬件"这两张表都换了，双系统换的是开机时读进来的那个内核。换得越低，能变的东西越多，代价也越大。Look again more closely and you’ll see that every layer is really doing the same thing: looking things up by name. The shell uses PATH to turn "python" into a file; the dynamic linker uses its search path to turn "libc.so.6" into a file; Python uses sys.path to turn "torch" into a directory; the kernel uses the mount table to turn "/home/team/cup.png" into blocks on the disk, the page table to turn an address into a location in RAM, and device files to turn "/dev/nvidia0" into a driver. Strip away the details, and each of this page’s twenty-odd methods replaces this "name → thing" table at some layer: venv replaces sys.path; conda replaces PATH and the library search path; containers replace the kernel’s mount table, process-ID table and network table; virtual machines even replace both the "memory address → RAM" and the "device → hardware" tables; and dual boot replaces the kernel read in at power-on. The lower the replacement, the more can change, and the higher the cost.
    

    跨过系统调用这道门有多贵What it costs to cross the system-call door
    

    

    tcall ≈ 1.6 nstsys ≈ 123 ns ≈ 80 tcall
    

    

    一次普通的函数调用约 1.6 纳秒；一次最简单的系统调用约 123 纳秒，是函数调用的约 80 倍。An ordinary function call takes about 1.6 ns; the simplest system call takes about 123 ns, roughly 80 times as long.
    

    函数调用只是在同一个程序里跳一下。系统调用要过一道门：CPU 换到内核态，保存程序的寄存器，跳到内核的入口，内核检查参数、查表找到对应的处理函数，办完再换回用户态。我们测的这个系统调用（getppid，问"我的父进程是谁"）内核几乎什么都不用做，所以 123 纳秒基本全是过门的钱。后面会看到，各种隔离方法的运行开销，很大一部分就是一次请求要多过几道门：gVisor 多过一道，虚拟机里的 I/O 还要多过一道"VM 退出"。A function call is just a jump within the same program. A system call has to go through a door: the CPU switches to kernel mode, saves the program’s registers and jumps to the kernel’s entry point; the kernel checks the arguments, looks up the matching handler in a table, does the job and then switches back to user mode. The system call we measured (getppid, which asks "who is my parent process?") gives the kernel almost nothing to do, so the 123 ns is nearly all the cost of crossing the door. As we’ll see, much of the running overhead of the various isolation methods comes from a request having to cross extra doors: gVisor adds one, and I/O in a virtual machine has to cross yet another, a "VM exit".
    

    

    tcall
    调用一个什么都不做的小函数（不让编译器省掉）一次的平均时间the average time for one call to a small function that does nothing (with the compiler kept from optimising it away)
    

    tsys
    执行一次系统调用 getppid 的平均时间the average time for one getppid system call
    

    

    我们测的：各连做 500 万次取平均，函数调用 1.57 纳秒，系统调用 123 纳秒，比是 78。拿它算一笔账：程序按 4 KiB 一块读文件，读 1 MiB 要 256 次 read，过门一共约 256 × 123 ns ≈ 31 µs；读同样的 1 MiB，从固态硬盘拿数据本身要约 150 µs（按每秒 7 GB 估），所以从硬盘读文件时，这道门不贵。可文件已经在内存的缓存里时（训练的第二轮起常常如此），读 1 MiB 本身也就几十到一百微秒（估），过门的钱就占得不少了。Our measurement: averaging 5 million back-to-back runs of each, a function call took 1.57 ns and a system call 123 ns, a ratio of 78. Now use that to do the sums. If a program reads a file 4 KiB at a time, reading 1 MiB takes 256 calls to read, so crossing the door costs about 256 × 123 ns ≈ 31 µs in all. Getting the same 1 MiB off the SSD takes about 150 µs by itself (estimated at 7 GB per second), so when the file comes from the disk, the door is cheap. But when the file is already cached in memory (often the case from the second epoch of training on), reading 1 MiB itself takes only somewhere between a few tens of microseconds and a hundred (est.), and the cost of crossing the door becomes a sizeable share.
    

    这个数是在一台云上的虚拟机里测的，换一台机器、换一个内核版本都会变，但量级不会变：系统调用是百纳秒级，函数调用是纳秒级。程序越是频繁地敲门（大量的小文件、小网络包），过门的代价占得越多，后面几种"多加一道门"的方法对它影响也越大。This number was measured in a virtual machine in the cloud. It will change on another machine or with another kernel version, but the order of magnitude won’t: system calls are on the scale of a hundred nanoseconds, function calls on the scale of a nanosecond. The more often a program knocks on the door (lots of small files, small network packets), the bigger the share that crossing it takes, and the more it is affected by the later methods that "add one more door".

    先玩：一步一步走一遍。哪几步是在用户态里找东西，哪几步要进内核？最后一步里，容器换掉的是哪几张表，虚拟机呢？Try first: Go through it one step at a time. Which steps look things up in user mode, and which have to go into the kernel? In the last step, which tables does a container replace, and what about a virtual machine?
    

    


    

    


    

    

    

    

    

    


    这一步的要点：一台电脑从下到上是：硬件、固件和引导、内核、系统调用这道门、系统库和发行版、运行时、包、你的程序。每一层都在"按名字找东西"，各种隔离方法就是在某一层换掉这张表：换得越低，能变的越多，代价越大。程序和内核之间只有系统调用一道门，过一次约百纳秒，是普通函数调用的几十倍。The point of this step: From the bottom up, a computer is: hardware, firmware and boot, the kernel, the system-call door, system libraries and distro, runtimes, packages, your program. Every layer is "looking things up by name", and each isolation method replaces that table at some layer: the lower the replacement, the more can change and the higher the cost. Between a program and the kernel there is only one door, the system call. One crossing takes about a hundred nanoseconds, several dozen times as long as an ordinary function call.
    

    

    

    第 ② 步 · 最老的那堵墙Step ② · The oldest wall
    

    进程：每个程序都以为自己独占一台机器Processes: every program thinks it has the machine to itself
    

    所有隔离方法都建在同一个地基上：进程。工作站上此刻同时跑着 A 的训练脚本和 C 的一个 ROS 节点，两个程序都可能用到同一个地址，比如 0x2abc（地址是个编号，前缀 0x 表示十六进制）。可它们读到的是两块不同的内存，谁也碰不到谁。这是怎么做到的？Every isolation method is built on the same foundation: the process. Right now the workstation is running A’s training script and one of C’s ROS nodes at the same time, and both programs may well use the same address, say 0x2abc (an address is just a number; the prefix 0x means hexadecimal). Yet they read two different pieces of memory, and neither can touch the other’s. How is that done?
    

    答案是虚拟内存。程序里用的地址都是"虚拟地址"，CPU 里有一个专门的部件（MMU）在每次访问内存时，把虚拟地址翻成内存条上的"物理地址"。翻译按一张表来：页表。内存按页来管，一页 4 KiB；页表的每一行写着"这个虚拟页放在哪个物理页、能不能写、用户程序能不能碰"。关键在于每个进程一张自己的页表：训练脚本的页表把虚拟页 2 指到物理页 7，ROS 节点的页表把同一个虚拟页 2 指到物理页 9。训练脚本想读 ROS 节点的内存？它连一个能指过去的地址都写不出来。The answer is virtual memory. Every address a program uses is a "virtual address". On every memory access, a dedicated unit in the CPU (the MMU) translates the virtual address into a "physical address" in the actual RAM. The translation follows a table: the page table. Memory is managed in pages of 4 KiB; each row of the page table says "which physical page this virtual page is in, whether it may be written, and whether user programs may touch it". The key is that each process has a page table of its own: the training script’s page table points virtual page 2 at physical page 7, while the ROS node’s page table points the same virtual page 2 at physical page 9. Could the training script read the ROS node’s memory? It cannot even write down an address that points there.
    

    页表本身由内核来填，程序改不了：CPU 分用户态和内核态两种权限，换页表、直接操作设备、关中断这些指令只能在内核态执行，用户态的程序一碰，CPU 就停下它、交给内核处理。内核自己的内存也映射在每个进程的地址空间里，但页表上标着"只有内核态能访问"。要的页不在内存里，或者根本没有这一页，CPU 都报一个"缺页"，交给内核：前一种，内核把页补上再接着跑；后一种，内核给程序发一个信号，就是常见的 Segmentation fault，程序被杀掉。The page tables themselves are filled in by the kernel, and programs cannot change them. The CPU has two privilege levels, user mode and kernel mode: instructions that switch page tables, operate devices directly or turn off interrupts run only in kernel mode, and the moment a program in user mode tries one, the CPU stops it and hands it to the kernel. The kernel’s own memory is also mapped into every process’s address space, but the page table marks it "kernel mode only". If the page needed is not in memory, or there is no such page at all, the CPU raises a "page fault" and hands over to the kernel. In the first case, the kernel brings the page in and the program carries on; in the second, the kernel sends the program a signal, the familiar Segmentation fault, and the program is killed.
    

    真实的地址怎么拆How a real address is split
    

    

    48 = 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 12212 B = 4 KiB29 × 8 B = 4 KiB
    

    

    x86-64 用四级页表时，一个虚拟地址用 48 位：前 36 位分成四段、每段 9 位，是四级页表里各查哪一行；最后 12 位是页里的第几个字节。With four-level page tables, x86-64 uses 48 bits of a virtual address: the first 36 bits form four groups of 9, which say which row to look up at each of the four levels; the last 12 bits say which byte within the page.
    

    为什么分四级？一个进程能用的地址有 247 字节，也就是 128 TiB，按 4 KiB 一页要几百亿行，做成一张大表放不下，而且绝大多数页根本没用到。分成四级以后，每一级的一张表正好一页：512 行，每行 8 字节；没用到的地方整张下级表都不用建。代价是每翻译一个地址，要按顺序读四张表，也就是多读四次内存。所以 CPU 里有个小缓存叫快表（TLB），记着最近翻译过的页，命中了就一次表都不用查。较新的服务器 CPU 还支持五级页表：地址 57 位，每次多查一级；这台工作站的 CPU 用的是四级。Why four levels? A process can use 247 bytes of addresses, that is 128 TiB; at 4 KiB a page, one big table would need tens of billions of rows, far too many to hold, and most of those pages are never used anyway. With four levels, each table at each level fills exactly one page: 512 rows of 8 bytes each, and wherever nothing is used, the whole lower-level table need not be built. The price is that translating one address means reading four tables one after another, which is four extra memory reads. So the CPU has a small cache, the TLB, that remembers recently translated pages; on a hit, not a single table needs to be read. Newer server CPUs also support five-level page tables: 57-bit addresses, with one more level to look up each time; this workstation’s CPU uses four.
    

    

    48, 47
    x86-64 四级页表用的虚拟地址位数；其中低一半（47 位，128 TiB）留给用户程序，高一半给内核The number of virtual-address bits used with x86-64 four-level page tables; the lower half (47 bits, 128 TiB) is kept for user programs, the upper half for the kernel
    

    9
    每级页表的行号用 9 位，29 = 512 行The row number at each level takes 9 bits: 29 = 512 rows
    

    12
    页内的位置用 12 位，212 = 4096 字节 = 一页The position within a page takes 12 bits: 212 = 4096 bytes = one page
    

    8
    页表的一行（一个页表项）占 8 字节：512 × 8 B 正好一页One row of a page table (one page-table entry) takes 8 bytes: 512 × 8 B is exactly one page
    

    

    一个 Python 进程里的地址 0x00007f3a12c45678，拆开是：第四级查第 254 行，第三级第 232 行，第二级第 150 行，第一级第 69 行，页内偏移 0x678。快表没命中时，CPU 要先读这四行，第五次才读到真正的数据。Linux 的文档说用户空间这 128 TiB "每个进程各不相同"（Linux 内核文档）。The address 0x00007f3a12c45678 in a Python process splits into row 254 at level 4, row 232 at level 3, row 150 at level 2, row 69 at level 1, and offset 0x678 within the page. On a TLB miss, the CPU first has to read these four rows, and only the fifth read reaches the actual data. Linux’s documentation describes this 128 TiB of user space as "different per mm", that is, different for every process (Linux kernel docs).
    

    页表是 CPU 硬件在查、内核在填，程序自己碰不到，所以这堵墙很结实。第 ⑤ 步会看到，虚拟机要在这上面再套一层翻译，四次就变成了二十四次。The CPU hardware reads the page tables, the kernel fills them in, and programs cannot touch them, so this wall is solid. Step ⑤ will show that a virtual machine adds another layer of translation on top of this, and the four reads become twenty-four.
    

    

    进程隔开的只是内存。CPU 大家轮流用，可谁用多少没有上限，一个进程开几百个线程，别人就都慢下来（要设上限，得靠第 ⑦ 步的控制组）。同一台机器上的两个进程，下面这些也全都共用：Processes keep only memory apart. Everyone takes turns on the CPU, but there is no limit on how much each one uses: if one process starts a few hundred threads, everyone else slows down (setting limits takes the control groups of step ⑦). Two processes on the same machine also share all of the following:
    

      

    • 文件：两边看到的是同一棵目录树，同一个 /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages（Ubuntu 的系统 Python 放包的地方）。有人用 apt 把里面的 numpy 升了级，所有用系统 Python 的程序下次 import 拿到的都是新的。Files: both see the same directory tree, the same /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages (where Ubuntu’s system Python keeps its packages). If someone upgrades the numpy in there with apt, every program that uses the system Python gets the new one at its next import.
      • 

    • 用户和权限：按"属于哪个用户"来管。同一个用户的两个进程能读写对方的文件；按 Unix 的老规矩，还能用调试器钻进对方的内存（Ubuntu 默认收紧了：只能调试自己启动的子进程）。F 的代码以你的身份运行，就能读 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519。最便宜的一堵墙，是给它单独开一个用户。Users and permissions: these go by "which user it belongs to". Two processes of the same user can read and write each other’s files, and by the old Unix rules one can even poke into the other’s memory with a debugger (Ubuntu tightens this by default: you can only debug child processes you started yourself). F’s code, run as you, can read ~/.ssh/id_ed25519. The cheapest wall is to give it a user of its own.
      • 

    • 网络：端口号全机只有一份，两个程序都想监听 8080，后来的那个会报 Address already in use。Network: there is only one set of port numbers for the whole machine; if two programs both want to listen on 8080, the second one gets Address already in use.
      • 

    • 内核和驱动：只有一个，版本、设置、实时不实时，大家都一样。Kernel and drivers: there is only one, so the version, the settings and whether it is real-time are the same for everyone.
      • 

    

    这四样，正是后面那些方法要一层一层补上的。These four are exactly what the methods that follow patch up, one layer at a time.
    

      

    • 玩具（默认）：16 位的地址，16 页，每页 4 KiB。左右两边是进程 1（训练脚本）和进程 2（ROS 节点）各自的页表，每行写着这一页在不在（P）、用户态能不能碰（U）、放在哪个物理页；中间一列是 16 个物理页，按归谁上色；下面一排是 4 项的快表。Toy (the default): 16-bit addresses, 16 pages of 4 KiB each. On the left and right are the page tables of process 1 (the training script) and process 2 (the ROS node); each row says whether the page is present (P), whether user mode may touch it (U) and which physical page it is in. The middle column is the 16 physical pages, coloured by owner; along the bottom is a 4-entry TLB.
      • 

    • 选 进程 1 或 进程 2，再选一个地址：0x2abc（两个进程都用它）、0x9000（没有这一页）、0xf010（内核的页）；用户态 / 内核态 切换 CPU 的权限。每选一次就从头翻译一遍；▶ 播放 或 下一步：拆地址、查快表、查页表、检查权限、得出物理地址，或者停下来报错。Pick Process 1 or Process 2, then an address: 0x2abc (both processes use it), 0x9000 (no such page) or 0xf010 (a kernel page); User mode / Kernel mode switches the CPU’s privilege level. Every new choice restarts the translation from the beginning; ▶ Play or Next step: split the address, look in the TLB, walk the page table, check the permissions and arrive at the physical address, or stop with a fault.
      • 

    • 真实大小：把 0x00007f3a12c45678 拆成 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 12，一级一级查下去，数着读了几次内存。Real size: splits 0x00007f3a12c45678 into 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 12 and looks it up level by level, counting the memory reads.
      • 

    

    先玩：用两个进程各访问一次 0x2abc：物理地址各是多少？用户态访问 0xf010 会怎样，换成内核态呢？同一个地址连着访问两次，第二次查了几次表？Try first: access 0x2abc once from each process: what physical address does each one get? What happens when user mode accesses 0xf010, and what about kernel mode? Access the same address twice in a row: how many table lookups does the second access take?
    

    


    

    

    

    

    

    



    

    

    

    

    


    这一步的要点：进程是最老、最基本的隔离：每个进程一张自己的页表，CPU 按它翻译每一个地址，内核态才能改页表，所以进程之间看不到彼此的内存。x86-64 的地址拆成 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 12，翻译一次要查四级表，快表命中就不用查。可文件、用户、网络端口、装的包和内核，进程之间全都共用。The point of this step: the process is the oldest and most basic isolation. Each process has a page table of its own, the CPU translates every address through it, and only kernel mode can change page tables, so processes cannot see each other’s memory. An x86-64 address splits into 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 12, and one translation looks up four levels of tables, or none on a TLB hit. But files, users, network ports, installed packages and the kernel are all shared between processes.
    

    

    

    第 ③ 步 · 全景Step ③ · The overview
    

    二十五种方法，放在一张图上Twenty-five methods in one picture
    

    有了"几层"和"每层一张名字表"这两个概念，就能回答第一个问题了：这些方法的共同点是，它们都给程序一份"自己的机器"的样子，让它以为某几层是它独占的。不同点归结为两个问题：With the two ideas of "layers" and "a name table for each layer", we can answer the first question. What these methods have in common is that they all give a program something that looks like "a machine of its own", so that it believes certain layers belong to it alone. The differences come down to two questions:
    

      

    • 切在哪一层？从那一层往上，每个世界各有一份；往下，大家共用一份。venv 只切在"包"上，解释器和下面的一切都共用；容器切在内核上面，系统库各一份，内核共用；虚拟机切在硬件上面，连内核都各有一个，硬件是监控器假装出来的；分开的机器，什么都不共用。Where is the cut? From that layer up, each world has its own copy; below it, everyone shares one. venv cuts only at "packages": the interpreter and everything below it are shared. A container cuts just above the kernel: one copy of the system libraries per world, one shared kernel. A virtual machine cuts just above the hardware: even the kernel is one per world, and the hardware is faked by the hypervisor. Separate machines share nothing at all.
      • 

    • 谁来守这条线？有四种主要的守法。硬件：CPU 自己拒绝，比如页表、虚拟化指令、GPU 的硬件分区、内存加密，最难绕过。内核：内核给每组进程记一份单独的表，每次系统调用都查一遍，比如命名空间、控制组、seccomp、文件权限；墙有多结实，取决于内核有没有漏洞，而 Linux 内核有三百多个系统调用（我们测试机上，Ubuntu 24.04 自带的 6.8 版内核头文件里定义了 373 个），每一个都是一个入口。约定：PATH、sys.path、库的搜索路径、Nix 的哈希路径，靠的是"大家都按这个顺序找"，程序真想去读别的环境的文件，没有任何东西拦着；它防的是不小心混在一起，不防人。轮流：双系统同一时间只开一个，可两个系统都看得见整块硬盘，硬盘不是墙。另有少数靠软件：gVisor 这样的用户态内核和全系统模拟器，用一个程序替内核把每个请求查一遍（第 ⑥ 步）。Who guards the line? There are four main ways. Hardware: the CPU itself refuses, as with page tables, virtualisation instructions, GPU hardware partitions and memory encryption; this is the hardest to get round. Kernel: the kernel keeps a separate table for each group of processes and checks it on every system call, as with namespaces, control groups, seccomp and file permissions; how solid the wall is depends on whether the kernel has bugs, and the Linux kernel has over three hundred system calls (on our test machine, the headers of the 6.8 kernel that ships with Ubuntu 24.04 define 373), each one a way in. Convention: PATH, sys.path, library search paths and Nix’s hash paths rely on "everyone looks in this order"; if a program really wants to read another environment’s files, nothing stops it. It guards against things getting mixed up by accident, not against people. Taking turns: with dual boot only one system runs at a time, but both systems can see the whole disk, so the disk is not a wall. A few rely on software: user-space kernels such as gVisor, and full-system emulators, use a program to check every request on the kernel’s behalf (step ⑥).
      • 

    

    还有几种方法压根不是为了隔离，而是为了翻译：Wine 把 Windows 的调用翻成 Linux 的调用，Rosetta 把 x86 指令翻成 ARM 指令，WSL 1 把 Linux 的系统调用翻成 Windows 内核的操作。它们让"另一个世界的程序"能跑，但不设墙。A few methods are not about isolation at all, but about translation: Wine turns Windows calls into Linux calls, Rosetta turns x86 instructions into ARM instructions, and WSL 1 turns Linux system calls into operations of the Windows kernel. They let "programs from another world" run, but put up no wall.
    

    为什么会有这么多种Why are there so many?
    

    因为它们是为五种不同的需要，在五十多年里一批一批发明出来的：Because they were invented wave after wave over more than fifty years, for five different needs:
    

      

    • 分享一台机器：60 年代的大型机很贵，要分给很多人轮流用，于是有了进程、虚拟内存和最早的虚拟机：IBM 的 CP-40 在 1966 年跑起来，1972 年的 VM/370 让每个用户都有一台"自己的"System/370（Creasy 1981）。1974 年，Popek 和 Goldberg 把"什么样的机器能虚拟化"写成了定理（Popek、Goldberg 1974）。今天的 GPU 分片、云计算的多租户，也是这个需要。Share one machine: mainframes in the 1960s were expensive and had to be shared out among many people taking turns, which gave us processes, virtual memory and the first virtual machines: IBM’s CP-40 was up and running in 1966, and VM/370 in 1972 gave every user a System/370 "of their own" (Creasy 1981). In 1974 Popek and Goldberg turned "which machines can be virtualised" into a theorem (Popek and Goldberg 1974). Today’s GPU slicing and multi-tenant cloud computing come from the same need.
      • 

    • 解依赖冲突：两个程序要同一个库的不同版本。1979 年 Unix 有了 chroot，能让一个程序在一棵单独的目录树里跑，用那里的另一套文件（Linux 基金会 2017）；后来有了在集群上切换软件版本的 Modules（1991，Furlani 1991）、Nix（2004）、virtualenv（2007）、conda（2012）、uv（2024）。Resolve dependency clashes: two programs need different versions of the same library. In 1979 Unix gained chroot, which lets a program run inside a separate directory tree and use the other set of files there (Linux Foundation 2017); later came Modules for switching software versions on clusters (1991, Furlani 1991), Nix (2004), virtualenv (2007), conda (2012) and uv (2024).
      • 

    • 换系统：要跑另一个操作系统、另一个内核、另一种 CPU 的程序。x86 本来不能高效地虚拟化，1999 年 VMware 用二进制翻译做到了（Bugnion 等 2012），2005、2006 年 Intel 和 AMD 把虚拟化做进了 CPU。Wine（1993）、WSL 1、Rosetta 2（2020）是另一条路：不开虚拟机，直接翻译。Another system: running programs for another operating system, another kernel or another kind of CPU. x86 could not originally be virtualised efficiently; in 1999 VMware did it with binary translation (Bugnion et al. 2012), and in 2005 and 2006 Intel and AMD built virtualisation into the CPU. Wine (1993), WSL 1 and Rosetta 2 (2020) take another road: no virtual machine, just direct translation.
      • 

    • 安全：不可信的代码要跑，又不能让它碰到别人。FreeBSD 的 jail（2000）连 root 也关进笼子里，论文的题目就叫"把无所不能的 root 关起来"（Kamp、Watson 2000）；云函数要在同一台机器上跑成千上万个陌生人的代码，于是有了 gVisor 和 Firecracker（2018）。Security: untrusted code has to run without being able to reach anyone else. FreeBSD’s jail (2000) locks up even root, and the paper is titled "Jails: Confining the omnipotent root" (Kamp and Watson 2000); cloud functions have to run code from thousands of strangers on the same machine, which led to gVisor and Firecracker (2018).
      • 

    • 可复现、可搬运："在我电脑上能跑"。2013 年的 Docker 把程序连同它要的整个用户空间打成镜像，在同一种 CPU 的 Linux 机器上，到哪都一样；Kubernetes（2014）把成千上万个容器排到一大群机器上。Reproducible, portable: "it works on my machine". Docker (2013) packs a program, together with the whole user space it needs, into an image that behaves the same wherever it goes, on any Linux machine with the same kind of CPU; Kubernetes (2014) schedules thousands of containers across a whole fleet of machines.
      • 

    

    同一种方法常常服务好几个动机，比如容器既解依赖冲突，又方便搬运，还能挡一部分安全问题。下面这张表先按家族把它们排一排，从切得最高的到切得最低的：One method often serves several motives: containers, for example, resolve dependency clashes, make software easy to move, and also fend off some security problems. The table below first lines them up by family, from the highest cut to the lowest:
    

    

    家族Family例子Examples从哪层开始各一份Own copies start at谁守墙Who guards the wall最早Earliest
    


    基线Baseline普通进程Plain process只有内存各一份Only memory: one copy per world硬件（页表）+ 内核Hardware (page tables) + kernel60 年代1960s
    

    环境Environmentsvenv、uv、conda、pyenv、nvm、Modules（Lmod）venv, uv, conda, pyenv, nvm, Modules (Lmod)包；conda 连解释器和大部分库Packages; for conda, the interpreter and most libraries too约定Convention1991
    

    Nix / Guix/nix/store/哈希-名字/nix/store/hash-name连 glibc 都各一份Even glibc: one copy per world约定（路径不会重名）Convention (paths never clash)2004
    

    沙箱SandboxesFlatpak、Snap、手机应用Flatpak, Snap, phone apps手机应用不复制，只收权限；Flatpak、Snap 还自带一套运行时（连 glibc）Phone apps copy nothing and only take permissions away; Flatpak and Snap also bring their own runtime (glibc included)内核Kernel
    

    容器Containerschroot、jail、LXC、Docker、Podman、Apptainerchroot, jail, LXC, Docker, Podman, Apptainer系统库和发行版System libraries and distro内核Kernel1979
    

    翻译层Translation layersWine、WSL 1、Rosetta 2、qemu-user、gVisorWine, WSL 1, Rosetta 2, qemu-user, gVisor系统调用或指令集被翻译System calls or the instruction set are translated不设墙；gVisor 是用户态内核No wall; gVisor is a user-space kernel1993
    

    虚拟机Virtual machinesKVM、VirtualBox、Hyper-V、Firecracker、WSL 2KVM, VirtualBox, Hyper-V, Firecracker, WSL 2内核；硬件是假装的Kernel; the hardware is faked硬件虚拟化 + 监控器Hardware virtualisation + hypervisor1966
    

    启动Boot双系统、Live USBDual boot, Live USB内核，但轮流用Kernel, but taken in turns轮流Taking turns
    

    硬件Hardware分开的机器、MIG、可信执行环境Separate machines, MIG, trusted execution environments硬件本身或它的一片The hardware itself, or a slice of it硬件Hardware
    

    

    切得越低，能变的越多：环境只能换包和解释器（conda 还能换大部分库），容器能换整个发行版，虚拟机能换内核和操作系统，分开的机器连 CPU 都能换。可代价也一级级往上涨。拿"多久能开始干活"来说：激活一个环境只是改几个环境变量，几乎是 0；开一个普通进程，我们测的是 0.83 毫秒；用 Docker 起一个最小的容器，我们测的约 200 毫秒，可其中建命名空间本身只要约 2.7 毫秒（我们用 unshare 测的），大部分时间花在 Docker 守护进程和运行时的手续上；Firecracker 从启动监控器进程到客户机内核开始跑第一个进程，论文里不到 125 毫秒（Agache 等 2020），这还不算外面的调度和配置；一台装着完整系统的虚拟机要开机，十几秒到几十秒（估）；双系统换一次要重启，一两分钟（估）。所以选法只有一句话：在必须不同的最低一层切开，不要更低。第 ⑮ 步会拿这七个要求一个个试。The lower the cut, the more can change: an environment can only swap the packages and the interpreter (conda can also swap most libraries), a container can swap the whole distro, a virtual machine can swap the kernel and the operating system, and a separate machine can even change the CPU. But the cost climbs level by level too. Take "how soon can it start work": activating an environment only changes a few environment variables, so it is almost 0; starting a plain process took 0.83 ms when we measured it; starting a minimal container with Docker took about 200 ms in our measurement, but creating the namespaces themselves takes only about 2.7 ms (we measured that with unshare), and most of the time goes on the paperwork of the Docker daemon and the runtime; for Firecracker, the paper reports under 125 ms from launching the hypervisor process to the guest kernel starting its first process (Agache et al. 2020), not counting the scheduling and configuration around it; booting a virtual machine with a full system on it takes from ten-odd to several dozen seconds (est.); each switch with dual boot means a reboot, a minute or two (est.). So choosing comes down to one sentence: cut at the lowest layer that has to differ, and no lower. Step ⑮ will try it on the seven requests, one by one.

The default is App containers. Then tap App containers again, switch on Compare, tap gVisor to put it in slot B, and look in "Reading a file": which hop does gVisor add? Then compare the steady overhead in "Costs".
    

    


    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    


    

    

    

    

    


    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    


    这一步的要点：所有方法都给程序一份"自己的机器"的样子。它们的不同只在两件事：切在哪一层（往上各一份，往下共用），谁来守这条线（硬件、内核、约定，或者轮流；少数靠软件）；另有几种只做翻译、不设墙。它们是为分享机器、解依赖、换系统、安全、可复现这五种需要，在五十多年里陆续发明的。切得越低越灵活、墙越结实，也越贵：在必须不同的最低一层切开。The point of this step: every method gives a program something that looks like "a machine of its own". They differ in only two things: where the cut is (one copy per world above it, shared below it) and who guards the line (hardware, the kernel, convention or taking turns; a few rely on software). A few others only translate and put up no wall. They were invented one after another over more than fifty years for five needs: sharing a machine, resolving dependencies, switching systems, security and reproducibility. The lower the cut, the more flexible it is and the more solid the wall, but also the more expensive: cut at the lowest layer that has to differ.
    

    

    

    第 ④ 步 · 启动Step ④ · Booting
    

    双系统：轮流用整台机器Dual boot: taking turns with the whole machine
    

    先看 D：标定工具只有 Windows 版，还要通过 USB 和力传感器说话。最直接的办法，是在硬盘上再装一个 Windows，开机时挑一个：双系统。它切得最低，也最"原生"：开进 Windows，就是一台真正的 Windows 电脑，USB、显卡、所有驱动都是它自己的；开进 Ubuntu 也一样。要理解它，得看开机那几秒发生了什么。Start with D: the calibration tool only exists for Windows, and it also has to talk to the force sensor over USB. The most direct answer is to install Windows on the disk as well and pick one at power-on: dual boot. It cuts the lowest of all, and it is also the most "native": boot into Windows and you have a real Windows PC, with the USB, the graphics card and every driver its own; boot into Ubuntu and the same is true. To understand it, you have to look at what happens in those few seconds after power-on.
    

      

    • 固件：按下电源，主板上的固件（UEFI）先自检，然后去它自己的一小块存储（NVRAM）里看启动项。这台工作站有两项：Boot0001 叫 ubuntu，指向 \EFI\ubuntu\shimx64.efi；Boot0000 叫 Windows Boot Manager，指向 \EFI\Microsoft\Boot\bootmgfw.efi。BootOrder 写着先试 0001。Firmware: when you press the power button, the firmware on the motherboard (UEFI) first runs a self-test, then looks up the boot entries in a small store of its own (NVRAM). This workstation has two: Boot0001, named ubuntu, points to \EFI\ubuntu\shimx64.efi; Boot0000, named Windows Boot Manager, points to \EFI\Microsoft\Boot\bootmgfw.efi. BootOrder says to try 0001 first.
      • 

    • EFI 系统分区：这两个文件都放在硬盘上一个专门的小分区里，格式是 FAT32，叫 EFI 系统分区（ESP）。微软要求它至少 200 MB（4K 扇区的硬盘至少 300 MB）；Windows 还会建一个 16 MB 的保留分区（Microsoft）。硬盘剩下的地方，一块 NTFS 给 Windows，一块 ext4 给 Ubuntu。EFI system partition: both files live in a small dedicated partition on the disk, formatted as FAT32 and called the EFI system partition (ESP). Microsoft requires it to be at least 200 MB (at least 300 MB on disks with 4K sectors); Windows also creates a 16 MB reserved partition (Microsoft). The rest of the disk goes to an NTFS partition for Windows and an ext4 partition for Ubuntu.
      • 

    • 安全启动：如果开着安全启动（Secure Boot），固件只运行签过名的程序。固件里存着微软的证书，所以它先验 shim（微软签的）；shim 里带着 Canonical 的证书，再去验 GRUB 和内核（Canonical 签的），和内核一起读进来的 initrd 却不验；内核再验它要加载的模块。NVIDIA 驱动如果装的是 Ubuntu 预编译好的那种（linux-modules-nvidia-550-…），Canonical 已经替它签了名（Ubuntu）；如果是用 DKMS 在本机自己编译的（比如换了一个自己编的内核），就要用你自己生成、开机时登记进去的密钥（MOK）签名（Ubuntu）。Secure Boot: with Secure Boot on, the firmware runs only signed programs. The firmware holds Microsoft’s certificate, so it first checks shim (signed by Microsoft); shim carries Canonical’s certificate and uses it to check GRUB and the kernel (signed by Canonical), but the initrd, read in along with the kernel, is not checked; the kernel in turn checks the modules it loads. If the NVIDIA driver is the kind Ubuntu ships precompiled (linux-modules-nvidia-550-…), Canonical has already signed it (Ubuntu); if it is compiled on this machine with DKMS (for example because you switched to a kernel you built yourself), it has to be signed with a key that you generate yourself and enrol at boot, a MOK (Ubuntu).
      • 

    • GRUB：出现菜单，选 Ubuntu，它把内核 /boot/vmlinuz-6.8… 和一个临时的小文件系统 initrd 读进内存，交给内核；内核启动 systemd，最后是登录界面。选 Windows，GRUB 就把控制权交给 Windows 自己的引导程序 bootmgfw.efi，后面是 Windows 的事。GRUB: a menu appears. Choose Ubuntu, and GRUB reads the kernel /boot/vmlinuz-6.8… and initrd, a small temporary file system, into memory and hands over to the kernel; the kernel starts systemd, and finally you reach the login screen. Choose Windows, and GRUB hands control to Windows’ own boot loader, bootmgfw.efi; from there on it is up to Windows.
      • 

    

    从这里能看出双系统隔开了什么：从内核往上，两个系统各一套，而且是轮流的，同一时间只有一个在跑，所以没有任何开销，GPU 整块是它的，想装实时内核也行。没隔开的是两样东西：固件（启动项大家共用一份），和硬盘。两个系统都看得见整块硬盘：Ubuntu 能挂载 Windows 的 NTFS 分区，Windows 里的工具也能改写分区表和启动项。这块共用的硬盘，是双系统大部分麻烦的来源（Arch Wiki）：This shows what dual boot keeps apart: from the kernel up there is one copy per system, and the two take turns: only one runs at a time, so there is no overhead at all, the whole GPU belongs to it, and it can have a real-time kernel if you want one. Two things are not kept apart: the firmware (one set of boot entries, shared by both) and the disk. Both systems can see the whole disk: Ubuntu can mount the Windows NTFS partition, and tools in Windows can rewrite the partition table and the boot entries. This shared disk is where most of dual boot’s trouble comes from (Arch Wiki):
    

      

    • 启动顺序被改：Windows 更新或修复以后，可能把自己排到 BootOrder 的第一位，开机直接进 Windows，GRUB 再也不出现。到固件的菜单里或者在 Linux 里用 efibootmgr 改回来就好。Boot order changed: after an update or a repair, Windows may put itself first in BootOrder, so the machine boots straight into Windows and GRUB never appears again. The fix is to change it back in the firmware’s menu, or with efibootmgr in Linux.
      • 

    • 快速启动：Windows 的"快速启动"关机时其实是休眠，NTFS 分区还处在"正在用"的状态。这时在 Ubuntu 里改了上面的文件，Windows 醒来后不知道，数据就可能丢；EFI 系统分区也可能因此损坏。双系统最好关掉快速启动。Fast Startup: with Windows’ "Fast Startup", shutting down is really hibernating, and the NTFS partition is left in an "in use" state. If you then change files on it from Ubuntu, Windows does not know when it wakes up, and data can be lost; the EFI system partition can be damaged this way too. On a dual-boot machine it is best to turn Fast Startup off.
      • 

    • 时钟：主板上有一个硬件时钟。Linux 默认把它当成世界标准时间（UTC），Windows 默认当成本地时间；哪个系统联网对了时，就按自己的理解把它写回去。于是每切一次，开机后的时间就差一个时区，要等它再联网对时才改过来：伦敦夏天差 1 小时，冬天正好不差。对 ROS 这种处处用时间戳的系统，这个要留意。Clock: the motherboard has a hardware clock. By default Linux treats it as UTC and Windows as local time; whichever system syncs the time over the network writes it back according to its own reading. So after every switch, the time after booting is off by the time-zone offset until that system syncs over the network again: in London it is 1 hour out in summer and, as it happens, not out at all in winter. For a system like ROS that uses timestamps everywhere, this is worth watching for.
      • 

    • BitLocker：Windows 的磁盘加密如果把钥匙放在主板的安全芯片（TPM）里，关掉安全启动后，Windows 可能停在 BitLocker 的恢复界面，要你输入恢复密钥。BitLocker: if Windows’ disk encryption keeps its key in the motherboard’s security chip (the TPM), then after you turn Secure Boot off, Windows may stop at the BitLocker recovery screen and ask you to enter the recovery key.
      • 

    

    还有一种只"轮流"、不动硬盘的办法：Live USB。整个系统装在 U 盘里，开机从 U 盘启动，改动只放在内存里，关机就没了。适合试一个新系统，或者救一台起不来的电脑：硬盘上的东西它一点不碰，只在你要的时候读。There is also a way that only "takes turns" and leaves the disk alone: a Live USB. The whole system is installed on a USB stick; you boot from the stick, changes are kept only in memory, and they are gone when you shut down. It is good for trying out a new system, or for rescuing a computer that will not start: it does not touch anything on the disk, and only reads it when you ask it to.
    

    回到 D：双系统能用，标定工具在一台真正的 Windows 上跑，USB 和驱动都是原生的。代价是标定的时候整台工作站都是 Windows，ROS、训练都得停下来，切一次要重启，一两分钟（估）。如果一个月只标定一次，这完全可以接受；如果要天天切，下一步的虚拟机更方便。Back to D: dual boot works. The calibration tool runs on a real Windows machine, with native USB and drivers. The price is that while you calibrate, the whole workstation is a Windows machine, so ROS and training both have to stop, and each switch is a reboot: a minute or two (est.). If you calibrate only once a month, that is perfectly acceptable; if you have to switch every day, the virtual machine in the next step is more convenient.
    

      

    • 上面是主板和硬盘（示意，不按比例）。主板上有固件（UEFI）和它存启动项的 NVRAM（两个启动项和 BootOrder）、安全芯片 TPM、硬件时钟；2 TB 的硬盘按 GPT 分成 EFI 系统分区（300 MB）、16 MB 的保留分区、Windows 的 C 盘、恢复分区和 Ubuntu。每个分区下面列着开机时要读的文件，一个小圆点从一个文件跳到下一个；验过签名的标 ✓，没验的标"–"。旁边"屏幕上"画出这一刻你看到的画面。At the top are the motherboard and the disk (schematic, not to scale). On the motherboard are the firmware (UEFI) and the NVRAM where it keeps the boot entries (two entries and BootOrder), the TPM security chip and the hardware clock; the 2 TB disk is divided by GPT into the EFI system partition (300 MB), a 16 MB reserved partition, the Windows C: drive, a recovery partition and Ubuntu. Under each partition are the files read during boot, and a small dot hops from one file to the next; files whose signature has been checked are marked ✓, those not checked "–". Beside it, "On screen" shows what you would see at that moment.
      • 

    • 选 Ubuntu 或 选 Windows 决定在 GRUB 的菜单里选哪一项；▶ 播放、上一步、下一步、重来 从关着机一步步走到登录界面，点带编号的小格可以直接跳到那一步。Pick Ubuntu or Pick Windows decides which entry is chosen in the GRUB menu; ▶ Play, Back, Next step and Restart go step by step from power-off to the login screen, and tapping a numbered cell jumps straight to that step.
      • 

    • 几个开关：安全启动（开 / 关）；Windows 改了启动顺序；Windows 快速启动没关；时钟（假设上次开的是另一个系统）。每个开关都会改变这次开机的结果。下面写着现在在跑的是谁、换一个系统要多久、两个系统都看得见什么；打开"时钟"，还写出主板时钟里存的时间和屏幕上显示的时间。A few switches: Secure Boot (On / Off); Windows changed the boot order; Windows Fast Startup left on; Clock (assuming the other system ran last). Each one changes how this boot turns out. Underneath, it says what is running now, how long switching systems takes and what both systems can see; with "Clock" on, it also gives the time stored in the motherboard clock and the time shown on screen.
      • 

    

    先玩：先选 Ubuntu 走一遍：一共验了几次签名，各是谁验谁？打开"Windows 改了启动顺序"再开一次机：GRUB 还出现吗？打开"快速启动没关"，再开进 Ubuntu：Windows 的分区还能放心地写吗？关掉安全启动、选 Windows：多出了哪一步？Try first: Pick Ubuntu and go through once: how many signature checks are there in all, and who checks whom each time? Turn on "Windows changed the boot order" and boot again: does GRUB still appear? Turn on "Fast Startup left on" and boot into Ubuntu again: can you still safely write to the Windows partition? Turn Secure Boot off and pick Windows: which extra step appears?
    

    


    

    


    

    

    

    

    

    

    


    这一步的要点：双系统把内核往上的一切都复制了一份，但是轮流用：同一时间只有一个系统在跑，所以原生速度、整块 GPU、内核随你挑。开机时固件按 BootOrder 从 EFI 系统分区里挑一个引导程序，安全启动一级验一级。它没隔开的是固件的启动项和整块硬盘：两个系统都能改对方的分区和启动顺序，快速启动、时钟、BitLocker 是最常见的坑。切一次要重启。The point of this step: Dual boot copies everything from the kernel up, but the copies take turns: only one system runs at a time, so you get native speed, the whole GPU and any kernel you like. At power-on the firmware follows BootOrder to pick a boot loader from the EFI system partition, and with Secure Boot each stage checks the next. What it does not keep apart is the firmware’s boot entries and the whole disk: each system can change the other’s partitions and the boot order, and Fast Startup, the clock and BitLocker are the most common pitfalls. Every switch takes a reboot.
    

    

    

    第 ⑤ 步 · 虚拟机Step ⑤ · Virtual machines
    

    虚拟机：假装出一整台电脑Virtual machines: a whole pretend computer
    

    D 不想每次标定都重启。另一个办法是在 Ubuntu 里开一个窗口，里面跑一台完整的 Windows：虚拟机。1974 年 Popek 和 Goldberg 给它下的定义一直用到今天：虚拟机是"一台真实机器的高效、隔离的复制品"（Popek、Goldberg 1974）。管着虚拟机的程序叫虚拟机监控器，要满足三条：在里面跑的程序看到的环境和真机基本一样（等价）；大部分指令直接在 CPU 上跑，最多慢一点（高效）；所有资源都由监控器说了算（资源可控）。D would rather not reboot for every calibration. Another way is to open a window in Ubuntu with a complete Windows running inside it: a virtual machine. The definition Popek and Goldberg gave in 1974 is still in use today: a virtual machine is "an efficient, isolated duplicate of the real machine" (Popek and Goldberg 1974). The program in charge of the virtual machines is called the hypervisor (virtual machine monitor, VMM), and it must meet three conditions: programs running inside it see essentially the same environment as on the real machine (equivalence); most instructions run directly on the CPU, at worst a little slower (efficiency); and the hypervisor has the final say over all resources (resource control).
    

    "高效"这一条是关键。最笨的办法是用软件一条一条模拟客户机的指令，那样慢得没法用。聪明的办法叫陷入再模拟：客户机里绝大多数指令，加法、读内存、写内存，本来就无害，直接放到真 CPU 上跑；只有少数"敏感"指令会碰到整台机器的状态：换页表、操作设备、关中断、让 CPU 停下来等着。把客户机的内核放在较低的权限里跑，这些指令一执行，CPU 就停下客户机、跳到监控器（陷入）；监控器在"假装的机器"上替它做完，再让客户机接着跑。客户机的内核以为自己在指挥真硬件，其实指挥的是监控器记着的一份状态。The "efficient" condition is the crucial one. The crudest way is to emulate the guest’s instructions in software, one at a time, which is far too slow to use. The clever way is called trap and emulate: the vast majority of the guest’s instructions (additions, memory reads, memory writes) are harmless anyway, so they run directly on the real CPU; only a few "sensitive" instructions touch the state of the whole machine: switching page tables, driving devices, turning interrupts off, halting the CPU to wait. Run the guest’s kernel at a lower privilege level, and the moment one of these instructions executes, the CPU stops the guest and jumps to the hypervisor (a trap); the hypervisor carries it out on the "pretend machine" for the guest, then lets the guest carry on. The guest kernel thinks it is in command of real hardware, but what it commands is a copy of the state kept by the hypervisor.
    

    

    S ⊆ P
    

    

    一台机器能这样虚拟化的条件是：所有敏感指令，都必须是特权指令。For a machine to be virtualised this way, every sensitive instruction must be a privileged instruction.
    

    "特权指令"是在用户态执行就会陷入的指令；"敏感指令"是会读或改整台机器状态的指令。陷入再模拟全靠"敏感的一定会陷入"：只要有一条敏感指令在低权限下不陷入，而是照样执行或者悄悄什么都不做，监控器就不知道客户机做了什么，客户机就会在不知不觉中出错。这就是 Popek 和 Goldberg 的定理 1。A "privileged instruction" is one that traps if executed in user mode; a "sensitive instruction" is one that reads or changes the state of the whole machine. Trap and emulate relies entirely on "anything sensitive is sure to trap": if even one sensitive instruction does not trap at low privilege, but runs anyway or quietly does nothing, the hypervisor does not know what the guest has done, and the guest goes wrong without anyone noticing. This is Popek and Goldberg’s Theorem 1.
    

    

    S
    敏感指令的集合：会读或改整台机器状态（页表、中断开关、设备）的指令the set of sensitive instructions: those that read or change the state of the whole machine (page tables, whether interrupts are enabled, devices)
    

    P
    特权指令的集合：在用户态执行就会陷入的指令the set of privileged instructions: those that trap if executed in user mode
    

    ⊆
    "包含于"：S 里的每一条都在 P 里"is a subset of": every instruction in S is also in P
    

    

    x86 不满足这一条。2000 年有人把奔腾的约 250 条指令逐条查了一遍，发现有 17 条敏感却不陷入（Robin、Irvine 2000）。比如 POPF：在低权限下执行，它要改的中断开关位会被悄悄忽略，也不报错，客户机以为中断关了，其实没关；SGDT 在当年的奔腾上任何权限都能执行，读出全局描述符表（GDT）的真实地址，客户机看到了本不该看到的东西（近几年的 CPU 加了一个开关 UMIP，打开以后它在低权限下也会陷入）。x86 does not meet this condition. In 2000, researchers went through the Pentium’s roughly 250 instructions one by one and found 17 that are sensitive but do not trap (Robin and Irvine 2000). Take POPF: executed at low privilege, its change to the interrupt-enable bit is silently ignored, with no error, so the guest thinks interrupts are off when they are not; SGDT, on the Pentiums of the time, could be executed at any privilege level and read out the real address of the global descriptor table (GDT), so the guest saw something it should never have seen (recent CPUs have added a switch, UMIP, and with it on, SGDT traps at low privilege too).
    

    所以 x86 上的虚拟机在 1999 年以前一直做不好。后来的三种办法，都是在绕过这 17 条。That is why virtual machines on x86 never worked well before 1999. The three approaches that came later all work around these 17.
    

    

    这三种办法先后出现：The three approaches appeared one after another:
    

      

    • 二进制翻译（VMware，1999）：客户机内核的代码在运行前先过一遍"翻译"，把那些麻烦的指令换成安全的几条指令或对监控器的调用，其余的照抄，翻好的代码几乎原速运行（Bugnion 等 2012）。不用改客户机，所以能跑现成的 Windows。Binary translation (VMware, 1999): before the guest kernel’s code runs, it goes through a "translation" pass that swaps the troublesome instructions for a few safe ones or for a call into the hypervisor and copies the rest unchanged; the translated code runs at almost full speed (Bugnion et al. 2012). The guest needs no changes, so it can run off-the-shelf Windows.
      • 

    • 半虚拟化（Xen，2003）：干脆改客户机内核的源代码，让它别用那些指令，有事直接调用监控器（超级调用）。剑桥的团队改 Linux 只动了 2995 行，占 x86 部分代码的 1.36%，一台服务器能跑 100 台虚拟机（Barham 等 2003）。代价是客户机得改，闭源的 Windows 就难办。Paravirtualisation (Xen, 2003): simply change the guest kernel’s source code so that it stops using those instructions and calls the hypervisor directly whenever it needs something (a hypercall). The Cambridge team changed only 2995 lines of Linux, 1.36% of the x86-specific code, and one server could run 100 virtual machines (Barham et al. 2003). The price is that the guest has to be modified, which is hard for closed-source Windows.
      • 

    • 硬件虚拟化（Intel VT-x，2005 年 11 月；AMD-V，2006 年 5 月，Intel 2005、eWeek 2006）：CPU 自己加了一种模式，监控器在"根模式"，客户机在"非根模式"，拿着完整的内核权限；哪些操作要停下来交给监控器（VM 退出），大部分由监控器事先设定，也有几条（比如 cpuid）在 Intel 的 CPU 上总要退出（Intel 手册）。2007 年进入 Linux 2.6.20 的 KVM 就是用它把 Linux 变成了监控器，设备则交给用户态的 QEMU 来模拟（LWN 2016）。Hardware virtualisation (Intel VT-x, November 2005; AMD-V, May 2006, Intel 2005, eWeek 2006): the CPU itself gained a new mode. The hypervisor runs in "root mode" and the guest in "non-root mode", with full kernel privileges; which operations have to stop and be handed to the hypervisor (a VM exit) is mostly set by the hypervisor in advance, though a few (cpuid, for example) always exit on Intel CPUs (Intel manual). KVM, which went into Linux 2.6.20 in 2007, uses it to turn Linux into a hypervisor, leaving device emulation to QEMU in user mode (LWN 2016).
      • 

    

    有意思的是，第一代硬件虚拟化并不比二进制翻译快。VMware 的人在 2006 年测过：3.8 GHz 的奔腾 4 上，进入一次客户机（VM entry）要 2409 个 CPU 周期，一次因缺页引起的 VM 退出要 1931 个周期，而一次普通的系统调用只要 242 个周期；他们的结论是第一代硬件"很少比已有的软件办法占优"（Adams、Agesen 2006）。到了下一代 Core，VM entry 降到 937 个周期。虚拟机的性能，从此就是一场"少退出几次"的仗。Interestingly, the first generation of hardware virtualisation was no faster than binary translation. People at VMware measured it in 2006: on a 3.8 GHz Pentium 4, entering the guest once (a VM entry) took 2409 CPU cycles and a VM exit caused by a page fault took 1931 cycles, while an ordinary system call took only 242 cycles; they concluded that first-generation hardware support "rarely offers performance advantages over existing software techniques" (Adams and Agesen 2006). On the next generation, Core, a VM entry came down to 937 cycles. From then on, virtual machine performance has been a battle for "fewer exits".
    

    

    f ≈ Nexit · texit
    

    

    监控器占掉的时间比例，约等于每秒 VM 退出的次数，乘上每次退出再回去要花的时间。The share of time the hypervisor takes up is roughly the number of VM exits per second multiplied by the time it takes to exit and get back each time.
    

    客户机不退出的时候，就是在真 CPU 上原速运行，没有开销；开销都花在一次次"停下来、交给监控器、再回去"上。所以要么让每次退出更便宜（CPU 一代代在改进），要么让退出更少：后面的嵌套页表让客户机改页表不用退出，virtio 让一批 I/O 只通知一次。While the guest is not exiting, it runs at full speed on the real CPU, with no overhead; all the overhead goes on the repeated "stop, hand over to the hypervisor, go back". So either make each exit cheaper (CPUs have improved generation after generation) or make exits rarer: nested paging, below, lets the guest change its page tables without exiting, and virtio sends a single notification for a whole batch of I/O.
    

    

    f
    一个 CPU 的时间里，花在退出和监控器上的比例the fraction of one CPU’s time spent on exits and in the hypervisor
    

    Nexit
    每秒 VM 退出的次数the number of VM exits per second
    

    texit
    一次退出、处理、再进入客户机的时间the time for one exit, its handling and the re-entry into the guest
    

    

    用 2006 年奔腾 4 的数：一次缺页退出加一次进入，1931 + 2409 = 4340 个周期，3.8 GHz 下约 1.1 µs（这还没算监控器处理它的时间）。没有嵌套页表的时候，客户机每次缺页都要退出；一个大量编译、频繁开进程的客户机，每秒缺页 10 万次，f ≈ 100000 × 1.1 µs ≈ 0.11，一个 CPU 十分之一多的时间耗在退出上。With the 2006 Pentium 4 figures: one page-fault exit plus one entry is 1931 + 2409 = 4340 cycles, about 1.1 µs at 3.8 GHz (not yet counting the time the hypervisor spends handling it). Without nested paging, every page fault in the guest is an exit; a guest that compiles a lot and starts processes all the time takes 100,000 page faults a second, f ≈ 100000 × 1.1 µs ≈ 0.11, and over a tenth of one CPU’s time goes on exits.
    

    同一个客户机，在嵌套页表下这 10 万次缺页一次都不用退出（客户机自己处理）。今天的 CPU 退出也便宜得多，所以平时 CPU 上的开销只有几个百分点；真正贵的是 I/O 那条路，见下面。With nested paging, the same guest takes those 100,000 page faults without a single exit (the guest handles them itself). Exits are also much cheaper on today’s CPUs, so the everyday CPU overhead is only a few per cent; what is really expensive is the I/O path, covered below.
    

    

    内存：要翻译两次Memory: translated twice
    

    客户机的内核以为自己管着"物理内存"，可那其实只是监控器进程手里的一块普通内存。于是每个地址要翻两次：客户机的页表把虚拟地址翻成"客户机物理地址"，监控器再把它翻成真正的"主机物理地址"。早年的做法是影子页表：监控器替每个客户机进程维护一张合二为一的表，CPU 只查这一张；代价是客户机每改一次自己的页表，都得退出让监控器同步。后来 CPU 有了嵌套页表：AMD 从 Barcelona（K10）、Intel 从 Core i7（Nehalem）开始，CPU 自己按顺序查两套表，客户机改页表不用再退出（VirtualBox 手册）。可快表没命中时，要读的次数一下子多了很多：The guest kernel thinks it manages "physical memory", but that is really just an ordinary block of memory held by the hypervisor process. So every address has to be translated twice: the guest’s page tables turn a virtual address into a "guest physical address", and the hypervisor then turns that into the real "host physical address". The early approach was shadow page tables: for each guest process the hypervisor keeps a single table that combines the two, and the CPU looks only at that one; the price is that every time the guest changes its own page tables, it has to exit so that the hypervisor can bring the combined table in line. Later, CPUs gained nested paging: starting with AMD’s Barcelona (K10) and Intel’s Core i7 (Nehalem), the CPU itself walks the two sets of tables one after the other, and the guest no longer has to exit to change its page tables (VirtualBox manual). But on a TLB miss, the number of reads shoots up:
    

    

    R = (n + 1)(m + 1) − 1n = m = 4: R = 24
    

    

    客户机的页表有 n 级、主机的有 m 级，快表没命中时，一次地址翻译最多要读 (n + 1)(m + 1) − 1 次内存。If the guest’s page tables have n levels and the host’s have m, then on a TLB miss one address translation needs up to (n + 1)(m + 1) − 1 memory reads.
    

    客户机页表的每一级本身也放在"客户机物理地址"上，读它之前，先得用主机的 m 级页表把它的地址翻译一遍（读 m 次），再读这一项（1 次）：n 级一共 n(m + 1) 次。走完客户机的 n 级，得到的是数据的客户机物理地址，还得再用主机页表翻一遍，再加 m 次。合起来 n(m + 1) + m = (n + 1)(m + 1) − 1。Each level of the guest’s page tables itself sits at a "guest physical address", so before it can be read, its address must first be translated through the host’s m-level page tables (m reads), and then the entry itself is read (1 read): n(m + 1) reads for all n levels. Walking the guest’s n levels gives the guest physical address of the data, which must be translated through the host page tables once more: m more reads. Altogether n(m + 1) + m = (n + 1)(m + 1) − 1.
    

    

    n, m
    客户机和主机页表的级数；x86-64 一般都是 4the number of levels in the guest’s and the host’s page tables; on x86-64 both are usually 4
    

    R
    快表没命中时，翻译一个地址最多要读几次内存（不算最后读数据那一次）the most memory reads needed to translate one address on a TLB miss (not counting the final read of the data itself)
    

    

    n = m = 4：(4 + 1)(4 + 1) − 1 = 24，而原生只要 4 次，正好和研究者的说法一致："最多 24 次，原生最多只要 4 次"（Gandhi 等 2014，硬件做法见 Bhargava 等 2008）。客户机和主机都用 2 MiB 的大页，各少一级：n = m = 3，R = 15。五级页表：n = m = 5，R = 35。n = m = 4: (4 + 1)(4 + 1) − 1 = 24, where native needs only 4, which is exactly what the researchers say: "up to 24 memory references", against "up to only 4" natively (Gandhi et al. 2014; for the hardware approach, see Bhargava et al. 2008). If guest and host both use 2 MiB large pages, each loses a level: n = m = 3, R = 15. With five-level page tables: n = m = 5, R = 35.
    

    这 24 次只在快表没命中时发生，大部分访问一次都不用查。所以给虚拟机配大页、让快表多命中，是常见的调优手段。These 24 reads happen only on a TLB miss; most accesses need no lookup at all. That is why giving a virtual machine large pages, so that the TLB hits more often, is a common way to tune it.
    

    

    设备：从模拟到直通Devices: from emulation to passthrough
    

    客户机的磁盘和网卡也是假装的，有三种做法。模拟：监控器假装成一块常见的真实网卡，客户机用现成的驱动，每读写一次网卡的寄存器就退出一次，慢。virtio：客户机知道自己在虚拟机里，装一个专门的驱动，把请求放进和监控器共享的队列里，攒一批才通知一次；当年 Linux 至少支持 8 种虚拟化系统，各有一套自己的磁盘和网卡驱动，virtio 把它们统一了起来（Russell 2008）。直通：把一个真实的设备（一块 GPU、一个 USB 控制器）整个交给一台虚拟机，客户机用它自己的驱动直接操作；CPU 里的 IOMMU（Intel 叫 VT-d，AMD 叫 AMD-Vi）保证这个设备只能读写这台虚拟机的内存（Linux 内核文档）。D 的标定工具用不着整块直通：VirtualBox 或 QEMU 能把力传感器这一个 USB 设备转交给 Windows 虚拟机。主机的内核照样管着 USB 控制器，监控器在软件里把这个设备的 USB 请求转过去，不经过 IOMMU；Windows 装自己的设备驱动，用起来和真机上一样，只是每个请求多绕一道，对时序要求很严的设备可能不稳（QEMU 文档）。只有把整个 USB 控制器（一个 PCI 设备）交出去，才用得上 IOMMU。The guest’s disk and network card are pretend too, and there are three ways to provide them. Emulation: the hypervisor pretends to be a common real network card and the guest uses an existing driver; every read or write of the card’s registers is an exit, which is slow. virtio: the guest knows it is in a virtual machine and installs a dedicated driver, which puts requests into a queue shared with the hypervisor and sends one notification only once a batch has built up; back then Linux supported at least 8 virtualisation systems, each with its own set of disk and network drivers, and virtio unified them (Russell 2008). Passthrough: a whole real device (a GPU, a USB controller) is handed to one virtual machine, and the guest drives it directly with its own driver; the IOMMU in the CPU (which Intel calls VT-d and AMD calls AMD-Vi) makes sure the device can read and write only that virtual machine’s memory (Linux kernel docs). D’s calibration tool does not need a whole device passed through: VirtualBox or QEMU can hand just the one USB device, the force sensor, over to the Windows virtual machine. The host kernel still runs the USB controller, and the hypervisor forwards this device’s USB requests in software, without the IOMMU; Windows installs its own driver for the device and uses it just as on a real machine, except that every request takes an extra detour, so a device with strict timing may be unreliable (QEMU docs). Only when the whole USB controller (a PCI device) is handed over does the IOMMU come into play.
    

    监控器本身也分两种。1 型直接装在硬件上，下面没有别的系统：ESXi、Xen、Hyper-V。2 型是装在一个普通操作系统上的程序：VirtualBox、VMware Workstation、Parallels、UTM。KVM 介于两者之间：它是 Linux 内核的一个模块，装上以后 Linux 自己就成了监控器。Hypervisors themselves come in two types. Type 1 is installed directly on the hardware, with no other system underneath: ESXi, Xen, Hyper-V. Type 2 is a program installed on an ordinary operating system: VirtualBox, VMware Workstation, Parallels, UTM. KVM sits in between: it is a module of the Linux kernel, and once it is loaded, Linux itself becomes the hypervisor.
    

    换来什么，付出什么What you gain, what you pay
    

    虚拟机换来的是：同一种 CPU 上的什么系统都能跑（Windows、别的版本的 Linux、别的内核；换一种 CPU 就得靠第 ⑥ 步的模拟）；墙很结实，客户机要逃出来，得攻破监控器；还有一样容器给不了的：整台机器就是一堆数据（内存加磁盘镜像），可以快照、复制，甚至在不停机的情况下从一台主机搬到另一台：2005 年剑桥的团队做到了停顿最短只有 60 毫秒（Clark 等 2005）。云计算就建在这上面：你租的云服务器，本身就是别人机器上的一台虚拟机。What a virtual machine gives you: any system for the same kind of CPU will run (Windows, other versions of Linux, other kernels; a different kind of CPU needs the emulation of step ⑥); the wall is solid: to escape, the guest has to break through the hypervisor; and something containers cannot give you: the whole machine is just a pile of data (memory plus a disk image), so it can be snapshotted, copied, and even moved from one host to another without being stopped: in 2005 a team at Cambridge got the pause down to as little as 60 milliseconds (Clark et al. 2005). Cloud computing is built on this: the cloud server you rent is itself a virtual machine on someone else’s machine.
    

    付出的是：开机，客户机要完整地启动一遍，十几秒到几十秒（估）；内存，给客户机的那份内存基本上就被占住了，监控器本身也要占内存，Firecracker 的论文里测得 QEMU 每台约 131 MB（Agache 等 2020）；磁盘，一整个系统的镜像，几十 GB；I/O，IBM 的研究者拿同一台机器比过：调好的 KVM 算 Linpack 只比原生慢 2%（没调的慢 17%），可随机读写的次数只有原生的一半左右，网络每次往返多出约 30 µs，MySQL 慢了 40% 以上；同样的测试里，Docker 大多和原生差不多，但用它默认的 NAT 网络时，每次往返的延迟翻了一倍，MySQL 的数据放在镜像层里也明显变慢，放进卷里才接近原生（Felter 等 2014）。还有两样对机器人团队要紧：GPU 要么整块直通给一台虚拟机（主机就用不了了），要么买专门的 vGPU；实时性差，客户机随时可能被监控器暂停，1 kHz 的控制回路不适合放在普通虚拟机里。What you pay: booting, as the guest has to start up in full, which takes ten-odd to several dozen seconds (est.); memory, as the memory given to the guest is more or less tied up, and the hypervisor itself needs memory too: the Firecracker paper measured QEMU at about 131 MB per VM (Agache et al. 2020); disk, for an image of a whole system, tens of GB; I/O, where IBM researchers comparing them on the same machine found that tuned KVM ran Linpack only 2% slower than native (17% untuned), but managed only about half the native number of random reads and writes, added about 30 µs to every network round trip and made MySQL over 40% slower; in the same tests Docker was mostly about as fast as native, but with its default NAT networking the latency of each round trip doubled, and MySQL was also clearly slower with its data in the image layers, getting close to native only once the data went into a volume (Felter et al. 2014). Two more matter to a robot team: the GPU must either be passed through whole to one virtual machine (and then the host cannot use it) or you buy a dedicated vGPU; and real-time behaviour is poor: the hypervisor can pause the guest at any moment, so a 1 kHz control loop does not belong in an ordinary virtual machine.
    

    同一个词，两种东西。"虚拟机"还有另一个意思：Java 虚拟机（JVM）、Python 的字节码解释器、浏览器里的 WebAssembly。它们虚拟的不是整台电脑，而是一套指令，只给一个程序用：程序被编译成这套虚拟的指令，由一个普通的进程解释或翻译着执行。研究者把前者叫"系统虚拟机"，后者叫"进程虚拟机"（Smith、Nair 2005）。这一篇说的虚拟机都是前者。One word, two things. "Virtual machine" has a second meaning: the Java virtual machine (JVM), Python’s bytecode interpreter, WebAssembly in the browser. What they virtualise is not a whole computer but a set of instructions, for one program only: the program is compiled into these virtual instructions, and an ordinary process interprets or translates them as it runs. Researchers call the first kind "system virtual machines" and the second "process virtual machines" (Smith and Nair 2005). All the virtual machines on this page are the first kind.
    

      

    • 敏感指令那个交互：左边是客户机内核的 9 条指令（读内存、加法、cli、mov cr3、popf、sgdt、out、cpuid、hlt），右边是 CPU 和监控器两个方框。The sensitive instructions widget: on the left, 9 instructions from the guest kernel (a memory read, an addition, cli, mov cr3, popf, sgdt, out, cpuid, hlt); on the right, two boxes, the CPU and the VMM.
      • 

    • 五种做法（按钮）：理想机器（1974）、x86 直接跑（1999 年以前）、二进制翻译（VMware 1999）、半虚拟化（Xen 2003）、硬件虚拟化（VT-x 2005 / AMD-V 2006）。▶ 播放、下一步、上一步、重来：每条指令要么直接跑到 CPU，要么陷入（或 VM 退出）到监控器再回来，要么标红"悄悄失败"。下面数着每种结果各有几条（直接跑、陷入或退出、悄悄失败……）。硬件虚拟化下多一个开关 嵌套页表：默认是 没有（最早的 VT-x / AMD-V），这时换页表也要退出；换成 有（AMD 2007、Intel 2008 以后），换页表就不用退出了。旁边写出 2006 年测的退出代价。Five approaches (buttons): Ideal machine (1974), x86 run directly (before 1999), Binary translation (VMware 1999), Paravirtualisation (Xen 2003), Hardware virtualisation (VT-x 2005 / AMD-V 2006). ▶ Play, Next step, Back, Restart: each instruction either runs straight on the CPU, or traps to the VMM (or makes a VM exit) and comes back, or is marked in red "fails silently". Underneath, a count shows how many instructions end each way (run directly, traps or exits, silent errors …). Under hardware virtualisation there is one more switch, Nested paging: the default is Off (the first VT-x / AMD-V), where switching page tables also causes an exit; change it to On (AMD 2007, Intel 2008 onwards) and switching page tables no longer exits. Beside it are the exit costs measured in 2006.
