    先玩：在"x86 直接跑"下走一遍：哪两条指令出了错，错在哪？换成"硬件虚拟化"：这 9 条里还有几条要退出？把"嵌套页表"打开，又少了哪一条？到格子图里数一数嵌套页表的 24 次，再切到"大页"和"影子页表"：省下的是什么，代价换到了哪里？Try first: Go through once under "x86 run directly": which two instructions go wrong, and how? Switch to "Hardware virtualisation": how many of the 9 still exit? Turn "Nested paging" on: which one no longer does? In the grid, count the 24 reads under nested paging, then switch to "2 MiB pages" and "Shadow page tables": what is saved, and where has the cost gone?
    

    


    

    

    


      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      


      


      

      


      

      

      

      

      


      这一步的要点：虚拟机让客户机的指令直接在真 CPU 上跑，只在敏感操作时陷入监控器，由它在一份假装的机器状态上替客户机完成。这要求敏感指令都会陷入（S ⊆ P），x86 有 17 条例外，于是先后有了二进制翻译、半虚拟化和硬件虚拟化。开销来自 VM 退出（f ≈ Nexit · texit）和两层地址翻译（快表没命中时最多 24 次读内存）；设备从模拟到 virtio 再到直通。虚拟机能跑同一种 CPU 上的任何系统、墙结实、能快照和迁移，代价是开机慢、占内存和磁盘、I/O 有损失、GPU 和实时性麻烦。The point of this step: A virtual machine lets the guest’s instructions run directly on the real CPU and traps to the hypervisor only for sensitive operations, which the hypervisor carries out for the guest on a pretend copy of the machine state. This needs every sensitive instruction to trap (S ⊆ P); x86 has 17 exceptions, which led in turn to binary translation, paravirtualisation and hardware virtualisation. The overhead comes from VM exits (f ≈ Nexit · texit) and from the two-stage address translation (up to 24 memory reads on a TLB miss); devices went from emulation to virtio to passthrough. A virtual machine can run any system for the same kind of CPU, its wall is solid, and it can be snapshotted and migrated; the price is slow booting, memory and disk taken up, some loss on I/O, and trouble with the GPU and real-time behaviour.
      

      

      

      第 ⑥ 步 · 更轻的虚拟机，和几种翻译层Step ⑥ · Lighter VMs, and a few translation layers
      

      微虚拟机、gVisor、WSL、Wine、RosettaMicroVMs, gVisor, WSL, Wine and Rosetta
      

      再看 F：比赛收上来的几百份代码，或者 AI 助手写的代码，要一份份跑一遍。直接跑太危险；放进普通容器（第 ⑦ 步）快，可所有容器共用主机的内核，内核有一个漏洞，代码就可能逃出来；放进完整的虚拟机墙够结实，可每份都要开机十几秒到几十秒、占几百 MB 内存（估）。亚马逊做云函数（Lambda）时就卡在这里，他们在论文里说，容器在"安全"和"兼容"之间有一个根本的取舍，而他们哪个都不想放弃（Agache 等 2020）。于是有了两条路：把虚拟机做轻，或者在容器和内核之间再垫一层。Now back to F: several hundred submissions collected from a competition, or code written by an AI assistant, all have to be run one by one. Running them directly is too dangerous. An ordinary container (step ⑦) is fast, but all containers share the host’s kernel: one bug in that kernel and the code may get out. A full VM has a sturdy enough wall, but each one needs ten-odd to several tens of seconds to boot and several hundred MB of memory (est.). This is exactly where Amazon got stuck when it built its cloud functions (Lambda). In their paper they say that containers involve a fundamental trade-off between "security" and "compatibility", and they did not want to give up either (Agache et al. 2020). That left two roads: make the VM lighter, or add another layer between the container and the kernel.
      

      把虚拟机做轻：微虚拟机Making the VM lighter: microVMs
      

      Firecracker 是一个只为跑 Linux 客户机而写的监控器。普通的 QEMU 能模拟几十种设备，有 140 多万行代码；Firecracker 只留了网卡、磁盘、串口和半个键盘控制器，没有 PCI 总线，没有显卡，约 5 万行 Rust（这是 2020 年论文里的样子；后来又加了几种 virtio 设备，2025 年起还能选择改用 PCI 来接它们，但这只是换一种接法，并不能直通真实的设备，Firecracker）。设备少，开机就快：从启动监控器进程到客户机内核启动第一个进程，不到 125 毫秒；监控器本身每台约占 3 MB 内存（同样测法下 QEMU 约 131 MB）；一台主机每秒能开 150 台。它从 2018 年起在 Lambda 上跑，也用在 Fargate 上。它还把自己关进一个"监狱"：换根目录、单独的进程号和网络命名空间、去掉权限、只许用 24 个系统调用和 30 种设备控制命令，万一监控器有漏洞，也逃不远。代价是 I/O（论文里测的）：它的磁盘一次只处理一个请求，4 kB 的随机读每秒约 1.3 万次，而同一台主机直接读能超过 34 万次；网络约 15 Gb/s，主机约 44 Gb/s（Agache 等 2020）。Firecracker is a hypervisor written only to run Linux guests. Ordinary QEMU can emulate several dozen kinds of device and has over 1.4 million lines of code; Firecracker keeps only a network card, a disk, a serial port and half a keyboard controller, with no PCI bus and no graphics card, in about 50,000 lines of Rust (that is how it looked in the 2020 paper; a few more virtio devices have been added since, and from 2025 they can optionally be attached over PCI instead, but that is only a different way of connecting them and does not let real devices be passed through, Firecracker). With so few devices it boots fast: from starting the hypervisor process to the guest kernel starting its first process takes under 125 milliseconds; the hypervisor itself uses about 3 MB of memory per VM (QEMU, measured the same way, about 131 MB); and one host can start 150 of them a second. It has been used in Lambda since 2018, and in Fargate too. It also locks itself in a "jail": a new root directory, its own process-ID and network namespaces, dropped privileges, and only 24 system calls and 30 device-control commands allowed, so even if the hypervisor has a bug, an escape won’t get far. The price is I/O (measured in the paper): its disk handles one request at a time, managing about 13,000 random 4 kB reads a second, while the same host reading directly manages over 340,000; networking reaches about 15 Gb/s, against about 44 Gb/s on the host (Agache et al. 2020).
      

      Kata Containers（2017 年底）把这个思路包成了容器的样子：用法和 Docker 一样，可每个容器（在 Kubernetes 里是每个 pod）其实跑在一台自己的轻量虚拟机里（Kata 设计文档），有自己的内核，监控器可以选 QEMU、Cloud Hypervisor 或 Firecracker。它的口号是"容器的速度，虚拟机的安全"（Kata Containers）。Kata Containers (late 2017) wraps this idea up to look like containers: you use it just like Docker, but each container (in Kubernetes, each pod) actually runs in a lightweight VM of its own (Kata design docs), with its own kernel, and the hypervisor can be QEMU, Cloud Hypervisor or Firecracker. Its slogan is "The speed of containers, the security of VMs" (Kata Containers).
      

      在容器和内核之间垫一层：gVisorAdding a layer between container and kernel: gVisor
      

      谷歌 2018 年开源的 gVisor 走了另一条路：不开虚拟机，而是用 Go 从头写了一个"内核"，叫 Sentry，作为一个普通进程跑在用户态。程序的系统调用不再直达主机内核，而是被截下来交给 Sentry 处理；Sentry 自己只在必要时、用很少的几种系统调用去找主机内核要东西，沙箱里办不了的请求，交给旁边一个更受信任的小进程（Gofer）（gVisor 文档）。攻击者要逃出来，得先攻破 Sentry（用内存安全的 Go 写的），再攻破主机内核。谷歌自己说，它像一个"极端半虚拟化的操作系统"，固定开销比完整的虚拟机低，代价是每次系统调用更贵，也不是所有系统调用都支持：开源时实现了约 200 个（Lacasse 2018）。所以它适合 F 这种"计算多、系统调用少"的代码；一个不停地读写小文件的程序，在 gVisor 里会明显变慢。gVisor, which Google open-sourced in 2018, took the other road: no VM, but a "kernel" written from scratch in Go, called the Sentry, that runs as an ordinary process in user mode. A program’s system calls no longer go straight to the host kernel; they are intercepted and handed to the Sentry. The Sentry itself turns to the host kernel only when it must, with a very small set of system calls, and requests the sandbox cannot handle go to a small, more trusted process beside it, the Gofer (gVisor docs). To escape, an attacker must first break the Sentry (written in memory-safe Go) and then the host kernel. Google itself says it is like an "extremely paravirtualized operating system", with a lower fixed overhead than a full VM; the price is that each system call costs more, and not every system call is supported: about 200 were implemented when it was open-sourced (Lacasse 2018). So it suits code like F’s, with "lots of computing and few system calls"; a program that keeps reading and writing small files will slow down noticeably in gVisor.
      

      不为隔离，为了翻译Not for isolation, but for translation
      

      还有几种方法常被和虚拟机放在一起说，目的都是"兼容"：让另一个世界的程序在这里跑起来，但不设墙。WSL 1、Wine、Rosetta 和 qemu-user 是翻译层；WSL 2 和 QEMU 的全系统模拟虽然是整台虚拟或模拟的机器，目的也一样。A few more methods are often talked about alongside VMs, and what they all aim for is "compatibility": getting programs from another world to run here, without putting up a wall. WSL 1, Wine, Rosetta and qemu-user are translation layers; WSL 2 and QEMU’s full-system emulation are whole virtual or emulated machines, but the aim is the same.
      

        

      • WSL 1 和 WSL 2：Windows 上跑 Linux 程序。WSL 1 没有 Linux 内核，在 Windows 内核里装了一个翻译层，把 Linux 的系统调用翻成 Windows 内核的操作，所以总有些系统调用对不上。WSL 2（2019 年宣布）改成在一台很轻的 Hyper-V 虚拟机里跑一个真正的 Linux 内核，系统调用 100% 兼容（Microsoft）；解压一个压缩包比 WSL 1 快到 20 倍，git clone、npm install 快 2 到 5 倍（Microsoft 2019）。代价是跨系统的文件变慢了：在 Linux 里读 Windows 那边 /mnt/c 上的文件，要过一道虚拟机的边界，所以项目文件最好放在 Linux 这边。WSL 1 and WSL 2: Linux programs on Windows. WSL 1 has no Linux kernel: it adds a translation layer to the Windows kernel that turns Linux system calls into Windows kernel operations, so there are always some system calls that don’t match up. WSL 2 (announced in 2019) switched to running a real Linux kernel in a very light Hyper-V VM, with 100% system-call compatibility (Microsoft); unpacking an archive is up to 20 times faster than in WSL 1, and git clone and npm install are 2 to 5 times faster (Microsoft 2019). The price is slower access to files across the two systems: reading a Windows-side file on /mnt/c from Linux means crossing a VM boundary, so project files are best kept on the Linux side.
        • 

      • Wine（1993 年开始）：在 Linux 上直接跑 Windows 的 .exe。它没有 Windows 内核，也不开虚拟机，而是把 Windows 的 API 重新实现了一遍，程序一调用就翻成 Linux 的调用；名字就是"Wine 不是模拟器"的缩写（WineHQ）。很多软件和游戏能这样跑，但需要自己的内核驱动的软件多半不行：D 的标定工具要靠 Windows 的 USB 驱动和传感器说话，Wine 里没有 Windows 内核可以装驱动。Wine (started in 1993): runs Windows .exe files directly on Linux. It has no Windows kernel and starts no VM; instead it reimplements the Windows API, and each call a program makes is translated into Linux calls on the spot. The name is short for "Wine Is Not an Emulator" (WineHQ). Many programs and games run this way, but software that needs its own kernel driver mostly does not: D’s calibration tool relies on a Windows USB driver to talk to the sensor, and Wine has no Windows kernel to install a driver into.
        • 

      • Rosetta 2（2020 年）：苹果换成自己的 ARM 芯片以后，旧的 x86 程序由它翻译成 ARM 指令再跑，整个进程一起翻，连运行时才生成的代码也能翻；翻不了的是内核扩展、虚拟 x86 整机的程序和 AVX-512 指令（Apple）。苹果已经说了，通用的 Rosetta 只提供到 macOS 27。Rosetta 2 (2020): since Apple switched to its own ARM chips, Rosetta has been translating old x86 programs into ARM instructions so that they can run. It translates the whole process together, even code that is generated only at run time; what it cannot translate is kernel extensions, programs that virtualise a whole x86 machine, and AVX-512 instructions (Apple). Apple has already said that general-purpose Rosetta will only be offered up to macOS 27.
        • 

      • QEMU（2005 年的论文）：有两种用法。全系统模拟：在软件里模拟另一种 CPU 的一整台机器，连客户机的内核也是被翻译着跑。用户态模拟：只翻译一个程序的指令，它的系统调用由 QEMU 换成本机的系统调用，再交给本机内核（Bellard 2005）。G 要给 Thor 构建 ARM64 的镜像，在 x86 的工作站上用 docker buildx 就会悄悄用上后一种；Docker 的文档提醒，这样"可能比原生构建慢得多，编译这类重活尤其如此"，能在 ARM 机器上原生构建或者交叉编译就更好（Docker 文档）。QEMU (the 2005 paper): it can be used in two ways. Full-system emulation: a whole machine with a different CPU is emulated in software, and even the guest’s kernel runs translated. User-mode emulation: only one program’s instructions are translated, and QEMU turns its system calls into the host’s own system calls before passing them to the host kernel (Bellard 2005). When G builds ARM64 images for Thor with docker buildx on the x86 workstation, it quietly ends up using the second kind. Docker’s docs warn that this "can be much slower than native builds, especially for compute-heavy tasks like compilation"; building natively on an ARM machine, or cross-compiling, is better where you can (Docker docs).
        • 

      

        

      • 上面一排按钮选一种跑法：原生、容器、gVisor、微虚拟机（Firecracker）、WSL 2（Linux 文件）、WSL 2（/mnt/c 上的文件）、WSL 1、Wine、qemu-user（x86 上跑 ARM64 程序）。The row of buttons at the top picks how the program runs: Native, Container, gVisor, microVM (Firecracker), WSL 2 (Linux files), WSL 2 (files on /mnt/c), WSL 1, Wine and qemu-user (ARM64 program on x86).
        • 

      • 中间从上到下画出一次读文件要经过的每一站：程序、库、翻译或拦截的那一层、内核（客户机的或主机的）、监控器、主机内核、硬盘；虚线框圈出容器、沙箱、虚拟机或被翻译的代码。▶ 播放、上一步、下一步、重来：一个圆点沿左边走下去，数据沿右边回来。读数写着"到这一步为止 / 整趟"：过了几次用户态和内核态的门、几次 VM 退出、几次翻译；只数这次请求自己穿过的门，下去一次、回来一次。The middle draws, from top to bottom, every stop a single file read passes through: the program, the libraries, the layer that translates or intercepts, the kernel (the guest’s or the host’s), the hypervisor, the host kernel and the disk; dashed boxes mark out the container, sandbox, VM or translated code. ▶ Play, Back, Next step, Restart: a dot goes down the left side and the data comes back up the right. The readouts say "so far / whole round trip": how many times the door between user mode and kernel mode was crossed, how many VM exits and how many translations; only the doors this request itself passes through are counted, once on the way down and once on the way back.
        • 

      • 还有一项"要攻破的墙"：这种跑法下，恶意代码要逃出来得突破几道墙；只为兼容的几种写着"不是边界"。有数的地方写出了代价：一次系统调用约 120 ns（我们测的），一次 VM 退出加进入约 1.1 µs（2006 年的硬件）。One more readout is "Walls to break": how many walls malicious code run this way would have to break through to get out; the methods that are only about compatibility say "not a boundary". Where there are figures, the costs are given: about 120 ns per system call (our measurement), and about 1.1 µs for a VM exit plus entry (2006 hardware).
        • 

      

      先玩：把 容器、gVisor、微虚拟机 三种依次走一遍：读同一个文件，各多了哪几站？要逃出来，各得攻破几道墙？再看 WSL 2 的两种：为什么读 /mnt/c 上的文件要慢？Try first: walk through Container, gVisor and microVM one after another. Reading the same file, which extra stops does each one add? And how many walls must be broken to escape from each? Then look at the two WSL 2 options: why is reading a file on /mnt/c slower?
      

      


      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      


      这一步的要点：微虚拟机（Firecracker）把监控器砍到只剩几种设备，开机不到 125 毫秒、每台只多约 3 MB，墙和虚拟机一样，代价是 I/O 慢、不能直通 GPU；Kata 把它包成容器的样子。gVisor 不开虚拟机，用一个用户态的内核接住所有系统调用，墙多了一层，系统调用变贵。WSL 1、Wine、Rosetta 和 qemu-user 是翻译层，WSL 2 和 QEMU 的全系统模拟是为兼容而开的虚拟机：它们让别的系统或别的 CPU 的程序跑起来，都不是安全边界。The point of this step: A microVM (Firecracker) trims the hypervisor down to a handful of devices: it boots in under 125 milliseconds and adds only about 3 MB per VM, and its wall is the same as a VM’s; the price is slow I/O and no GPU passthrough. Kata wraps it up to look like a container. gVisor starts no VM: a user-space kernel catches every system call, which adds one more wall and makes system calls more expensive. WSL 1, Wine, Rosetta and qemu-user are translation layers, and WSL 2 and QEMU’s full-system emulation are VMs run for compatibility: they let programs from other systems or other CPUs run here, and none of them is a security boundary.
      

      

      

      第 ⑦ 步 · 容器Step ⑦ · Containers
      

      容器：同一个内核，各看各的Containers: one kernel, each sees its own
      

      C 要的其实不多：ROS 2 Humble 的程序是照着 Ubuntu 22.04 的系统库编译的（glibc 2.35 和一大堆 apt 包），它要的是 22.04 的"用户空间"，并不要 22.04 的内核。而 Linux 对用户程序有一条铁律：系统调用这道门"非常稳定，不会被破坏"，十几年前编译的程序在新内核上照样能跑（Linux 内核文档）。所以没必要像虚拟机那样连内核都复制，只要在内核上面切开：系统库和发行版各一份，内核共用。这就是容器。C doesn’t actually ask for much. ROS 2 Humble’s programs were compiled against Ubuntu 22.04’s system libraries (glibc 2.35 and a big pile of apt packages), so what they need is 22.04’s "user space", not 22.04’s kernel. And Linux has an iron rule for user programs: the system-call door is "very stable, and will not break", so a program compiled over a decade ago still runs on a new kernel (Linux kernel docs). So there is no need to copy the kernel as well, the way a virtual machine does. It is enough to cut just above the kernel: one copy per world of the system libraries and the distribution, with the kernel shared. That is a container.
      

      它不是一下子发明出来的。1979 年的 chroot 让一个进程把某个目录当成根目录 /，可它只换了文件树：进程、网络、用户都还共用，root 还能逃出来。2000 年 FreeBSD 的 jail 把进程、网络地址和 root 的权力也关了进去（Kamp、Watson 2000），2004 年 Solaris 有了 Zones（Price、Tucker 2004）。Linux 则是一块一块攒起来的：2002 年先有了挂载命名空间，之后十几年陆续加了主机名、进程间通信、进程号、网络、用户（2013 年的 3.8 版才完成）等几种（Kerrisk 2013）；2008 年初的 2.6.24 版加入了控制组（Corbet 2007）。2013 年 Docker 把这些零件和"镜像"（下一步）包成了一条命令，一开始还借用 LXC，2014 年换成了自己直接调内核的库（Docker 2014），2015 年，运行容器的格式和 runc 交给了一个开放的组织 OCI，第二年镜像的格式也交了过去（OCI）。所以"容器"不是内核里的一个东西，而是三样东西拼起来的：命名空间、控制组、权限的削减。It wasn’t invented in one go. In 1979, chroot let a process treat a given directory as the root directory /, but it swapped only the file tree: processes, the network and users were all still shared, and root could still break out. In 2000, FreeBSD’s jail confined processes, network addresses and root’s powers as well (Kamp and Watson 2000), and in 2004 Solaris got Zones (Price and Tucker 2004). Linux, by contrast, built it up piece by piece. The mount namespace came first, in 2002, and over the next decade and more others were added one by one: hostname, inter-process communication, process ID, network, user (complete only in version 3.8, in 2013) and a few more (Kerrisk 2013); version 2.6.24, in early 2008, added control groups (Corbet 2007). In 2013, Docker wrapped these parts, together with "images" (the next step), into a single command. At first it borrowed LXC; in 2014 it switched to its own library that calls the kernel directly (Docker 2014). In 2015, the format for running containers, along with runc, was handed over to an open organisation, the OCI, and the image format followed the next year (OCI). So a "container" is not one thing in the kernel but three things put together: namespaces, control groups and cut-down privileges.
      

      命名空间：每组进程一份自己的名字表Namespaces: each group of processes gets its own name tables
      

      第 ① 步说过，内核里有很多"名字 → 东西"的表。命名空间就是让一组进程用自己的那份。Linux 现在有八种（namespaces(7)）：As step ① showed, the kernel holds many "name → thing" tables. A namespace simply lets a group of processes use its own copy of one. Linux now has eight kinds (namespaces(7)):
      

      

      命名空间Namespace各一份的是What gets its own copy容器里看到的What the container sees
      


      挂载（mount）Mount挂载表：哪个目录是哪个文件系统The mount table: which directory is which file system镜像里的 22.04 当根目录The image’s 22.04 as the root directory
      

      进程号（PID）Process ID (PID)进程编号Process numbers自己的第一个进程是 1 号，看不到别的进程Its first process is number 1; it can’t see any other processes
      

      网络（network）Network网卡、IP 地址、端口、路由表Network interfaces, IP addresses, ports, routing table自己的 eth0，8080 端口随便用Its own eth0, and port 8080 is free to use
      

      主机名（UTS）Hostname (UTS)主机名The hostname容器的编号，比如 d0d4cabe519eThe container’s ID, such as d0d4cabe519e
      

      进程间通信（IPC）Inter-process communication (IPC)System V 的共享内存、消息队列System V shared memory and message queues碰不到主机上的Can’t touch the host’s
      

      用户（user）User用户号的对照表The user-ID mapping table开了它，里面的 root 在外面只是个普通用户（Docker 默认不开，Podman 的无根模式会开）With it on, root inside is just an ordinary user outside (off by default in Docker; Podman’s rootless mode turns it on)
      

      控制组（cgroup）Control group (cgroup)控制组树的根The root of the control-group tree只看得见自己那一枝Sees only its own branch
      

      时间（time）Time开机时间、单调时钟的偏移Offsets of the boot-time and monotonic clocks可以有自己的"开机多久了"（Docker 默认也不开）Can have its own "time since boot" (also off by default in Docker)
      

      

      我们在一台测试机上做了个实验：一个很小的静态程序，打印自己的进程号、主机名，再数一数根目录下有几项。直接在主机上跑，打出 pid=771、hostname=vm，根目录下 28 项（程序用 readdir 数的，连 . 和 .. 在内）；装进一个只有它自己的镜像、用 Docker 跑，同一个程序打出 pid=1、hostname=d0d4cabe519e，根目录下 8 项。程序一个字节都没变，变的是内核给它看的那几张表。We ran an experiment on a test machine: a tiny static program that prints its own process ID and hostname, then counts the entries in the root directory. Run directly on the host, it printed pid=771, hostname=vm and 28 entries in the root directory (the program counts with readdir, including . and ..); packed into an image containing nothing but itself and run with Docker, the same program printed pid=1, hostname=d0d4cabe519e and 8 entries. Not one byte of the program changed; what changed were the few tables the kernel showed it.
      

      控制组：每组进程一份资源上限Control groups: each group of processes gets its own resource limits
      

      命名空间管"看得见什么"，控制组管"能用多少"：一组进程最多用几个 CPU、多少内存、多少磁盘带宽、最多开多少个进程（Linux 内核文档）。Namespaces decide "what can be seen"; control groups decide "how much can be used": how many CPUs a group of processes may use at most, how much memory, how much disk bandwidth, and how many processes it may start (Linux kernel docs).
      

      

      c = Q / T
      

      

      一组进程能用的 CPU 个数，等于每个周期里给它的 CPU 时间，除以周期的长度。The number of CPUs a group of processes can use is the CPU time it is given in each period, divided by the length of the period.
      

      内核按周期记账：在每个长度为 T 的周期里，这组进程的所有线程加起来，最多在 CPU 上跑 Q 这么久；用完了就停下来，等下一个周期。Q 是 T 的一半，平均下来就只能用半个 CPU；Q 是 T 的两倍，就能同时用满两个 CPU。内存的上限更直接：用到 memory.max 时，内核先回收这组进程的文件缓存（允许的话也换到交换区）；回收不出来，OOM 杀手就在这组进程里挑一个杀掉。The kernel keeps the books period by period: in each period of length T, all the threads in the group together may run on CPUs for at most Q; once that is used up, they stop and wait for the next period. If Q is half of T, the group gets only half a CPU on average; if Q is twice T, it can keep two CPUs fully busy at the same time. The memory limit is more direct: when the group reaches memory.max, the kernel first reclaims the group’s page cache (and, if allowed, moves memory out to swap); if it can’t reclaim enough, the OOM killer picks one process in the group and kills it.
      

      

      Q
      配额：每个周期里这组进程最多用多少 CPU 时间（微秒）Quota: the most CPU time the group may use in each period (µs)
      

      T
      周期（微秒），默认 100000，也就是 0.1 秒Period (µs), default 100000, i.e. 0.1 s
      

      c
      折合几个 CPUThe equivalent number of CPUs
      

      

      docker run --cpus 0.5 写进控制组的是 cpu.max = "50000 100000"：Q = 50000，T = 100000，c = 0.5。我们测的：一段只用 CPU 的循环，不限制时 1.17 秒，限成 0.5 个 CPU 后 2.27 秒，用时是不限制时的 1.94 倍，接近 2 倍。内存：--memory 128m --memory-swap 128m（不许用交换区）下，一个每次多要 16 MiB 的程序打印到"allocated 112 MiB"，下一次就被杀了，退出码 137（128 + 9，9 是 SIGKILL 这个信号的编号）。docker run --cpus 0.5 writes cpu.max = "50000 100000" into the control group: Q = 50000, T = 100000, c = 0.5. Our measurement: a CPU-only loop took 1.17 s with no limit and 2.27 s when limited to 0.5 CPUs, 1.94 times as long, close to 2. Memory: under --memory 128m --memory-swap 128m (no swap allowed), a program that asks for 16 MiB more each time printed up to "allocated 112 MiB" and was killed on the next request, with exit code 137 (128 + 9; 9 is the number of the SIGKILL signal).
      

      这只是平均：在一个周期的前半段，它可能已经把 50 毫秒用完，后半段一直在等。对 E 这种每毫秒都要准时的控制回路，这种"用完就停"的限法会造成卡顿，实时任务要用别的办法（第 ⑮ 步）。我们那台测试机用的还是旧版控制组，文件名不同，意思一样。This is only an average: the group may use up its 50 ms in the first half of a period and then spend the whole second half waiting. For a control loop like E, which has to be on time every millisecond, this "use it up, then stop" kind of limit causes stalls; real-time tasks need a different approach (step ⑮). Our test machine still ran the old version of control groups: the file names differ, but the meaning is the same.
      

      

      削减权限：能力、系统调用过滤、用户命名空间Cutting privileges: capabilities, system-call filtering, user namespaces
      

      容器里的 root 不该是真的 root。Linux 把 root 的权力拆成了 41 种"能力"（改系统时间、加载内核模块、挂载文件系统、改网络配置……），Docker 默认只给容器留其中 14 种（我们测的）。再加一层 seccomp 过滤：Docker 默认的规则在三百多个系统调用里"禁掉了约 44 个"，比如改系统时钟的 clock_settime（日期时间不分命名空间：上面那个时间命名空间只能挪开机时间和单调时钟，改了日期就是改整台机器的）、操作内核密钥环的 add_key（它也不分命名空间）、往内核里装程序的 bpf（Docker 文档）。用户命名空间能让容器里的 root 在外面只是个普通用户，可 Docker 默认不开它：我们测的默认容器里，用户号的对照表是"0 0 4294967295"，容器里的 root 就是主机的 root，只是被拿掉了大部分能力、套上了 seccomp。我们又用一个编号 30033 的普通用户开了一个用户命名空间，里面 id 显示 uid=0(root)，对照表写着"0 30033 1"，可在 /etc 下建一个文件，照样"Permission denied"。Root inside a container shouldn’t be real root. Linux splits root’s powers into 41 "capabilities" (setting the system time, loading kernel modules, mounting file systems, changing network settings…), and by default Docker leaves a container only 14 of them (our measurement). On top of that comes a layer of seccomp filtering: of the 300-plus system calls, Docker’s default profile "disables around 44", for example clock_settime, which sets the system clock (the date and time are not namespaced: the time namespace above can only shift the boot-time and monotonic clocks, so changing the date changes it for the whole machine); add_key, which works on the kernel keyring (also not namespaced); and bpf, which loads programs into the kernel (Docker docs). A user namespace can make root in the container an ordinary user outside, but Docker doesn’t turn it on by default: in the default container we tested, the user-ID mapping table was "0 0 4294967295", so root in the container is the host’s root, just with most of its capabilities taken away and seccomp on top. We then had an ordinary user, ID 30033, open a user namespace: inside, id showed uid=0(root) and the mapping table read "0 30033 1", yet creating a file under /etc still gave "Permission denied".
      

      容器没隔开的，就是这个方法本身的边界：内核是共用的。在 22.04 的容器里敲 uname -r，打出来的是主机的 6.8。所以容器换不了内核：E 要的实时内核只能装在主机上；GPU 的内核驱动也只能在主机上（第 ⑬ 步）；Windows 的内核和驱动更进不来，D 那种要靠 Windows USB 驱动的工具只能用虚拟机（普通的 .exe 倒是能在容器里用 Wine 翻译着跑，第 ⑥ 步）。安全上，容器的墙和内核一样结实：三百多个系统调用，每一个都是一个入口，内核哪一处有漏洞，就可能被利用来逃出去。还有一件常被忽略的事：Docker 的守护进程以 root 运行，能让它启动容器的人，就能启动一个把主机根目录挂进来的容器、随意改主机上的文件，Docker 自己的文档说"只有可信的用户才能控制 Docker 守护进程"（Docker 文档）。把同事加进 docker 组，差不多等于给了他 root。What a container doesn’t separate marks the limit of the method itself: the kernel is shared. Type uname -r in a 22.04 container and it prints the host’s 6.8. So a container can’t change the kernel: the real-time kernel that E needs can only be installed on the host; the GPU’s kernel driver also has to be on the host (step ⑬); and a Windows kernel and drivers can’t get in at all, so a tool like D, which relies on a Windows USB driver, needs a virtual machine (an ordinary .exe, though, can run in a container with Wine translating; step ⑥). For security, a container’s wall is only as strong as the kernel: each of the 300-plus system calls is a way in, and a bug anywhere in the kernel may be exploited to break out. One more thing is often overlooked: the Docker daemon runs as root, so anyone who can get it to start containers can start one with the host’s root directory mounted inside and change any file on the host. Docker’s own docs say "only trusted users should be allowed to control your Docker daemon" (Docker docs). Adding a colleague to the docker group is close to giving them root.
      

      回到 C：docker run -it ros:humble，就在 24.04 的工作站上得到了一个 22.04 的 ROS 2 Humble 环境，镜像压缩后约 252 MB（Docker Hub）；Thor 上的 JetPack 7 也是 24.04，同样的办法也能用。Back to C: docker run -it ros:humble gives you a 22.04 ROS 2 Humble environment on the 24.04 workstation, from an image of about 252 MB compressed (Docker Hub); JetPack 7 on the Thor is also 24.04, so the same approach works there too.
      

        

      • 左边是主机看到的样子：systemd、sshd、桌面、A 的训练脚本（主机上的 PID 4127），还有一个从 ros:humble 起来的容器。右边是容器里的进程看到的样子。On the left is what the host sees: systemd, sshd, the desktop, A’s training script (PID 4127 on the host) and a container started from ros:humble. On the right is what the processes inside the container see.

Turn a switch off, run the command again and see what changes. The two small terminals below show the output of the little program we measured, inside and outside the container.

      先玩：关掉 PID 命名空间再 ps -e：容器里多看到了谁？关掉挂载命名空间，os-release 变成了哪个版本？不管怎么开关，uname -r 变过吗？把内存上限调到 256 MiB，程序打印到多少被杀？Try first: turn off the PID namespace and run ps -e: who else can the container see now? Turn off the mount namespace: which version does os-release show? However you set the switches, does uname -r ever change? Set the memory limit to 256 MiB: what is the last amount the program prints before it is killed?
      

      


      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      


      

      

      

      

      


      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      


      这一步的要点：容器在内核上面切开：系统库和发行版各一份，内核共用。它由三样东西拼成：命名空间给每组进程一份自己的名字表（挂载、进程号、网络、主机名、用户……），控制组给每组进程一份资源上限（c = Q / T 个 CPU，内存到了上限又回收不出来就被杀），能力和 seccomp 削减 root 的权力。所以它启动快（约 200 毫秒）、几乎没有运行开销；但内核、驱动、实时性都只能用主机的，墙有多结实取决于内核。The point of this step: a container cuts above the kernel: one copy per world of the system libraries and the distribution, with the kernel shared. It is built from three things: namespaces give each group of processes its own name tables (mounts, process IDs, network, hostname, users…), control groups give each group of processes its own resource limits (c = Q / T CPUs; at the memory limit, if nothing more can be reclaimed, a process is killed), and capabilities and seccomp cut down root’s powers. So it starts fast (about 200 ms) and has almost no running overhead; but the kernel, the drivers and real-time behaviour can only come from the host, and how strong the wall is depends on the kernel.
      

      

      

      第 ⑧ 步 · 镜像Step ⑧ · Images
      

      镜像：一层层叠起来的文件系统Images: a file system stacked in layers
      

      容器还缺一样东西：它自己的根目录。C 的容器要一整套 22.04 的系统文件加上 ROS；A 的训练容器要 CUDA 和 PyTorch，NVIDIA 官方带 cuDNN 的 CUDA 12.4 运行时镜像压缩后就有 1.99 GB（Docker Hub）。要是每开一个容器都把这些复制一遍，又慢又占地方。办法是把文件系统做成一层层叠起来的。A container is still missing one thing: its own root directory. C’s container needs a whole set of 22.04 system files plus ROS; A’s training container needs CUDA and PyTorch, and NVIDIA’s official CUDA 12.4 runtime image with cuDNN is already 1.99 GB compressed (Docker Hub). Copying all of that for every container you start would be slow and would eat up disk space. The way round it is to build the file system as a stack of layers.
      

      Linux 3.18（2014 年底）收进了 OverlayFS（Phoronix 2014）。它把几层目录叠在一起，给出一个"合起来"的视图：下面几层只读，最上面一层可写（Linux 内核文档）。规则只有四条：Linux 3.18 (late 2014) added OverlayFS (Phoronix 2014). It stacks several directories on top of each other and presents a "merged" view: the lower layers are read-only and the top one is writable (Linux kernel docs). There are just four rules:
      

        

      • 读：从上往下找，哪一层先有这个文件，就用哪一层的。下面的层不用复制，十个容器读的是磁盘上同一份文件。Read: search from the top down and use the file from the first layer that has it. Nothing in the lower layers is copied: ten containers read the same file on disk.
        • 

      • 第一次改：要改一个只在下面某层里的文件，先把整个文件复制到最上面那层（copy-up），再改。First edit: to change a file that exists only in a lower layer, first copy the whole file up into the top layer (copy-up), then change it.
        • 

      • 删：下面的层是只读的，删不掉；于是在最上面一层放一个"删除标记"（一个设备号为 0/0 的特殊文件），把下面那个挡住。Delete: the lower layers are read-only, so the file cannot be deleted from them; instead a "whiteout" (a special file with device number 0/0) is put in the top layer to hide the one below.
        • 

      • 新建：直接写在最上面一层。Create: written straight into the top layer.
        • 

      

      第二条有个后果，我们测了一下：做一个镜像，里面放一个 200 MB 的文件，在容器里往它末尾追加 1 个字节，第一次用了 353 毫秒，因为整个 200 MB 先被复制了上来；第二次、第三次都只要 0.01 毫秒上下。新建一个小文件 0.1 毫秒。所以别在容器里改镜像里的大文件：数据集、日志、数据库，都应该放在挂进来的目录（卷）里。IBM 的测试里，MySQL 的数据放在容器的分层文件系统里明显变慢，放在卷里就好得多（Felter 等 2015）。The second rule has a consequence, and we measured it: we made an image holding a 200 MB file and, inside a container, appended 1 byte to the end of it. The first time took 353 ms, because the whole 200 MB was copied up first; the second and third times took only about 0.01 ms. Creating a new small file took 0.1 ms. So don’t modify big files from the image inside a container: datasets, logs and databases all belong in a directory mounted in from outside (a volume). In IBM’s tests, MySQL was clearly slower with its data on the container’s layered file system, and much better with it on a volume (Felter et al. 2015).
      

      镜像是一叠有名字的层An image is a stack of named layers
      

      一个镜像就是这样一叠只读的层，加上一点说明（从哪个程序启动、环境变量是什么）。每一层是一个打包的目录差异，名字不是随便起的，而是用它的内容算出来的 SHA-256 摘要，这种格式后来成了开放标准（OCI）。An image is just such a stack of read-only layers, plus a few settings (which program to start, what the environment variables are). Each layer is a packed-up directory diff, and its name is not arbitrary: it is the SHA-256 digest computed from its contents. This format later became an open standard (OCI).
      

      

      d = h(x)D = Σdistinct si
      

      

      一层的名字，是它全部内容的哈希；一台机器上所有镜像占的磁盘，是所有不同的层的大小加起来，重复的层只算一次。A layer’s name is the hash of its entire contents; the disk space taken by all the images on a machine is the sum of the sizes of all the distinct layers, with a repeated layer counted only once.
      

      哈希函数把任意长的内容变成一串固定长度的"指纹"：内容差一个字节，指纹就完全不同；内容一样，指纹一定一样。用指纹当名字，有三个好处：两个镜像用了同一个底层，只存一份、只下载一次；下载下来的东西对不对，算一遍哈希就知道；一个名字永远对应同一份内容，不会被悄悄换掉。A hash function turns content of any length into a fixed-length "fingerprint": if the content differs by a single byte, the fingerprint is completely different; if the content is the same, the fingerprint is always the same. Using the fingerprint as the name has three benefits: when two images use the same base layer, it is stored once and downloaded once; you can tell whether a download is correct by computing its hash once; and a name always stands for the same content, which cannot be quietly swapped.
      

      

      x
      这一层打包以后的全部字节all the bytes of this layer, once packed up
      

      h(·)
      哈希函数，这里是 SHA-256，输出 256 位，写成 64 个十六进制字符the hash function, here SHA-256: its output is 256 bits, written as 64 hexadecimal characters
      

      d
      一层的摘要，写成 sha256:bbbcace2…a layer’s digest, written as sha256:bbbcace2…
      

      D, si
      所有镜像占的磁盘；第 i 层的大小the disk space taken by all the images; the size of layer i
      

      

      我们做的实验：镜像 hello:1 只有一层，摘要 sha256:bbbcace29482…；在它上面再叠两层（一个 200 MB 的文件和一个小程序），做成 big:1，big:1 最底下那一层的摘要还是 sha256:bbbcace29482…，磁盘上只存一份。同一个 ros:humble 起十个容器：只读的层只下载一份、只存一份（下载的压缩包约 252 MB，解开存在硬盘上要大两三倍，估），再加十个很薄的可写层，而不是十份完整的拷贝。Our experiment: the image hello:1 has only one layer, with digest sha256:bbbcace29482…; stacking two more layers on top of it (a 200 MB file and a small program) makes big:1, and the bottom layer of big:1 still has the digest sha256:bbbcace29482…, so it is stored only once on disk. Start ten containers from the same ros:humble and you get one download and one stored copy of the read-only layers (the compressed download is about 252 MB; unpacked on disk it is two to three times larger, est.), plus ten very thin writable layers, not ten complete copies.
      

      注意镜像的"标签"和"摘要"不是一回事。ros:humble 是一个会动的名字，维护者每推一次更新，它就指向新的内容；ros@sha256:… 才钉死了一份内容：@ 后面是镜像清单的摘要，清单里列着每一层的摘要，钉住它就钉住了每一层。G 要复现，就要记下摘要，而不只是标签。Note that an image’s "tag" and its "digest" are not the same thing. ros:humble is a name that moves: every time the maintainers push an update, it points to new content. Only ros@sha256:… pins the content down: what follows the @ is the digest of the image manifest, and the manifest lists the digest of every layer, so pinning it pins every layer. For G to be reproducible, you have to record the digest, not just the tag.
      

      

      镜像通常用一个 Dockerfile 来做：FROM 之后，每个 RUN、COPY（或 ADD）指令生成一层，别的指令（ENV、CMD……）只改说明。改了某一行，这一行和它后面各行的层（叠在上面的）都要重做，前面各行的层直接从缓存里拿。所以 Dockerfile 的顺序有讲究：最少变的写在最前面（基础镜像、apt 装的系统包，它们是最底下的层），其次是 Python 的依赖，最常改的代码写在最后。这样改一行代码，重做的只是最上面那薄薄的一层，推到仓库、拉到机器人上，也只传这一层。Images are usually built with a Dockerfile: after FROM, every RUN and COPY (or ADD) instruction produces a layer, while the other instructions (ENV, CMD …) only change the settings. Change a line, and the layers of that line and of every line after it (the ones stacked above) have to be rebuilt, while the layers of the lines before it come straight from the cache. So the order in a Dockerfile matters: what changes least goes first (the base image and the system packages installed with apt, which form the bottom layers), then the Python dependencies, and the code, which changes most often, goes last. That way a one-line code change rebuilds only the thin top layer, and pushing to the registry and pulling onto the robot also transfers just that one layer.
      

      同一个标签还可以同时指向几种 CPU 的版本：ubuntu:24.04 有 x86-64 的（压缩后 28.39 MB）和 ARM64 的（27.6 MB）（Docker Hub），在哪台机器上拉，就自动拉哪个。G 往 Thor 上部署，团队的镜像也得同时做一个 ARM64 的版本，否则在 Thor 上一运行，就是第 0 步里那句 Exec format error。One tag can also point to versions for several kinds of CPU at once: ubuntu:24.04 comes in x86-64 (28.39 MB compressed) and ARM64 (27.6 MB) (Docker Hub), and whichever machine you pull on automatically gets its own version. When G deploys to Thor, the team’s image must also be built in an ARM64 version; otherwise, the moment it runs on Thor, you get the Exec format error from step 0.
      

        

      • 叠层：左边是团队的镜像 grasp:1 的几层，从下往上：ubuntu 22.04 的底层（L1）、ROS 的包（L2，ros:humble 在底层上加的 18 层画成一层）、团队的代码（L3，里面有一个 200 MB 的 big.bin），最上面是容器的可写层 U（一开始是空的）；查找从上往下，一层一层标出有没有。右边是合起来以后看到的文件，下面一行是等价的 mount 命令。按钮：读 setup.bash、改 /etc/bash.bashrc、往 200 MB 的 big.bin 末尾加 1 个字节、删掉 big.bin、新建 /tmp/log.txt；▶ 播放、上一步（撤销上一下）、下一步、重来。每一下都标出文件是在哪一层找到的、复制上来多少、花了多久（我们测的那几个数）。Layers: on the left are the layers of the team’s image grasp:1, from the bottom up: the ubuntu 22.04 base layer (L1), the ROS packages (L2: the 18 layers ros:humble adds on top of the base, drawn as one), the team’s code (L3, which holds a 200 MB big.bin), and on top the container’s writable layer U (empty at first). The lookup runs from the top down, marking layer by layer whether the file is there. On the right are the files you see once the layers are merged, and the line below is the equivalent mount command. Buttons: Read setup.bash, Edit /etc/bash.bashrc, Append 1 byte to the 200 MB big.bin, Delete big.bin, Create /tmp/log.txt; ▶ Play, Back (undoes the last action), Next step, Restart. Each press shows which layer the file was found in, how much was copied up and how long it took (the figures we measured).
        • 

      • 镜像和层：两组例子。团队的三个镜像（ros:humble-ros-base、grasp:1、robot:1）共用底下的 19 层；我们测的 hello:1 和 big:1 共用摘要相同的一层。下面挑一个镜像，滑块 容器个数 从 1 到 20，比较"叠层"和"每个容器一份完整拷贝"各占多少磁盘（都按压缩后的大小算，解开会更大）。Images and layers: two sets of examples. The team’s three images (ros:humble-ros-base, grasp:1, robot:1) share the 19 layers at the bottom; our test images hello:1 and big:1 share one layer with the same digest.       这一步的要点：容器的根目录是一叠只读的层加一层可写的：读的时候从上往下找，第一次改就把整个文件复制上来（我们测的 200 MB 用了 353 毫秒），删除用一个标记挡住。每一层按内容的 SHA-256 命名，相同的层只存一份、只传一次；标签会动，摘要不会。Dockerfile 把常变的放在最后，改代码就只重做最上面一层。The point of this step: A container’s root directory is a stack of read-only layers plus one writable layer: reads search from the top down, the first edit copies the whole file up (353 ms for our 200 MB file), and deleting covers the file with a marker. Each layer is named by the SHA-256 of its contents, so identical layers are stored once and transferred once; tags move, digests don’t. A Dockerfile puts what changes often last, so a code change rebuilds only the top layer.
      

      

      

      第 ⑨ 步 · 容器一家子Step ⑨ · The container family
      

      同样的零件，五种用法The same parts, five ways to use them
      

      命名空间、控制组、分层镜像是同一套零件，可不同的工具拿它们去做不同的事：有的为了部署服务，有的为了在集群上跑作业，有的只是想在自己的桌面上用另一个发行版的软件。它们隔得多严，差别很大。Namespaces, control groups and layered images are one set of parts, but different tools use them for different jobs: some to deploy services, some to run jobs on a cluster, and some simply to use another distro’s software on your own desktop. How strictly they isolate varies a great deal.
      

        

      • Docker：你敲的 docker 命令只是个客户端，真正干活的是一个以 root 运行的守护进程 dockerd，它再交给 containerd 和 runc 去创建容器。好处是生态最大，镜像仓库里什么都有；麻烦是那个 root 守护进程（第 ⑦ 步）。在 Mac 和 Windows 上，Docker Desktop 其实先开了一台 Linux 虚拟机，所有 Linux 容器都跑在这台虚拟机里：Mac 上用苹果的虚拟化框架，Windows 上放在 WSL 2 里（Docker 2021）。因为容器要的是一个 Linux 内核，没有它，容器无处安身。授权也要留意：Docker Desktop 对员工少于 250 人并且年收入少于 1000 万美元的公司、个人、教育和非商业的开源项目免费，大公司要付费；Docker Engine 这些开源部分的条款不变（Docker 文档）。Docker: the docker command you type is only a client. The real work is done by a daemon, dockerd, which runs as root and hands the job on to containerd and runc to create the container. The upside is the biggest ecosystem: the registries have everything. The catch is that root daemon (step ⑦). On Mac and Windows, Docker Desktop actually starts a Linux virtual machine first, and every Linux container runs inside that VM: on a Mac it uses Apple’s virtualisation framework, on Windows it sits in WSL 2 (Docker 2021). That is because a container needs a Linux kernel; without one, it has nowhere to live. Mind the licence too: Docker Desktop is free for companies with fewer than 250 employees and less than $10 million in annual revenue, for individuals, for education and for non-commercial open-source projects; larger companies have to pay. The terms for the open-source parts, such as Docker Engine, are unchanged (Docker docs).
        • 

      • Podman（1.0 版发布于 2019 年 1 月）：没有守护进程，命令直接创建容器；大多数命令用普通用户就能跑（靠用户命名空间），命令行和 Docker 兼容（Podman 2019）。没有那个 root 守护进程，墙就少了一个大窟窿。Podman (version 1.0 came out in January 2019): there is no daemon; the command creates the container itself. Most commands work as an ordinary user (thanks to user namespaces), and the command line is compatible with Docker’s (Podman 2019). Without that root daemon, the wall has one big hole fewer.
        • 

      • 系统容器（LXC / Incus、systemd-nspawn）：不只跑一个程序，而是跑一整套系统，有自己的 init、服务和用户，用起来像一台轻量的虚拟机，只是没有自己的内核。想要一台长期开着的"Ubuntu 22.04 小机器"，它比 Docker 顺手。System containers (LXC / Incus, systemd-nspawn): instead of a single program, they run a whole system, with its own init, services and users. In use it feels like a lightweight virtual machine, except that it has no kernel of its own. If you want a "little Ubuntu 22.04 machine" that stays running long-term, it is handier than Docker.
        • 

      • Apptainer（原名 Singularity，2017 年的论文；2021 年加入 Linux 基金会时改名）：为超算集群做的。集群不能给每个人 root，也不能装 Docker 的 root 守护进程，于是镜像做成一个 .sif 文件，用你自己的身份运行，容器里也不能提权（Kurtzer 等 2017、Apptainer 2021）。它为方便而设计：默认就把你的家目录、当前目录、/tmp 挂进容器（Apptainer 文档），不加 --net 也不另开网络命名空间，用的就是主机的网络（Apptainer 文档）；加一个 --nv，主机的 NVIDIA 驱动库和 GPU 设备就进来了（Apptainer 文档）。Docker 镜像可以直接转成 .sif。Apptainer (formerly Singularity, described in a 2017 paper; renamed when it joined the Linux Foundation in 2021): made for supercomputer clusters. A cluster can’t give everyone root, nor can it install Docker’s root daemon, so the image is a single .sif file that runs as you, and inside the container you can’t gain extra privileges (Kurtzer et al. 2017, Apptainer 2021). It is designed for convenience: by default it mounts your home directory, the current directory and /tmp into the container (Apptainer docs), and without --net it does not create a network namespace of its own, so it simply uses the host’s network (Apptainer docs); add --nv and the host’s NVIDIA driver libraries and GPU devices come in too (Apptainer docs). Docker images can be converted straight into .sif files.
        • 

      • Distrobox 和 Toolbx：开发用的"宠物容器"。在 24.04 上开一个 22.04 的终端，装在里面的图形程序（比如 ROS 的 rviz2）照样弹窗口，家目录、U 盘、USB 设备、声音、网络、进程表全部和主机共用，整个主机的文件系统还挂在容器里的 /run/host 下（distrobox-create 手册）。它的说明里写得很清楚："隔离和沙箱不是这个项目的主要目的"（Distrobox）。Distrobox and Toolbx: "pet containers" for development. Open a 22.04 terminal on 24.04, and graphical programs installed inside it (such as ROS’s rviz2) still open their windows as normal; the home directory, USB sticks, USB devices, sound, network and process table are all shared with the host, and the host’s entire file system is also mounted inside the container under /run/host (distrobox-create manual). Its README says so plainly: "isolation and sandboxing are not the main aims of the project" (Distrobox).
        • 

      • Kubernetes（2014 年 6 月第一次提交代码，Kubernetes 2024）：不是新的隔离方法，而是一个调度器：把成百上千个容器排到一大群机器上，挂了就重启，负载高了就多开几个。云上的 GPU 服务器跑训练和推理，常常就是它在排。Kubernetes (first code committed in June 2014, Kubernetes 2024): not a new way to isolate, but a scheduler. It places hundreds or thousands of containers across a large fleet of machines, restarts them when they crash, and starts a few more when the load goes up. When GPU servers in the cloud run training and inference, it is often Kubernetes doing the scheduling.
        • 

      

      

      工具Tool谁在运行它Who runs it默认和主机共用Shared with the host by default最适合Best for团队的用法How the team uses it
