      Podman你自己，无守护进程You, no daemon内核Kernel同上，更安全Same as above, but safer同上Same as above
      

      LXC / Incus命令行工具；Incus 有守护进程Command-line tools; Incus has a daemon内核Kernel长期开着的整套系统A whole system that stays running一台常驻的 22.04 开发机An always-on 22.04 development machine
      

      Apptainer你自己You内核、家目录、当前目录、/tmp、网络Kernel, home directory, current directory, /tmp, network集群上跑作业Running jobs on a clusterG 在学校集群上训练G trains on the university cluster
      

      DistroboxPodman 或 DockerPodman or Docker内核、家目录、整个主机的文件（/run/host）、网络、进程、USB、图形界面、声音Kernel, home directory, all of the host’s files (/run/host), network, processes, USB, GUI, sound在桌面上用别的发行版Using another distro on your desktopC 的 rviz2 等图形工具C’s rviz2 and other graphical tools
      

      Docker Desktop一台 Linux 虚拟机A Linux virtual machineMac 或 Windows 上的文件（挂进虚拟机）Files on the Mac or Windows machine (mounted into the VM)在 Mac、Windows 上用容器Using containers on Mac and Windows队员的笔记本Team members’ laptops
      

      

      不管哪一种，容器的边界都一样：内核是主机的。所以 E 的实时内核要装在主机上；GPU 的内核驱动在主机上，容器里只带 CUDA 运行时；容器换不了 CPU 的种类，x86 的镜像在 Thor 上跑不了，要么另做 ARM64 的镜像，要么用 QEMU 翻译着跑（慢）；要跑 D 这种离不开 Windows 内核和驱动的程序，还是得回到虚拟机。Whichever kind you use, a container’s boundary is the same: the kernel is the host’s. So E’s real-time kernel has to be installed on the host. The GPU’s kernel driver is on the host, and the container carries only the CUDA runtime. A container can’t change the kind of CPU: an x86 image won’t run on Thor, so either build a separate ARM64 image or run it through QEMU’s translation (slow). And to run something like D, which can’t do without the Windows kernel and drivers, you still have to go back to a virtual machine.
      

      这一步的要点：Docker、Podman、LXC、Apptainer、Distrobox 用的是同一套零件，区别在谁来运行（root 守护进程还是你自己）、默认共用多少（Apptainer、Distrobox 为了方便共用家目录等，几乎不设防）、适合什么场合。Mac 和 Windows 上的 Docker Desktop 其实是"虚拟机里的容器"。所有容器都共用主机的内核和驱动，也换不了 CPU 的种类。The point of this step: Docker, Podman, LXC, Apptainer and Distrobox use the same set of parts. They differ in who runs them (a root daemon or you), how much they share by default (for convenience, Apptainer and Distrobox share your home directory and more, and are almost wide open), and what they suit. Docker Desktop on Mac and Windows is really "containers inside a virtual machine". All containers share the host’s kernel and drivers, and none of them can change the kind of CPU.
      

      

      

      第 ⑩ 步 · 沙箱Step ⑩ · Sandboxes
      

      沙箱：重点不在复制，在收走权限Sandboxes: not copying, but taking permissions away
      

      别的方法都是"复制一份"：容器复制系统库，虚拟机复制内核，第 ⑪ 步的环境复制包。沙箱的重点不在复制：安卓应用用的就是系统的库，Flatpak、Snap 虽然带着一份自己的运行时，也不让程序以为自己有一台机器；它们做的是把程序能做的事一样样收走，要什么得申请。它用的仍是内核的那几样工具（命名空间、seccomp、访问控制），只是用法不同：目标不是"让它以为自己有一台机器"，而是"它只能碰到它该碰的"。The other methods all "make a copy": containers copy the system libraries, virtual machines copy the kernel, and the environments of step ⑪ copy packages. A sandbox is not about copying. Android apps use the system’s own libraries; Flatpak and Snap do bring a runtime of their own, but they don’t let the program think it has a machine to itself either. What they do is take away the things a program can do, one by one, so that it has to ask for anything it wants. Sandboxes still use the same few kernel tools (namespaces, seccomp, access control), just in a different way: the goal is not "let it think it has a machine of its own" but "it can touch only what it should".
      

        

      • 手机应用：安卓给每个应用一个单独的 Linux 用户号，各在自己的进程里跑，默认互相碰不到，也碰不到系统的大部分东西；后来又加上了 SELinux（5.0）、按系统调用过滤（8.0）、每个应用一个 SELinux 沙箱（9）（Android）。这正是第 ② 步说的"最便宜的一堵墙，是给它单独开一个用户"，做到了极致：每个应用一个用户。Phone apps: Android gives each app its own Linux user ID, and each runs in its own process; by default they can’t touch one another, or most of the system. Later Android added SELinux (5.0), system-call filtering (8.0) and a separate SELinux sandbox for each app (9) (Android). This is step ②’s "the cheapest wall is to give it a user of its own", taken to the extreme: one user per app.
        • 

      • Flatpak：桌面上的应用默认看不到主机上的文件（只有运行时、应用本身和它自己的数据目录），也不能上网。要打开一个文件，就弹出系统的文件选择框，你挑中哪个，它就只能读哪个，这种机制叫"门户"（Flatpak 文档）。Flatpak: by default a desktop app can’t see the host’s files (only the runtime, the app itself and its own data directory), and it can’t go online. To open a file, the system’s file chooser pops up, and the app can read only the file you pick. This mechanism is called a "portal" (Flatpak docs).
        • 

      • Snap：严格模式下"完全隔离，只留一个被认为总是安全的最小权限"，用 AppArmor、seccomp 和命名空间来实现，要别的权限得通过一个个"接口"申请；也有经典模式，权限和普通软件包一样（Snapcraft 文档）。Snap: strict mode means "complete isolation, up to a minimal access level that is deemed always safe", enforced with AppArmor, seccomp and namespaces; any other permission has to be requested through "interfaces", one at a time. There is also a classic mode, with the same permissions as an ordinary package (Snapcraft docs).
        • 

      

      两样核心零件值得单独说。seccomp 是一段挂在进程上的小过滤程序，进程每发一次系统调用，内核先拿它过一遍：放行、返回一个错误、或者直接杀掉进程。规则可以只看系统调用的编号，也可以看参数的数值；但它看不到指针指着的东西（比如文件名），所以挡不住"读某一个文件"，那要靠挂载命名空间或者强制访问控制。前面已经见过三份规则：Docker 默认禁掉三百多个里的约 44 个；Firecracker 给自己只留了 24 个；安卓从 8.0 开始给所有应用套上一份。强制访问控制（AppArmor、SELinux）则在普通的文件权限之外，再加一套系统级的规则："这个程序只能读这几个目录、只能连这几个端口"，由系统说了算，不由文件的主人说了算。Two core parts deserve a closer look. seccomp is a small filter program attached to a process: every time the process makes a system call, the kernel first runs it through the filter, which lets it pass, returns an error, or kills the process on the spot. A rule can look at just the system-call number, or at the values of the arguments too; but it can’t see what a pointer points to (a file name, say), so it can’t block "read this particular file". That needs a mount namespace or mandatory access control. We have already met three sets of rules: Docker’s default blocks about 44 of the 300-plus system calls; Firecracker keeps only 24 for itself; and since 8.0, Android has put one on every app. Mandatory access control (AppArmor, SELinux) adds a set of system-wide rules on top of the ordinary file permissions: "this program may read only these directories and connect only to these ports". The system has the final say, not the file’s owner.
      

      回到 F。最便宜的一堵墙是单独开一个用户来跑它；稍好一点，是放进一个"加固"的容器：不给网络、根目录只读、去掉全部能力、用普通用户、限制进程数和内存，只把输入目录只读地挂进去、把输出目录可写地挂进去。可它和主机共用内核，内核的三百多个系统调用里只要有一个有漏洞，墙就可能被打穿；所以真要跑陌生人的代码，就在这上面再加一层：gVisor 或者一台微虚拟机（第 ⑥ 步）。Back to F. The cheapest wall is to run it as a separate user. A little better is a "hardened" container: no network, a read-only root, every capability dropped, an ordinary user, limits on processes and memory, with only the input directory mounted read-only and the output directory mounted writable. But it shares the kernel with the host: if even one of the kernel’s 300-plus system calls has a bug, the wall may be broken through. So if you really are running a stranger’s code, add one more layer on top: gVisor or a microVM (step ⑥).
      

        

      • 表里每一行是不可信的代码想做的一件事：读你的 SSH 私钥、连外网、改团队的数据、读输入、写结果、fork 炸弹、一点点地要内存（一直要到 100 GB）、挂载硬盘、改系统时间、利用一个内核漏洞。Each row of the table is one thing the untrusted code tries to do: read your SSH private key, connect out to the internet, modify the team’s data, read the input, write the result, set off a fork bomb, ask for memory bit by bit (all the way up to 100 GB), mount a disk, change the system time, exploit a kernel bug.
        • 

      • 每一列是一种跑法：直接跑、Docker 默认、Docker 加固（没有网络、根目录只读、去掉全部能力、普通用户、最多 100 个进程、最多 2 GiB 内存且不许用交换区）、gVisor（同样加固）、微虚拟机（Firecracker，没有网卡）。手机上一次看一列，用按钮切换。Each column is one way of running it: Run directly, Docker default, Docker hardened (no network, read-only root, every capability dropped, an ordinary user, at most 100 processes, at most 2 GiB of memory and no swap), gVisor (same hardening), microVM (Firecracker, no network card). On a phone you see one column at a time and switch between them with the buttons.
        • 

      • 每一格是结果：得逞（红）、受限（黄）、拦住（绿），读输入、写结果这两件正当的事是能用；"拦住"里也包括"看不见"：那个文件根本不在它的世界里。点一下格子，旁边的图里一个小点一路往下走，停在做出决定的那一层，下面写出原因；▶ 播放、上一步、下一步、重来 把一种跑法下的十件事挨个走一遍。表底数着八件坏事里有几件得逞。Each cell is an outcome: gets through (red), contained (yellow) or blocked (green), and the two legitimate jobs, reading the input and writing the result, show works. The "blocked" outcome also covers "not visible": that file simply isn’t in its world. Tap a cell and a small dot in the diagram beside it travels down and stops at the layer that makes the decision, with the reason written underneath; ▶ Play, Back, Next step and Restart walk through all ten attempts under one way of running it. The foot of the table counts how many of the eight harmful attempts get through.
        • 

      

      先玩："Docker 默认"下，哪几件危险的事还能做成？换成"Docker 加固"，还剩哪一件？那一件，gVisor 和微虚拟机各是怎么挡的？Try first: Under "Docker default", which dangerous things still succeed? Switch to "Docker hardened": which one is left? And how do gVisor and the microVM each stop that one?
      

      


      

      

      

      

      


      

      

      

      


      这一步的要点：沙箱的重点不是复制（Flatpak、Snap 自带运行时，手机应用连这个也不带），而是在同一个系统里收走权限：手机给每个应用一个用户，Flatpak 默认看不到文件、上不了网，要文件就通过门户挑一个；底下的零件是 seccomp（按系统调用过滤）和强制访问控制。跑不可信的代码：至少用一个加固的容器，真要放心，再加一层 gVisor 或微虚拟机。The point of this step: A sandbox is not about copying (Flatpak and Snap bring their own runtime; phone apps don’t even bring that), but about taking permissions away within the same system: a phone gives each app its own user; a Flatpak app by default can’t see your files or go online, and when it needs a file, you pick one through a portal; the parts underneath are seccomp (system-call filtering) and mandatory access control. To run untrusted code, use at least a hardened container, and to be truly at ease, add another layer: gVisor or a microVM.
      

      

      

      第 ⑪ 步 · 环境Step ⑪ · Environments
      

      环境管理器：只换"先到哪里找"Environment managers: changing only "where to look first"
      

      最常用的一类方法反而切得最高。A 和 B 的冲突不在内核，也不在发行版，而在"Python 和它的包"这两层：同一个 import torch，A 要拿到 2.5.1，B 要拿到 1.13.1。第 ① 步说过，程序是"按名字、照顺序去找"的，那就不必复制任何东西，只要给每个项目换一个找的顺序。这里有三张表：The most widely used family of methods actually cuts the highest of all. The clash between A and B isn’t in the kernel, nor in the distribution, but in two layers, "Python and its packages": with the same import torch, A needs to get 2.5.1 and B needs 1.13.1. As step ① showed, programs look things up "by name, in order", so there’s no need to copy anything: just give each project its own search order. There are three tables here:
      

        

      • PATH：shell 找命令的目录列表，从前往后，第一个找到的算数。PATH: the list of directories where the shell looks for commands, searched front to back; the first match wins.
        • 

      • sys.path：Python 找包的目录列表，也是从前往后。它不是写死的，而是 Python 启动时根据"我这个解释器在哪"推出来的。sys.path: the list of directories where Python looks for packages, also searched front to back. It isn’t hard-coded: Python works it out at start-up from "where does this interpreter live?"
        • 

      • 库的搜索顺序：动态链接器找 .so 共享库，先看程序里写好的老式路径（RPATH），再看 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 变量，再看程序里写好的新式路径（RUNPATH，现在很多链接器默认写这种），再查系统的缓存表，最后是 /lib 和 /usr/lib 这些默认目录（ld.so(8)）。The library search order: to find a .so shared library, the dynamic linker first checks the old-style path written into the program (RPATH), then the LD_LIBRARY_PATH variable, then the new-style path written into the program (RUNPATH, which many linkers now write by default), then the system’s cache table, and finally default directories such as /lib and /usr/lib (ld.so(8)).
        • 

      

      各种环境管理器，不过是在这三张表上做文章。Every environment manager is just a way of playing with these three tables.
      

        

      • venv（标准库自带，Python 3.3 起；它的前身 virtualenv 是 2007 年的）：一个环境就是一个目录，里面一个 pyvenv.cfg 文件记着"原来的解释器在哪"，一个 bin/python 指向那个解释器，加上一个自己的 site-packages。Python 从 .venv/bin/python 启动时看到 pyvenv.cfg，就把自己的 sys.path 换成这个环境的 site-packages；解释器和标准库还是共用原来那一份（PEP 405、Willison 2007）。所谓"激活"，只是把 .venv/bin 放到 PATH 的最前面。所以 venv 能解决 A，却解决不了 B：它造不出一个 Python 3.8。venv (built into the standard library since Python 3.3; its predecessor, virtualenv, dates from 2007): an environment is just a directory, holding a pyvenv.cfg file that records "where the original interpreter is", a bin/python that points to that interpreter, and a site-packages of its own. When Python starts from .venv/bin/python, it sees pyvenv.cfg and points its sys.path at the environment’s site-packages; the interpreter and the standard library are still the original, shared copy (PEP 405, Willison 2007). "Activating" it just means putting .venv/bin at the very front of PATH. So venv can solve A but not B: it can’t make a Python 3.8.
        • 

      • uv（2024 年）：用 Rust 写的包管理器，比 pip 快得多：没有缓存时快 8 到 10 倍，有缓存时快 80 到 115 倍；所有环境共用一个缓存，同一个包在磁盘上只存一份，用硬链接或写时复制"放"进各个环境（Astral 2024）。它还能另外下载别的版本的 Python：uv python install 3.8，再用这个 3.8 建 B 的环境，装 PyTorch 官方给 CUDA 11.7 编译的 1.13.1。uv (2024): a package manager written in Rust and much faster than pip: 8 to 10 times faster without a cache, 80 to 115 times faster with one. All environments share one cache, so each package is stored on disk only once and "placed" into each environment with hard links or copy-on-write (Astral 2024). It can also download other versions of Python separately: uv python install 3.8, then build B’s environment with that 3.8 and install PyTorch’s official 1.13.1 build for CUDA 11.7.
        • 

      • conda（出自 2012 年成立的 Anaconda，Anaconda）：科学计算的包里到处是 C、Fortran、CUDA 写的库，早年的 pip 主要从源代码装 Python 包，很难管好这些编译好的库，于是有了一个"不分语言的二进制包管理器"（conda）。一个 conda 环境也是一个目录，可里面放的东西多得多：它自己的 Python 解释器、C++ 标准库、OpenSSL、CUDA 运行时、编译器，甚至 R。所以 conda create -n b python=3.8 就能给 B 一个 3.8，再装上 PyTorch 1.13.1 和 CUDA 11.7 的运行时。conda 没有复制的是 glibc、内核和 GPU 驱动，这些还用主机的。mamba、micromamba、pixi 是同一套包的更快的装法；conda-forge 是 2015 年起社区维护的软件源（conda-forge）。要留意的是授权：Anaconda 公司自己的软件源，对个人、合格的学术机构、非营利机构和 200 人以下的公司免费，更大的公司要付费，在集群这类大规模用法上还可能另收费（Anaconda 2025）；只用社区的 conda-forge（比如通过 Miniforge 安装）就不涉及这份条款。conda (from Anaconda, a company founded in 2012, Anaconda): scientific computing packages are full of libraries written in C, Fortran and CUDA. Early pip mostly installed Python packages from source code and had a hard time managing these compiled libraries, so along came a "language-agnostic binary package manager" (conda). A conda environment is also a directory, but it holds far more: its own Python interpreter, C++ standard library, OpenSSL, CUDA runtime, compilers, even R. So conda create -n b python=3.8 is all it takes to give B a 3.8, and then you add PyTorch 1.13.1 and the CUDA 11.7 runtime. What conda doesn’t copy is glibc, the kernel and the GPU driver: those still come from the host. mamba, micromamba and pixi are faster ways of installing the same packages; conda-forge is a channel the community has maintained since 2015 (conda-forge). One thing to watch is licensing: Anaconda’s own channel is free for individuals, eligible academic institutions, non-profits and companies of 200 people or fewer; larger companies have to pay, and large-scale use such as on clusters may cost extra (Anaconda 2025). These terms don’t come into it if you use only the community’s conda-forge (installed through Miniforge, for example).
        • 

      • pyenv、nvm 这类版本管理器：同一台机器上装好几个版本的 Python 或 Node，各放一个目录。nvm 把要用的那个目录排到 PATH 前面；pyenv 在 PATH 最前面放一个"垫片"目录，垫片看当前目录里的 .python-version 文件，再转给对应版本的 python。Ubuntu 24.04 用 apt 装的 Node 是 18.19（Ubuntu 软件包），某个工具要 22 以上，nvm install 22 就行，不用动系统的那份。Version managers such as pyenv and nvm: several versions of Python or Node on one machine, each in its own directory. nvm moves the directory you want to the front of PATH; pyenv puts a "shim" directory at the very front of PATH, and the shim reads the .python-version file in the current directory and hands over to the matching version of python. The Node that apt installs on Ubuntu 24.04 is 18.19 (Ubuntu packages); if a tool needs 22 or later, nvm install 22 does it, without touching the system’s copy.
        • 

      • Lmod（集群上的"模块"）：集群的管理员把各个版本的 CUDA、编译器、Python 装在共享的目录里，你 module load cuda/12.4，它就把对应的目录加到 PATH 和库的搜索路径前面；它还按层级组织，选了一个编译器，才看得到用它编译的那些库（TACC）。G 在集群上不用容器的时候，就是这样拿到 CUDA 的。Lmod ("modules" on a cluster): the cluster’s administrators install various versions of CUDA, compilers and Python in shared directories; you run module load cuda/12.4, and it adds the matching directories to the front of PATH and of the library search path. Modules are also arranged in a hierarchy: only after you pick a compiler do you see the libraries built with it (TACC). When G runs on the cluster without a container, this is how it gets CUDA.
        • 

      • 打包成一个文件：反过来做也行，让程序根本不用找：静态链接把库编进程序本身（Go、Rust 写的命令行工具常这样），AppImage、PyInstaller 把整个程序连同它的库塞进一个文件。拷过去就能跑，代价是每个程序各带一份库，有了安全补丁得每个都重新打包。Packing everything into one file: you can also go the other way and make sure the program never has to look anything up. Static linking compiles the libraries into the program itself (command-line tools written in Go or Rust often do this); AppImage and PyInstaller pack the whole program, libraries and all, into a single file. Copy it over and it runs; the price is one copy of the libraries per program, and when a security patch comes out, every one of them has to be repackaged.
        • 

      

      环境管理器隔开的，只是"找到哪个文件"。下面这些全都没变：内核和 GPU 驱动（B 用的 CUDA 11.7 运行时，靠的还是主机上 550 版的驱动，见第 ⑬ 步）；venv 和 conda 用的 glibc；文件（B 的代码照样能读、能删 A 的数据）；用户、网络、权限。它们是约定，不是墙：防的是两个项目不小心混在一起，挡不住一段存心捣乱的代码。所以 F 绝不能只靠一个 conda 环境。All an environment manager separates is "which file gets found". None of the following changes: the kernel and the GPU driver (B’s CUDA 11.7 runtime still depends on the host’s 550 driver; see step ⑬); the glibc that venv and conda use; files (B’s code can still read and delete A’s data); users, network, permissions. They are a convention, not a wall: they guard against two projects getting mixed up by accident, but can’t stop code that sets out to cause trouble. So F must never rely on a conda environment alone.
      

        

      • 两个终端并排（手机上上下排）：左边是项目 A，右边是项目 B。上面一排按钮选方法：不用环境、venv、conda（默认）、uv、Lmod（集群）；每换一种，终端里先打出装环境的命令和结果。Two terminals side by side (one above the other on a phone): project A on the left, project B on the right. The row of buttons at the top picks the method: No environment, venv, conda (the default), uv, Lmod (cluster). Each time you switch, the terminals first print the commands that set up the environment, with their output.
        • 

      • 命令按钮：which python、import torch（打印 PyTorch 和它的 CUDA 版本）、sys.prefix、echo $PATH，conda 下还有一个 ldd，看 PyTorch 的库最后找到了哪个 libcudart。▶ 播放 把这几条命令依次跑一遍，上一步、下一步 一条一条地看。Command buttons: which python, import torch (prints PyTorch’s version and its CUDA version), sys.prefix, echo $PATH, and under conda one more, ldd, which shows which libcudart PyTorch’s library ends up finding. ▶ Play runs these commands one after another; Back and Next step take you through them one at a time.
        • 

      • 每个终端下面列出这条命令要依次查的那张表（PATH、sys.path，或者库的五步搜索顺序），一项一项查过去：没有的打 ✗，找到的打 ✓。下面写着两个项目各得到了什么，最下面一栏写着两个项目还共用的东西。Under each terminal is the table that this command searches in order (PATH, sys.path, or the five-step library search order), checked one entry at a time: ✗ where it isn’t, ✓ where it’s found. Below that is what each project ends up with, and the bottom panel lists what the two projects still share.
        • 

      

      先玩：在"不用环境"下装 PyTorch，会碰到什么？换成 venv，A 好了，B 卡在哪？换成 conda：B 的 libcudart 是从哪个目录找到的？看最下面那一栏：换了这么多方法，有哪几样始终没变？Try first: Under "No environment", what do you run into when you install PyTorch? Switch to venv: A works now, but where does B get stuck? Switch to conda: in which directory is B’s libcudart found? Look at the bottom panel: through all these methods, which things never change?
      

      


      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      


      这一步的要点：环境管理器只改"先到哪里找"：PATH、sys.path、库的搜索顺序。venv 和 uv 给每个项目一份自己的包（uv 还能另装 Python），conda 连解释器、C++ 库和 CUDA 运行时都各放一份，pyenv、nvm、Lmod 在 PATH 上切换版本。它们最轻、几乎没有开销，但内核、驱动、glibc、文件和权限全都共用：是约定，不是墙。The point of this step: Environment managers change only "where to look first": PATH, sys.path and the library search order. venv and uv give each project its own copy of the packages (uv can also install a separate Python); conda keeps a copy of even the interpreter, the C++ libraries and the CUDA runtime in each environment; pyenv, nvm and Lmod switch versions through PATH. They are the lightest option, with almost no overhead, but the kernel, the driver, glibc, files and permissions are all shared: a convention, not a wall.
      

      

      

      第 ⑫ 步 · Nix 和 GuixStep ⑫ · Nix and Guix
      

      换个思路：让名字永远不会撞A different idea: make sure names can never clash
      

      环境管理器的办法是"每个项目换一个找的顺序"。可顺序总有出错的时候：PATH 里排错一个目录，就拿到了别的版本；更隐蔽的是，你忘了在依赖里写上某个库，可你的电脑上恰好装着，于是一切正常，换一台机器就坏了。2004 年，乌得勒支大学的 Dolstra 等人提出了另一个思路（Dolstra 等 2004）：不换顺序，而是让名字不可能撞。这就是 Nix。The environment managers’ answer is "a different search order for each project". But sooner or later an order goes wrong: put one directory in the wrong place in PATH and you get a different version. More insidiously, you forget to list some library among your dependencies, but your computer happens to have it installed, so everything works, until you move to another machine and it breaks. In 2004, Dolstra and colleagues at Utrecht University proposed another idea (Dolstra et al. 2004): don’t change the order; make it impossible for names to clash. That is Nix.
      

      Nix 把每个软件包放在 /nix/store/ 下面一个单独的目录里，目录名的开头是一串哈希，比如 /nix/store/（32 个字符）-python3-3.12.4。这串哈希是用构建这个包的全部输入算出来的：源代码、构建脚本、用的编译器、依赖的每一个包（它们自己的路径里也带着哈希）、平台、环境变量。只要有一样不同，哈希就不同，就是另一个目录。于是：Nix puts every package in a directory of its own under /nix/store/, and the directory name starts with a hash, for example /nix/store/(32 characters)-python3-3.12.4. The hash is computed from all the inputs used to build the package: the source code, the build script, the compiler used, every package it depends on (whose own paths carry hashes too), the platform, the environment variables. If any one of them differs, so does the hash, and it’s a different directory. So:
      

        

      • 不同版本永远共存：Python 3.8 和 3.12，链接了不同 OpenSSL 的两个 Python，都各在各的目录里，谁也不覆盖谁。Different versions always coexist: Python 3.8 and 3.12, or two Pythons linked against different OpenSSLs, each sit in their own directory, and none overwrites another.
        • 

      • 不用到处找：程序在构建时就把依赖的完整路径写死在自己里面（动态链接器的路径、库的 RUNPATH、脚本开头的解释器路径），运行时只在这几个钉死的仓库目录里找，摸不到系统里别的同名文件（除非你自己设了 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 这类变量去盖过它）。连 glibc 都是这样钉死的，这一点比 conda 还彻底。No searching around: at build time a program gets the full paths of its dependencies written into it (the path of the dynamic linker, the library RUNPATH, the interpreter path at the top of a script), so at run time it looks only in those pinned store directories and can’t reach other files of the same name on the system (unless you set a variable such as LD_LIBRARY_PATH yourself to override this). Even glibc is pinned this way, which goes further than conda.
        • 

      • 漏写的依赖藏不住：构建在一个只看得见已声明输入的隔离环境里进行，没写的库根本不存在，当场就失败。Missing dependencies can’t hide: builds run in an isolated environment that can see only the declared inputs, so a library you didn’t list simply isn’t there, and the build fails on the spot.
        • 

      • 升级和回滚是原子的：你"装好的软件"其实是一个指向某一"代"的符号链接，升级就是建好新的一代再把链接一换，回滚就是换回去；没人再用的目录，可以安全地回收。Upgrades and rollbacks are atomic: your "installed software" is really a symbolic link to one "generation". Upgrading means building the new generation and then swapping the link; rolling back means swapping it back. Directories nobody uses any more can be garbage-collected safely.
        • 

      

      

      d = h(x1, x2, …, xk)160 = 32 × 5
      

      

      一个包的目录名开头那串字符，是它全部构建输入的哈希；这串哈希取 160 位，用 32 个字符写出来，每个字符代表 5 位。The string at the start of a package’s directory name is a hash of all its build inputs; the hash is 160 bits long and written as 32 characters, each standing for 5 bits.
      

      和镜像的摘要（第 ⑧ 步）是同一个想法，只是对象换了：镜像是对"内容"算哈希，Nix 是对"怎么造出来的"算哈希，所以还没构建，就已经知道它该放在哪个目录。依赖的路径本身也是输入，因此改动会一路往上传：给 OpenSSL 打一个补丁，OpenSSL 的哈希变了；用到它的 Python 的输入变了，Python 的哈希也变；再往上 numpy、你的程序，全都变成新的目录。旧的那些原封不动地留着。It’s the same idea as an image’s digest (step ⑧), applied to something different: an image hashes its "content", while Nix hashes "how it was made", so you know which directory a package belongs in before it has even been built. The paths of its dependencies are inputs too, so a change ripples all the way up: patch OpenSSL and OpenSSL’s hash changes; the inputs of the Python that uses it change, so Python’s hash changes too; further up, numpy and your program all become new directories. The old ones stay exactly as they were.
      

      

      x1, …, xk
      构建这个包的全部输入：源代码、构建脚本、编译器、每个依赖的路径、平台all the inputs used to build the package: source code, build script, compiler, the path of every dependency, platform
      

      h(·)
      哈希函数：现在的 Nix 用 SHA-256，再压缩成 160 位the hash function: Nix today uses SHA-256, then compresses it to 160 bits
      

      d
      目录名开头的那串哈希；32 个字符，字母表是 0–9 和 26 个字母里去掉 e、o、u、t 剩下的 22 个，正好 32 个the hash at the start of the directory name; 32 characters, from an alphabet of 0–9 plus the 22 letters left when e, o, u and t are taken out of the 26: exactly 32 symbols
      

      

      Nix 的手册写着：仓库路径是"/nix/store/摘要-名字"，摘要是对一串指纹做 SHA-256、压缩到 160 位，再用 Nix 自己的 32 进制字母表写出来（Nix 手册）。160 ÷ 5 = 32 个字符。2004 年的论文里用的还是 128 位、32 个十六进制数字。According to the Nix manual, a store path is "/nix/store/digest-name", where the digest is the SHA-256 of a fingerprint string, compressed to 160 bits and written in Nix’s own base-32 alphabet (Nix manual). 160 ÷ 5 = 32 characters. The 2004 paper still used 128 bits, written as 32 hexadecimal digits.
      

      "同样的输入一定得到同样的路径"，带来一个很实用的东西：二进制缓存。服务器上已经按同样的输入构建过的包，路径和你算出来的一模一样，直接下载就行，不用自己再编译一遍。"The same inputs always give the same path" brings something very practical: the binary cache. A package that a server has already built from the same inputs has exactly the path you computed, so you just download it instead of compiling it again yourself.
      

      

      Guix（2013 年）沿用了 Nix 底层的这一套，只是把描述包的语言换成了 Scheme（Courtès 2013）。对机器人团队来说，Nix 最大的用处是 G 里的"可复现"：一份描述文件钉死了从 glibc 到 PyTorch 的每一个版本和补丁，半年后在另一台机器上能造出一模一样的环境。它不管的仍然是内核、GPU 驱动和安全：Nix 里跑的程序和你有一样的权限。代价是学起来难，概念和普通的 Linux 很不一样；第一次构建可能很久，有二进制缓存就快。Guix (2013) reuses this machinery underneath Nix and only swaps the language for describing packages for Scheme (Courtès 2013). For the robot team, Nix’s biggest use is the "reproducible" part of G: one description file pins every version and patch from glibc up to PyTorch, so six months later another machine can build exactly the same environment. What it still doesn’t cover is the kernel, the GPU driver and security: programs running under Nix have the same permissions as you. The price is that it’s hard to learn, as its concepts are very different from ordinary Linux; the first build can take a long time, though a binary cache makes it quick.
      

        

      • 一张小的依赖图，从下往上：glibc、openssl、python3、numpy、团队的程序 grasp-app；gcc 是它们的构建工具（虚线）。每个节点写着它的仓库路径，开头的哈希是这个交互在你的浏览器里用 SHA-256 真算出来的（图上只显示前 10 个字符）。点一个节点，下面写出它的指纹（简化过的输入清单）怎样一步步变成路径：SHA-256，压缩到 160 位，再写成 32 个字符。A small dependency graph, from the bottom up: glibc, openssl, python3, numpy and the team’s program, grasp-app; gcc is their build tool (dashed lines). Each node shows its store path, and the hash at its start is genuinely computed with SHA-256 by this widget, in your browser (the graph shows only the first 10 characters). Tap a node and below it you’ll see how its fingerprint (a simplified list of inputs) becomes a path, step by step: SHA-256, compressed to 160 bits, then written as 32 characters.
        • 

      • 按钮：给 openssl 打补丁、换编译器、回滚、回收；▶ 播放、上一步、下一步、重来。改了输入，变了哈希的节点换成新的，旧的路径淡淡地留在右边；每改一次就多一"代"，下面一排按钮可以换到任何一代。回滚是把"当前这一代"的链接换回上一代；回收照 nix-collect-garbage -d 来：先删掉当前这一代以外的各代，再删掉没有任何一代再用的路径。Buttons: Patch openssl, Change the compiler, Roll back, Garbage-collect; ▶ Play, Back, Next step, Restart. When you change an input, the nodes whose hashes change are replaced by new ones, and the old paths stay on the right, faded. Each change adds a "generation", and the row of buttons below lets you switch to any generation. Rolling back re-points the "current generation" link to the previous one; garbage collection does what nix-collect-garbage -d does: first it deletes every generation other than the current one, then every path that no generation uses any more.
        • 

      

      先玩：给 openssl 打补丁：哪几个节点的哈希变了，哪几个没变？为什么 glibc 不变？再换编译器：这次连 glibc 也变了，为什么？回滚之后，新的那一代还在吗？这时回收，能删掉的是哪些？Try first: Patch openssl: which nodes’ hashes change, and which don’t? Why does glibc stay the same? Then change the compiler: this time even glibc changes. Why? After rolling back, is the new generation still there? If you garbage-collect at that point, what can be deleted?
      

      


      

      

      


      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      


      这一步的要点：Nix 和 Guix 不靠查找顺序，而是让每个包住在一个由它全部构建输入的哈希命名的目录里（SHA-256 压缩到 160 位，32 个字符），程序把依赖的完整路径写死。于是不同版本永远共存、漏写的依赖藏不住、升级回滚是原子的、同样的输入一定得到同样的路径。它把依赖钉得最死（连 glibc），但不隔离内核、驱动和权限。The point of this step: Nix and Guix don’t rely on search order. Instead, each package lives in a directory named by the hash of all its build inputs (SHA-256 compressed to 160 bits, 32 characters), and programs have the full paths of their dependencies written in. So different versions always coexist, missing dependencies can’t hide, upgrades and rollbacks are atomic, and the same inputs always give the same path. It pins dependencies down more tightly than anything else (glibc included), but it doesn’t isolate the kernel, the drivers or permissions.
      

      

      

      第 ⑬ 步 · GPUStep ⑬ · GPUs
      

      GPU：驱动在下面，CUDA 在上面GPUs: the driver below, CUDA above
      

      机器人团队几乎每个世界都要用 GPU，而 GPU 恰好横跨了"内核"和"用户空间"两边，最容易让人糊涂：为什么 conda 能装 CUDA 11.7，却装不了驱动？为什么容器里不用装驱动？为什么用 CUDA 13 编译的程序在工作站上用不了 GPU？把 GPU 这一摞从下往上拆开就清楚了：Almost every world the robot team uses needs the GPU, and the GPU happens to straddle both sides, "kernel" and "user space", so it is the easiest part to get confused about. Why can conda install CUDA 11.7 but not the driver? Why is there no need to install a driver inside a container? Why can’t a program compiled with CUDA 13 use the GPU on the workstation? Take the GPU’s stack apart from the bottom up and it all becomes clear:
      

        

      • 内核驱动（nvidia.ko）：装在内核里，直接指挥显卡。它属于"内核"那一层，所以和内核一样，整台机器只有一份，容器、conda、venv 都只能共用主机的。The kernel driver (nvidia.ko): installed in the kernel, it drives the graphics card directly. It belongs to the "kernel" layer, so, just like the kernel, there is only one copy for the whole machine: containers, conda and venv can only share the host’s.
        • 

      • 用户态驱动（libcuda.so）：和内核驱动是一个安装包里出来的，平时版本必须一致，所以也跟着主机走（NVIDIA）。数据中心的卡和 Jetson 例外：NVIDIA 的"向前兼容包"能在旧的内核驱动上换一个新的 libcuda.so（NVIDIA）。The user-mode driver (libcuda.so): it comes out of the same installer as the kernel driver and normally has to be the same version, so it goes with the host too (NVIDIA). Data-centre cards and Jetson are the exception: NVIDIA’s "forward-compatibility package" can swap in a newer libcuda.so on top of an older kernel driver (NVIDIA).
        • 

      • CUDA 运行时和库（libcudart、cuBLAS、cuDNN）：程序编译时选定的那一版，跟着程序走，每个世界可以不一样：pip 装的 PyTorch 把它要的 CUDA 运行时一起装进来，conda 环境里也可以各装一版，容器镜像里自带一版。The CUDA runtime and libraries (libcudart, cuBLAS, cuDNN): the version chosen when the program was compiled. It goes with the program, so each world can have a different one: PyTorch installed with pip brings the CUDA runtime it needs along with it, each conda environment can install its own, and a container image comes with its own.
        • 

      • 框架和你的程序：PyTorch 和训练脚本。The framework and your program: PyTorch and the training script.
        • 

      

      所以真正要对上的，只有"程序带的 CUDA 运行时"和"主机的驱动"这一对（前提是驱动认得这块卡：RTX 4090 在 Linux 上至少要 520 版）。NVIDIA 的规则是：新驱动能跑用旧 CUDA 编译的程序；在同一个大版本里，只要驱动不低于这个大版本的最低要求，就能跑（要新驱动才有的功能会报错；只带 PTX、要驱动现场编译的程序也不行，NVIDIA）。So the only pair that really has to match is "the CUDA runtime the program brings" and "the host’s driver" (provided the driver recognises the card at all: on Linux the RTX 4090 needs at least version 520). NVIDIA’s rule: a new driver can run programs compiled with an older CUDA; and within one major version, a program runs as long as the driver is no lower than that major version’s minimum (features that only a newer driver has will report an error, and programs that ship only PTX, for the driver to compile on the spot, won’t run either, NVIDIA).
      

      

      v ≥ vmin(k)vmin(11) = 450, vmin(12) = 525, vmin(13) = 580
      

      

      一个用 CUDA k 点几编译的程序，能在驱动版本 v 上跑，只要 v 不低于 CUDA k 这一族要求的最低驱动版本。A program compiled with any CUDA k.x runs on driver version v as long as v is no lower than the minimum driver version the CUDA k family requires.
      

      驱动是"往下兼容"的：它认得所有比它旧的 CUDA 运行时，所以老程序总能在新驱动上跑；反过来不行，新的 CUDA 要用新驱动才提供的东西。NVIDIA 为每个大版本定了一个最低驱动，大版本内部的小版本都按这个算，这样不必每升一次 CUDA 就升一次驱动。The driver is "backward compatible": it knows every CUDA runtime older than itself, so old programs always run on a new driver. The reverse doesn’t hold: a new CUDA needs things that only a new driver provides. NVIDIA sets one minimum driver for each major version, and every minor version within it goes by that, so you don’t have to upgrade the driver every time you upgrade CUDA.
      

      

      v
      主机上 NVIDIA 驱动的版本号（Linux）the version number of the NVIDIA driver on the host (Linux)
      

      k
      程序所用 CUDA 运行时的大版本：11、12、13the major version of the CUDA runtime the program uses: 11, 12, 13
      

      vmin(k)
      这一族要求的最低驱动：11.x 是 450（精确地说 450.80.02），12.x 是 525（525.60.13），13.x 是 580（NVIDIA）the minimum driver this family requires: 450 for 11.x (450.80.02, to be exact), 525 for 12.x (525.60.13), 580 for 13.x (NVIDIA)
      

      

      工作站的驱动 v = 550：A 的 CUDA 12.4，550 ≥ 525，能跑；B 的 CUDA 11.7，550 ≥ 450，也能跑。所以 A、B 用两个环境各带各的 CUDA，共用同一个驱动，完全没问题。可如果有人拿来一个用 CUDA 13.2 编译的程序（Thor 现在的 JetPack 7.2 带的就是 CUDA 13.2），550 < 580，跑不了，会直接报错；要么升级主机的驱动，要么换一个用 CUDA 12 编译的版本。Thor 的镜像在工作站上还多一道坎：它是 ARM64 的，在 x86 上只能靠 QEMU 翻译着跑，那样根本碰不到 GPU；就算重新编成 x86 版，CUDA 13.2 也要 580 以上的驱动。The workstation’s driver is v = 550. A’s CUDA 12.4: 550 ≥ 525, so it runs. B’s CUDA 11.7: 550 ≥ 450, so it runs too. So A and B can use two environments, each bringing its own CUDA, and share the one driver: no problem at all. But if someone brings along a program compiled with CUDA 13.2 (Thor’s current JetPack 7.2 ships exactly CUDA 13.2), then 550 < 580: it won’t run, and fails straight away with an error. Either upgrade the host’s driver or switch to a build compiled with CUDA 12. Thor’s image has one more hurdle on the workstation: it is ARM64, so on x86 it can only run translated by QEMU, and that way it can’t reach the GPU at all; and even rebuilt for x86, CUDA 13.2 still needs a driver of 580 or above.
      

      这就是"conda 能装 CUDA、装不了驱动"的原因：conda 管的是用户空间，驱动的另一半在内核里。也是"容器里不用装驱动"的原因：见下面。That is why "conda can install CUDA but not the driver": conda looks after user space, and the other half of the driver lives in the kernel. It is also why "there’s no need to install a driver inside a container": see below.
      

      

      GPU 怎样进到每一种世界里：How the GPU gets into each kind of world:
      

        

      • conda、venv：就是主机上的普通进程，直接用主机的驱动，环境里只带 CUDA 运行时。conda, venv: these are just ordinary processes on the host; they use the host’s driver directly, and the environment carries only the CUDA runtime.
        • 

      • Docker 容器：主机上要装好驱动，但不用装 CUDA 工具包；NVIDIA Container Toolkit 在容器启动前插一个钩子，把主机的驱动库和 /dev/nvidia* 这些设备文件挂进容器，CUDA 运行时由镜像自带（NVIDIA、NVIDIA）。所以镜像里的 CUDA 不能比主机驱动支持的更新。Docker container: the host must have the driver installed, but not the CUDA toolkit. The NVIDIA Container Toolkit inserts a hook before the container starts that mounts the host’s driver libraries and device files such as /dev/nvidia* into the container, while the CUDA runtime comes with the image (NVIDIA, NVIDIA). So the CUDA in the image can’t be newer than what the host’s driver supports.
        • 

      • Apptainer：--nv 做的是同一件事：把主机的驱动库和设备挂进来（第 ⑨ 步）。Apptainer: --nv does the same thing: it mounts the host’s driver libraries and devices in (step ⑨).
        • 

      • 虚拟机：客户机有自己的内核，就得装自己的驱动。显卡要么整块直通给它（IOMMU 保证安全，第 ⑤ 步），这时主机自己就用不了这块卡了；要么用数据中心显卡的 vGPU 功能切给几台虚拟机。Virtual machine: the guest has its own kernel, so it has to install its own driver. Either the whole card is passed through to it (the IOMMU keeps that safe, step ⑤), and then the host itself can no longer use the card; or a data-centre card’s vGPU feature cuts it up among several VMs.
        • 

      • WSL 2：特别一点。Windows 的驱动是唯一的驱动，WSL 里的 libcuda.so 只是一个转接，把调用转给 Windows；NVIDIA 明确说不要在 WSL 里装 Linux 的显卡驱动（NVIDIA）。WSL 2: a little special. The Windows driver is the only driver; the libcuda.so inside WSL is just an adapter that forwards calls to Windows. NVIDIA says explicitly not to install a Linux GPU driver inside WSL (NVIDIA).
        • 

      • Mac 上的 Docker Desktop：Mac 上没有 NVIDIA 的显卡，容器里也就没有 CUDA。Docker Desktop on a Mac: a Mac has no NVIDIA graphics card, so there is no CUDA in the container either.
        • 

      

      一块卡，几个人用One card, several users
      

      学校集群上一块 GPU 常常要分给好几个人，有几种分法。轮流（时间片）：几个程序的任务交替上卡，最简单，但显存不分开，一个程序把显存吃满，别人就得等着或者出错。MPS：让几个进程的任务同时在卡上跑，分的是逻辑上的份额，最多 48 个客户端，可一个出错会连累别的。MIG：在硬件上把卡切开，最多 7 份，每份有自己的显存、二级缓存和内存控制器，互不拖慢，一份出错不影响别的；A100、H100、B200 这些数据中心的卡都有，Thor 的 GPU 也支持（NVIDIA）。H100 80GB 可以切成 7 份 1g.10gb（每份 1/8 的显存、1/7 的计算单元），也可以切成 2 份 3g.40gb，或者别的组合。vGPU 是给虚拟机的切法，直通则是整块给一台虚拟机。On the university cluster one GPU often has to be shared among several people, and there are a few ways to split it. Time-slicing (taking turns): several programs’ jobs alternate on the card. It is the simplest, but memory isn’t divided: if one program fills the memory, the others have to wait or fail. MPS: lets several processes’ jobs run on the card at the same time; the shares it hands out are logical, for up to 48 clients, but an error in one can drag the others down. MIG: cuts the card apart in hardware into up to 7 slices, each with its own memory, L2 cache and memory controllers, so they don’t slow each other down and an error in one doesn’t affect the others. Data-centre cards such as the A100, H100 and B200 all have it, and Thor’s GPU supports it too (NVIDIA). An H100 80GB can be cut into 7 slices of 1g.10gb (each with 1/8 of the memory and 1/7 of the compute units), or into 2 of 3g.40gb, or other combinations. vGPU is the way to split a card for virtual machines. Passthrough, by contrast, gives the whole card to one VM.
      

        

      • 谁提供哪一层：两个世界并排，一摞 GPU 的层，从上往下：PyTorch、cuDNN 和 cuBLAS、CUDA 运行时、用户态驱动 libcuda.so、内核驱动 nvidia.ko、显卡，两个驱动之间是系统调用那条线。按钮选一种世界：本机、conda、Docker 容器（默认）、Apptainer --nv、虚拟机（直通）、WSL 2、Mac 上的 Docker Desktop；彩色方块是这个世界自己带的，灰条是主机的、大家共用，虚线框是插进来的一层，红色是缺的。▶ 播放、上一步、下一步、重来：一次 torch.matmul 从上往下走过每一层。Who provides each layer: two worlds side by side, with the GPU’s layers stacked from top to bottom: PyTorch, cuDNN and cuBLAS, the CUDA runtime, the user-mode driver libcuda.so, the kernel driver nvidia.ko, the graphics card; between the two drivers runs the system-call line. The buttons pick a kind of world: Native, conda, Docker container (the default), Apptainer --nv, VM (passthrough), WSL 2, Docker Desktop on a Mac. Coloured blocks are what this world brings itself, grey bars are the host’s and shared by everyone, a dashed box is an inserted layer, and red means missing. ▶ Play, Back, Next step, Restart: one torch.matmul travels down through every layer from the top.
        • 

      • 能不能跑：选主机的驱动版本（470、525、535、550、570、580），表里列出五个 CUDA 版本（11.7、12.1、12.4、12.8、13.2）各能不能跑、差在哪。默认是工作站的 550；470 那一行是灰的：RTX 4090 至少要 520 的驱动。Will it run: pick the host’s driver version (470, 525, 535, 550, 570, 580), and the table shows, for each of five CUDA versions (11.7, 12.1, 12.4, 12.8, 13.2), whether it runs and where it falls short. The default is the workstation’s 550; the 470 row is greyed out: the RTX 4090 needs at least driver 520.
        • 

      • 一块卡分给几个人：轮流、MPS、MIG、vGPU、直通，图里画出计算单元、显存和时间各怎样分；选 MIG 时，可以挑 H100 80GB 的六种切法，看每份分到多少显存和计算单元、还空着多少。One GPU for several people: Time-slicing, MPS, MIG, vGPU, Passthrough; the diagram shows how compute units, memory and time are each divided. With MIG selected, you can choose one of six ways to cut an H100 80GB and see how much memory and compute each slice gets, and how much is left free.
        • 

      

      先玩：在"谁提供哪一层"里比较 Docker 容器和虚拟机：内核驱动各是谁的？在"能不能跑"里，驱动 550 能跑哪几个 CUDA 版本？要跑 CUDA 13.2，驱动至少要升到多少？Try first: in "Who provides each layer", compare the Docker container with the VM: whose kernel driver does each one use? In "Will it run", which CUDA versions can driver 550 run? To run CUDA 13.2, what is the lowest driver you need to upgrade to?
      

      


      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      

      


      

      

      

      

      

      


      这一步的要点：GPU 的驱动一半在内核里（nvidia.ko）、一半在用户态（libcuda.so），两半版本一般要一致，整台机器只有一份，各种世界都只能共用主机的；CUDA 运行时和库跟着程序走，每个世界可以各带一版。规则是 v ≥ vmin(k)：550 的驱动能跑 CUDA 11.x 和 12.x，跑不了 13.x。容器靠 NVIDIA Container Toolkit 借用主机的驱动；虚拟机要直通或 vGPU；一块卡分给几个人，可以轮流、MPS，或者用 MIG 在硬件上切成最多 7 份。The point of this step: half of the GPU driver is in the kernel (nvidia.ko) and half in user mode (libcuda.so); the two halves normally have to be the same version, there is only one copy for the whole machine, and every kind of world can only share the host’s. The CUDA runtime and libraries go with the program, and each world can bring its own version. The rule is v ≥ vmin(k): driver 550 can run CUDA 11.x and 12.x, but not 13.x. Containers borrow the host’s driver through the NVIDIA Container Toolkit; VMs need passthrough or vGPU; to share one card among several people you can take turns, use MPS, or use MIG to cut it in hardware into up to 7 slices.
      

      

      

      第 ⑭ 步 · 硬件里的墙Step ⑭ · Walls in hardware
      

      分开的机器、硬件分区和可信执行环境Separate machines, hardware partitions and trusted execution environments
      

      切得最低的一类，墙直接修在硬件里。The methods that cut lowest of all build the wall straight into the hardware.
      

      分开的机器是最老、最笨、也最稳的办法：要两件事互不影响，就各用各的电脑。机器人身上其实已经这样做了：E 那个 1 kHz 的关节控制回路，最稳妥的放法是一台单独的实时控制器，或者 Thor 旁边的一个微控制器，它和跑大模型的那台计算机只通过总线交换数据，大模型卡住一秒，关节照样每毫秒更新一次（第 5 篇）。代价是钱、体积、功耗，还有要在两台机器之间搬数据、对时钟。Separate machines are the oldest, crudest and also the most dependable method: if two things must not affect each other, give each its own computer. The robot itself already does this: the safest place for E, the 1 kHz joint control loop, is a separate real-time controller, or a microcontroller next to Thor. It exchanges data with the computer running the big models only over a bus, so even if a big model stalls for a second, the joints are still updated every millisecond (page 5). The cost is money, size and power, plus moving data between the two machines and keeping their clocks in sync.
      

      硬件分区是把一台大机器在硬件或固件层面切成几台小的。IBM 大型机上的逻辑分区（LPAR）是"处理器硬件的一个子集"，每个分区看上去就是一台自己的计算机，跑自己的操作系统，分给它的内存不和别的分区共享，由机器里的 PR/SM 来管（IBM）；GPU 上的 MIG 是同一个想法（第 ⑬ 步）。和虚拟机比，分区更固定、更粗：内存是死分的，MIG 连计算单元也是死分的，不能临时借用别人那份没用完的，换来的是互不拖慢（大型机的 LPAR 倒常让几个分区按权重共用处理器，一个分区空出来的算力别的分区能用）。CPU 里的 IOMMU 也属于这一类：它给每个设备一张"能访问哪些内存"的表，直通给虚拟机的显卡或网卡，就算驱动有错、甚至被人控制，也只能读写那台虚拟机的内存（Linux 内核文档）。Hardware partitions cut one big machine into several smaller ones at the hardware or firmware level. A logical partition (LPAR) on an IBM mainframe is "a subset of the processor hardware": each partition looks like a computer of its own and runs its own operating system, the memory given to it isn’t shared with other partitions, and PR/SM inside the machine manages them (IBM). MIG on a GPU is the same idea (step ⑬). Compared with virtual machines, partitions are more fixed and coarser: memory is divided rigidly, and with MIG so are the compute units, so no one can temporarily borrow what is left unused in someone else’s share; in return, they don’t slow each other down. (Mainframe LPARs, though, often let several partitions share the processors by weight, so computing power that one partition leaves idle can be used by the others.) The IOMMU in the CPU belongs here too: it gives each device a table of "which memory it may access", so a graphics card or network card passed through to a VM, even if its driver is buggy or has been taken over by someone, can only read and write that VM’s memory (Linux kernel docs).
      

      可信执行环境（TEE）防的是另一种人。前面所有的墙，都是在保护主机不被里面的程序伤害，或者保护几个世界互不伤害；可要是你把数据交给别人的机器去算，比如在云上用家里拍的视频训练模型，要防的就是那台机器的主人：管理员、虚拟机监控器、甚至被攻破的主机内核。可信执行环境让 CPU 自己把一块内存隔开，主机上别的软件，连内核和监控器，都看不到里面的明文；SGX、SEV、TDX 还给这块内存加密，离开 CPU 就是密文（TrustZone 只做硬件隔离）。它们大多还能"远程证明"：让远方的你确认里面跑的确实是你那份代码。训练要用 GPU，GPU 也得支持这一套：NVIDIA 从 H100 起才有，要和 CPU 的可信执行环境一起用，否则数据一进显卡就出了这道墙。A trusted execution environment (TEE) protects against a different kind of person. All the walls so far protect the host from the programs inside, or the worlds from one another. But if you hand your data to someone else’s machine to compute on, say to train a model in the cloud on videos filmed at home, the one you have to guard against is that machine’s owner: its administrators, the hypervisor, even a compromised host kernel. A trusted execution environment has the CPU itself fence off a region of memory, so no other software on the host, not even the kernel or the hypervisor, can see the plaintext inside; SGX, SEV and TDX also encrypt that memory, so once it leaves the CPU it is ciphertext (TrustZone only isolates it in hardware). Most of them can also do "remote attestation": letting you, far away, confirm that what runs inside really is your code. Training needs a GPU, so the GPU has to support all this too: NVIDIA only has it from the H100 onwards, and it must be used together with the CPU’s trusted execution environment; otherwise the data is outside the wall the moment it enters the graphics card.
      

      

      技术Technology保护的是What it protects防着谁Against whom
      


      Arm TrustZoneCPU 里一个单独的"安全世界"，和普通世界在硬件上隔开，常用来跑可信启动和一个小的可信操作系统（Arm）A separate "secure world" inside the CPU, isolated in hardware from the normal world; often used to run trusted boot and a small trusted operating system (Arm)普通世界里的操作系统和程序The operating system and programs in the normal world
      

      Intel SGX一个应用里的一小块"飞地"：外面的软件，连内核在内，都读不到；离开 CPU 时自动加密（McKeen 等 2013）A small "enclave" inside an application: software outside it, the kernel included, can’t read it; it is encrypted automatically when it leaves the CPU (McKeen et al. 2013)操作系统、监控器The operating system, the hypervisor
      

      AMD SEV整台虚拟机：每台一把钥匙，把客户机和监控器互相隔开；后来的 SEV-SNP 还防监控器偷偷改内存（AMD）A whole VM: one key per VM, keeping the guest and the hypervisor apart from each other; the later SEV-SNP also stops the hypervisor from secretly altering memory (AMD)监控器、主机The hypervisor, the host
      

      Intel TDX整台虚拟机（叫"信任域"）：硬件隔离，内存对云服务商不可见（Intel）A whole VM (called a "trust domain"): isolated in hardware, its memory invisible to the cloud provider (Intel)监控器、主机、云服务商The hypervisor, the host, the cloud provider
      

      

      它们的代价是：要特定的 CPU；调试困难；进出加密区域要花额外的时间；而且侧面的攻击一再出现：2018 年的 Foreshadow 利用 CPU 的推测执行，从 SGX 飞地里读出了明文，连英特尔用来做远程证明的密钥都取了出来（Van Bulck 等 2018）。所以它是一道很高的墙，但不是不透风的墙。对机器人团队，它只在"数据很敏感、算力又必须租别人的"时候才值得用。What they cost: they need particular CPUs; debugging is hard; getting in and out of the encrypted region takes extra time; and side-channel attacks keep turning up: in 2018, Foreshadow used the CPU’s speculative execution to read plaintext out of SGX enclaves, and even extracted the keys Intel uses for remote attestation (Van Bulck et al. 2018). So it is a very high wall, but not an airtight one. For the robot team it is only worth using when "the data is very sensitive and the computing power has to be rented from someone else".
      

      这一步的要点：墙修在硬件里最结实：分开的机器什么都不共用（实时控制最好这样放），硬件分区（LPAR、MIG）把一台大机器切成几份，至少内存是死分的，IOMMU 管住设备能碰哪些内存。可信执行环境防的是机器的主人：CPU 把内存隔开、加密，监控器和主机看不到明文，还能远程证明里面跑的是什么。The point of this step: walls built into the hardware are the sturdiest. Separate machines share nothing (the best place for real-time control); hardware partitions (LPAR, MIG) cut one big machine into several parts, with at least the memory divided rigidly; the IOMMU controls which memory a device can touch. A trusted execution environment protects against the machine’s owner: the CPU fences off and encrypts memory, so the hypervisor and the host can’t see the plaintext, and it can prove remotely what is running inside.
      

      

      

      第 ⑮ 步 · 怎么选、怎么套Step ⑮ · Choosing and nesting
      

      七个要求，七个答案Seven requests, seven answers
      

      回到第 0 步的工作站。选法就是第 ③ 步那句话：找出必须不同的最低一层，就在那里切开，不要更低；再看要不要额外加一堵墙。一个一个来：Back to the workstation from step 0. The way to choose is the sentence from step ③: find the lowest layer that has to differ, cut there, and no lower; then see whether an extra wall is needed. One at a time:
      

        

      • A 新项目（只是 Python 包不同）：切在"包"上就够了。uv venv 建一个环境，装 PyTorch 2.5.1 的 CUDA 12.4 版；再生成一个锁文件，把每个包的确切版本记下来，换台机器能装出一样的环境。A New project (only the Python packages differ): cutting at "packages" is enough. uv venv creates an environment; install the CUDA 12.4 build of PyTorch 2.5.1 in it, then generate a lock file that records every package’s exact version, so that another machine can install an identical environment.
        • 

      • B 老项目（还要 Python 3.8 和 CUDA 11.7）：要低一层，连解释器和 CUDA 运行时也换。conda 建一个 Python 3.8 的环境；或者用 uv 另装一个 3.8，再装 PyTorch 官方给 CUDA 11.7 编译的版本。驱动不用动：550 ≥ 450，CUDA 11.7 照样能跑（第 ⑬ 步）。B Old project (also needs Python 3.8 and CUDA 11.7): one layer lower, so the interpreter and the CUDA runtime change too. Create a Python 3.8 environment with conda, or have uv install a separate 3.8, then install the official PyTorch build compiled for CUDA 11.7. The driver can stay as it is: 550 ≥ 450, so CUDA 11.7 still runs (step ⑬).
        • 

      • C ROS 2 Humble（要 22.04 的系统库）：再低一层，换整个发行版，内核不用换：一个从 ros:humble 起的容器。要用 rviz2 这类图形工具，Distrobox 更顺手。长远看，迁到 24.04 对应的 Jazzy，这个容器就可以不要了。C ROS 2 Humble (needs 22.04’s system libraries): one layer lower again, swapping the whole distribution but not the kernel: a container based on ros:humble. For graphical tools such as rviz2, Distrobox is handier. In the long run, once you move to Jazzy, the release that goes with 24.04, this container can be dropped.
        • 

      • D 标定工具（要另一个操作系统，还要 USB）：要换内核和操作系统：一台 Windows 虚拟机，把传感器的 USB 设备直通进去，ROS 在外面照常跑。如果标定对 USB 的时序很敏感、在虚拟机里不稳定，就退回双系统。D Calibration tool (needs another operating system, plus USB): the kernel and the operating system have to change: a Windows VM with the sensor’s USB device passed through to it, while ROS carries on outside as usual. If the calibration is very sensitive to USB timing and unreliable in the VM, fall back to dual boot.
        • 

      • E 控制回路（要实时内核）：内核只有一个，容器换不了；普通虚拟机会随时被监控器暂停，也不行。看起来最直接的办法是给主机本身装实时内核：PREEMPT_RT 从 Linux 6.12 起进了主线（Phoronix 2024），Ubuntu 24.04 也有现成的实时内核，个人和小规模商用最多 5 台免费（Canonical 2024）。可这台工作站上有个大麻烦：NVIDIA 的驱动官方不支持实时内核，装驱动时会报错停下（设 IGNORE_PREEMPT_RT_PRESENCE=1 能强行编译，风险自负），A、B 的训练就可能用不了这块 4090（Ubuntu 论坛）。实时和 GPU 训练抢的是同一个内核，这正是"内核只有一个"的代价。所以最稳妥的，是第 ⑭ 步说的单独的实时控制器；退一步，用双系统多装一个实时内核，控制机器人时开进它。E Control loop (needs a real-time kernel): there is only one kernel, and a container can’t change it; an ordinary VM can be paused by the hypervisor at any moment, so that won’t do either. The most direct fix seems to be a real-time kernel on the host itself: PREEMPT_RT has been in mainline since Linux 6.12 (Phoronix 2024), and Ubuntu 24.04 has a ready-made real-time kernel, free for personal and small-scale commercial use on up to 5 machines (Canonical 2024). But this workstation has a big snag: NVIDIA’s driver does not officially support real-time kernels, and installing it stops with an error (setting IGNORE_PREEMPT_RT_PRESENCE=1 forces the build, at your own risk), so A’s and B’s training might lose the use of the 4090 (Ubuntu forum). Real time and GPU training are fighting over the same kernel: this is exactly the price of "there is only one kernel". So the safest choice is the separate real-time controller from step ⑭; failing that, use dual boot to install a real-time kernel alongside and boot into it when driving the robot.
        • 

      • F 别人的代码（要一堵墙）：至少是一个加固的容器（没有网络、只读、去掉能力、普通用户、限制资源）；要跑陌生人的代码，再加一层 gVisor，或者一份一台 Firecracker 微虚拟机。千万别只用一个 conda 环境：那是约定，不是墙。F Someone else’s code (needs a wall): at the very least a hardened container (no network, read-only, capabilities dropped, a non-root user, limited resources); for strangers’ code, add a layer of gVisor, or give each piece of code its own Firecracker microVM. Whatever you do, don’t rely on a conda environment alone: that’s a convention, not a wall.
        • 

      • G 部署（换 CPU、没有 root、要复现）：做成容器镜像，同时出 x86-64 和 ARM64 两个版本，ARM64 的最好直接在 Thor 或别的 ARM 机器上构建，不要在工作站上用 QEMU 翻译着编译（第 ⑥ 步）。云上的 GPU 服务器本身是虚拟机，容器跑在它里面；学校集群上不能用 Docker，就把同一个镜像转成 Apptainer 的 .sif，加 --nv 借用节点上的驱动，CUDA 运行时还是镜像里自带的那份（不用容器的作业，才用 Lmod 加载集群装好的 CUDA）。要复现，记下镜像的摘要和锁文件（摘要钉死了镜像里的每一个文件，连 glibc 在内）；要半年后还能从一份描述文件重新造出一模一样的环境，用 Nix。G Deployment (another CPU, no root, must be reproducible): build a container image in two versions at once, x86-64 and ARM64; the ARM64 one is best built directly on Thor or another ARM machine, rather than compiled on the workstation under QEMU translation (step ⑥). The cloud GPU server is itself a VM, and the container runs inside it; the university cluster doesn’t allow Docker, so convert the same image into an Apptainer .sif and add --nv to borrow the node’s driver, while the CUDA runtime is still the copy that comes in the image (only jobs that don’t use a container load the cluster’s installed CUDA with Lmod). To reproduce, record the image’s digest and the lock file (the digest pins down every file in the image, glibc included); to be able to rebuild an identical environment from one description file six months later, use Nix.
        • 

      

      这些方法常常是套着用的，每套一层，就多付一层的代价，墙也取最结实的那一层。几个真实的例子：These methods are often nested inside one another: each level of nesting adds its own cost, and the wall is that of the sturdiest level. A few real examples:
      

        

      • Mac 上的 Docker Desktop：你的容器 → 一台 Linux 虚拟机（苹果的虚拟化框架）→ macOS。在 Mac 上"跑容器"，其实先付了一台虚拟机的钱。Docker Desktop on a Mac: your container → a Linux VM (Apple’s Virtualization framework) → macOS. "Running a container" on a Mac actually means paying for a VM first.
        • 

      • Windows 上的 Docker Desktop：容器 → WSL 2 的那台轻量虚拟机 → Windows。Docker Desktop on Windows: container → WSL 2’s lightweight VM → Windows.
        • 

      • 云上训练：conda 环境 → 容器 → 一台云服务器（虚拟机）→ 云厂商的物理机。三层各管一件事：conda 管 Python 包，容器管发行版和可搬运，虚拟机管多租户之间的墙。Training in the cloud: conda environment → container → a cloud server (a VM) → the provider’s physical machine. Each of the three levels does one job: conda looks after the Python packages, the container the distribution and portability, and the VM the wall between tenants.
        • 

      • Kata Containers：每个 pod（单独跑一个容器时就是这个容器）→ 一台自己的轻量虚拟机 → 主机。用起来是容器，墙是虚拟机。Kata Containers: each pod (or the container itself, when one runs on its own) → a lightweight VM of its own → the host. You use it like a container, but the wall is a VM’s.
        • 

      

        

      • 最上面一排七个按钮 A 到 G 是七个要求的预设，点一下就勾上对应的几项；▶ 播放 从 A 到 G 依次走一遍，清空 去掉所有的勾。The seven buttons A to G in the top row are presets for the seven requests: one tap ticks the matching boxes; ▶ Play goes through A to G in turn, and Clear removes all the ticks.
        • 

      • 下面十一个勾选框是十一种需要，从"只是 Python 包版本不同"一直到"要防着机器的主人"，每一项后面写着它要求在哪一层切开。勾哪几个，右边的卡片就写出：最低的切口、推荐用什么、也可以用什么、什么不合适、谁守墙，以及代价；旁边一个小的层图画出这条切线。勾了好几项时，卡片下面再写出它们怎么组合。Below them, eleven checkboxes stand for eleven needs, from "Only Python package versions differ" all the way to "Must protect against the machine’s owner", each followed by the layer at which it needs the cut. Whatever you tick, the card on the right sets out the lowest cut, what is recommended, the alternatives, what is not a fit, who guards the wall, and the costs; beside it, a small layer diagram draws the cut line. When several boxes are ticked, the bottom of the card also says how they combine.
        • 

      • 最下面"套娃"：四个按钮画出上面四个真实的嵌套例子，一层套一层，数着套了几层、程序的系统调用最后落到哪个内核。At the very bottom, "Nesting": four buttons draw the four real nested examples above, one level inside another, counting how many levels there are and showing which kernel the program’s system calls finally land in.
        • 

      

      先玩：依次点 A 到 G，看那条切线怎样上下移动。只勾"还要别的发行版"，再加勾"要跑不可信的代码"：推荐变成了什么？为什么墙要另加，而不是把切线再往下移？Try first: tap A to G in turn and watch how the cut line moves up and down. Tick only "Also another distribution", then also tick "Must run untrusted code": what does the recommendation become? Why is the wall added separately, rather than the cut line being moved further down?
      

      


      

      

      

      

      

      


      

      

      

        

        

        

        

        

        

        


        

        

        

        

        


        这一步的要点：七个要求的答案：A 用 uv 或 venv 加锁文件；B 用 conda（或 uv 另装 Python 3.8），驱动不用动；C 用 ros:humble 容器（图形工具用 Distrobox）；D 用带 USB 直通的 Windows 虚拟机，不行再双系统；E 最好用单独的实时控制器（主机装实时内核会和 NVIDIA 驱动冲突，退一步用双系统开进实时内核）；F 用加固容器再加 gVisor 或微虚拟机；G 用多架构的镜像，集群上转成 Apptainer 加 --nv，记下摘要和锁文件，要能从描述文件重新造出一样的环境就用 Nix。方法可以套着用，代价一层层加，墙取最结实的一层。The point of this step: the answers to the seven requests: A uses uv or venv plus a lock file; B uses conda (or a Python 3.8 installed by uv), and the driver stays as it is; C uses a ros:humble container (Distrobox for graphical tools); D uses a Windows VM with USB passthrough, with dual boot if that fails; E is best served by a separate real-time controller (a real-time kernel on the host clashes with the NVIDIA driver; failing that, dual boot into a real-time kernel); F uses a hardened container plus gVisor or a microVM; G uses multi-architecture images, converted to Apptainer with --nv on the cluster, records the digest and the lock file, and uses Nix if the same environment must be rebuildable from a description file. Methods can be nested: the costs add up level by level, and the wall is that of the sturdiest level.

        开头的六个问题：The six questions from the opening:
        

          

        1. 共同点：它们都给程序一份"自己的机器"的样子，办法都是在某一层换掉"名字 → 东西"的那张表：sys.path、PATH、库的搜索路径、挂载表、进程号表、页表，或者开机时读进来的那个内核。What they share: they all give a program the look of "a machine of its own", and they all do it by swapping the "name → thing" table at some layer: sys.path, PATH, the library search path, the mount table, the process-ID table, the page table, or the kernel that is read in at boot.
          2. 

        2. 不同点：只有两样：切在哪一层（往上各一份，往下共用），谁来守这条线（硬件、内核、约定，或者轮流；少数靠软件）。另有几种只做翻译、不设墙。How they differ: in only two things: which layer they cut at (from there up, one copy per world; below it, shared), and who guards that line (hardware, the kernel, convention, or taking turns; a few rely on software). A few others only translate and put up no wall.
          3. 

        3. 为什么诞生：五种需要，在五十多年里一批批出现：分享一台贵机器（60 年代的分时和虚拟机），解依赖冲突（chroot、virtualenv、conda、Nix），换系统（x86 虚拟化、Wine、WSL、Rosetta），安全（jail、gVisor、Firecracker），可复现可搬运（Docker、Kubernetes、Nix）。Why they were invented: five needs, which arose in waves over more than fifty years: sharing an expensive machine (time-sharing and virtual machines in the 1960s), untangling dependency conflicts (chroot, virtualenv, conda, Nix), switching systems (x86 virtualisation, Wine, WSL, Rosetta), security (jail, gVisor, Firecracker), and reproducibility and portability (Docker, Kubernetes, Nix).
          4. 

        4. 换来什么、付出什么：切得越低，能换的越多，墙一般也越结实（双系统例外：硬盘是共用的）；启动、内存、磁盘、I/O 的代价也一级级往上涨，从环境的几乎为 0，到容器的约 200 毫秒（测），到虚拟机的十几到几十秒（估），到双系统的一次重启。What they gain, what they cost: the lower the cut, the more you can change, and usually the sturdier the wall (dual boot is the exception: the disk is shared); the costs in start-up, memory, disk and I/O climb step by step too, from almost 0 for an environment, to about 200 ms for a container (measured), to ten-odd to tens of seconds for a VM (est.), to a reboot for dual boot.
          5. 

        5. 怎么工作：进程靠页表（第 ② 步）；虚拟机靠陷入、VM 退出和两层地址翻译（第 ⑤ 步）；容器靠命名空间、控制组和分层的文件系统（第 ⑦、⑧ 步）；环境靠查找顺序（第 ⑪ 步）；Nix 靠按输入算出来的路径（第 ⑫ 步）；可信执行环境靠 CPU 隔开并加密内存（第 ⑭ 步）。How they work: processes rely on page tables (step ②); VMs on traps, VM exits and two levels of address translation (step ⑤); containers on namespaces, control groups and layered file systems (steps ⑦ and ⑧); environments on search order (step ⑪); Nix on paths computed from the inputs (step ⑫); trusted execution environments on the CPU walling off and encrypting memory (step ⑭).
          6. 

        6. 七个要求：见第 ⑮ 步。一句话：在必须不同的最低一层切开，不要更低；要防人，就另加一堵墙。The seven requests: see step ⑮. In one sentence: cut at the lowest layer that has to differ, and no lower; to guard against people, add a separate wall.
          7. 

        

        延伸阅读Further reading
        

          

        • Popek、Goldberg，什么样的机器能虚拟化：虚拟机的定义和"敏感指令都要陷入"的定理（第 ⑤ 步）。Popek and Goldberg, which machines can be virtualised: the definition of a virtual machine, and the theorem that "all sensitive instructions must trap" (step ⑤).
          • 

        • Bugnion 等，最早的 VMware Workstation：在没法靠"陷入再模拟"来虚拟化的 x86 上，用二进制翻译做出虚拟机（第 ⑤ 步）。Bugnion et al., the original VMware Workstation: building virtual machines with binary translation on the x86, which could not be virtualised by "trap and emulate" (step ⑤).
          • 

        • Barham 等，Xen：半虚拟化，一台服务器跑 100 台虚拟机（第 ⑤ 步）。Barham et al., Xen: paravirtualisation, with 100 virtual machines on one server (step ⑤).
          • 

        • Adams、Agesen，软件和硬件虚拟化的比较：为什么第一代 VT-x 不比二进制翻译快（第 ⑤ 步）。Adams and Agesen, a comparison of software and hardware virtualisation: why the first generation of VT-x was no faster than binary translation (step ⑤).
          • 

        • Agache 等，Firecracker：云函数怎样在容器和虚拟机之间取舍（第 ⑥ 步）。Agache et al., Firecracker: how cloud functions weigh containers against virtual machines (step ⑥).
          • 

        • Felter 等，虚拟机和容器的性能比较：同一台机器上原生、Docker、KVM 的逐项对比（第 ⑤、⑧ 步）。Felter et al., a performance comparison of virtual machines and containers: native, Docker and KVM on the same machine, compared test by test (steps ⑤ and ⑧).
          • 

        • Kerrisk，命名空间系列文章：Linux 命名空间一种一种的来历和用法（第 ⑦ 步）。Kerrisk, a series of articles on namespaces: the history and use of each kind of Linux namespace, one by one (step ⑦).
          • 

        • Dolstra 等，Nix：按全部输入的哈希给软件包命名（第 ⑫ 步）。Dolstra et al., Nix: naming software packages by a hash of all their inputs (step ⑫).
          • 

        • Smith、Nair，虚拟机的体系结构：系统虚拟机和进程虚拟机的分类（第 ⑤ 步）。Smith and Nair, the architecture of virtual machines: the division into system virtual machines and process virtual machines (step ⑤).
          •

        本页约定：kB、MB、GB 按 1000 进位，KiB、MiB、GiB 按 1024 进位，引用的数照原文的写法；"我们测的"是在一台 2 个虚拟 CPU、8 GB 内存的云虚拟机上测的（Ubuntu 24.04、Linux 6.18、Docker 29.8），测量用的小程序放在本页仓库的 isolation/meas/ 目录里，换一台机器数会变，量级不会变；"估"是没有出处的数量级估计。软件的版本、授权和价格以 2026 年 11 月公开的文档为准。厨房机器人的团队和它的七个要求是虚构的，工作站和 Thor 的配置照着真实的产品来配。所有交互都在你的浏览器里实时计算，其中 Nix 那一个的哈希是真的 SHA-256。Conventions on this page: kB, MB and GB count in powers of 1000, KiB, MiB and GiB in powers of 1024, and figures quoted from sources are written as in the original; "we measured" means measured on a cloud VM with 2 virtual CPUs and 8 GB of memory (Ubuntu 24.04, Linux 6.18, Docker 29.8), and the small programs used for measuring are in the isolation/meas/ folder of this page’s repository: on another machine the numbers will change, but their order of magnitude will not; "est." is an order-of-magnitude estimate with no source. Software versions, licences and prices follow the documentation published as of November 2026. The kitchen-robot team and its seven requests are fictional; the specifications of the workstation and Thor follow real products. Every widget is computed live in your browser, and the hashes in the Nix one are real SHA-256.
